articles.heading: Icyo iri tegeko rigamije
Isobanura Muri iri tegeko
articles.text:
(a) “kopi y’igihangano iri mu buryo
ishobora kugerwaho” bivuga kopi
y’igihangano iri mu buryo cyangwa mu
miterere iha umuntu ufite ubumuga bwo
kutabona, kutabona neza cyangwa
kutabasha gusoma igitabo, kubasha kugera
ku gihangano, harimo gufasha uwo muntu
kukigeraho mu buryo bushoboka kandi
yisanzuye nk’undi muntu ubona neza
cyangwa usoma neza igitabo;
(b) “igihangano nyiracyo atazwi” bivuga
igihangano umuntu adashobora kumenya
izina nyaryo cyangwa iry’irihimbano
ry’umuhanzi;
(c) “ARIPO” bivuga Umuryango wo mu
Karere ka Afurika ugamije kurengera
umutungo bwite mu by’ubwenge;
(d) “igihangano cy’iyumvabona” bivuga
igihangano kigizwe n’uruhererekane
rw’amashusho ayega cyangwa asa nk’aho
ayega, aherekejwe cyangwa adaherekejwe
n’amajwi, ashobora kuboneshwa amaso,
kandi igihe aherekejwe n’amajwi akaba
ashobora kumvwa;
(e) “umuhanzi” bivuga umuntu wahanze
igihangano;
(f) “urwego rubifite mu nshingano” bivuga
urwego rwemewe cyangwa rwahawe na
Leta uruhushya rwo gutanga serivisi
z’uburezi, amahugurwa, kwimenyereza
gusoma cyangwa kugeza amakuru ku
bantu bafite ubumuga bwo kutabona
cyangwa abatabasha gusoma igitabo,
rutagamije inyungu;
(g) “ubusabe bw’ibanze” bivuga ubusabe
bwo kwandikisha ikirango bushyikirizwa
ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha kandi
bukoreshwa nk’ubushingirwaho mu
gutanga ubusabe ku rwego mpuzamahanga
;
(h) “iyandikishwa ry’ibanze” bivuga
iyandikwa ry'ikirango rikozwe
n’ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha kandi
rishingirwaho mu gutanga ubusabe ku
rwego mpuzamahanga ;
(i) “isakaza” bivuga iyohereza hifashishijwe
uburyo budakoresha insinga hagamijwe
kugeza kuri rubanda amajwi cyangwa
amashusho aherekejwe n’amajwi cyangwa
ibigaragazwa n’amajwi n’amashusho,
harimo isakaza rikoresheje icyogajuru
n’isakaza ry’ibimenyetso biri mu buryo
buhishe aho uburyo bukoreshwa mu
kubihishura buhabwa rubanda bikozwe
n’ikigo cy’isakaza cyangwa kimaze
kubyemera;
(j) ikirango nyemeza” bivuga ikimenyetso
cyangwa urwunge rw’ibimenyetso
bishobora kugaragaza imiterere ihuriweho,
irimo inkomoko cyangwa ubuziranenge,
uburyo bw’imitunganyirize y’ibyakozwe
cyangwa serivisi kandi imikoreshereze
yabyo ikagengwa n’ufite uburenganzira ku
kimenyetso;
(k) “ihiganwa ririmo uburiganya” bivuga
igikorwa cyose cyangwa imigenzereze
bigaragaramo ubuhemu mu rwego
rw’inganda cyangwa urw’ubucuruzi
bikaba bifite inkurikizi cyangwa
umugambi wo kugera ku nyungu
z’ubucuruzi zibangikanye n’iz’ukora
imirimo imwe cyangwa ibicuruzwa bimwe
nk’iby’undi;
(l) “ikirango gihuriweho” bivuga
ikimenyetso kigaragara gituma inkomoko,
ubwiza cyangwa imiterere rusange
by’igicuruzwa cyangwa bya serivisi
by’abakoresha icyo kimenyetso
bitandukanywa n’ibimenyetso by’abandi;
(m)“igihangano gihuriweho” bivuga
igihangano cyahanzwe n’abantu benshi
bahagarariwe n’umuntu kandi cyahanzwe
ku buryo uruhare n’imyirondoro
by’abahanze icyo gihangano bidashobora
kugaragazwa bitandukanye;
(n) “kumenyesha rubanda” bivuga
ugusakaza kuri rubanda, hifashishijwe
uburyo ubwo ari bwo bwose, igihangano,
ikinwa ry’igihangano, fonogaramu
cyangwa amajwi n’amashusho byafashwe
cyangwa icyasakajwe bikagera ku bantu
batari mu itsinda ry’umuryango n’abandi
bafitanye umubano wa bugufi bari ahantu
hamwe cyangwa kure ugereranyije n’aho
ibyasakajwe byakomotse ku buryo
hatabaye iryo sakaza, icyo gihangano,
ikinwa ry’igihangano, fonogaramu
cyangwa amajwi n’amashusho byafashwe
cyangwa icyasakajwe bidashobora kugera
kubo bigenewe, hakubiyemo kugeza ku
bantu igihangano cyangwa ikindi
kirengewe ku buryo rubanda rushobora
kubigeraho ahantu no ku gihe buri wese
yihitiyemo;
(o) “ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha” bivuga
urwego rufite mu nshingano kurengera
umutungo bwite mu by’ubwenge;
(p) “inyandiko nsobanurabuvumbuzi
yuzuye” bivuga inyandiko igaragaza
amakuru yose mu buryo buhagije kandi
busobanutse ku cyavumbuwe, ku buryo
umuntu ubifitemo ubumenyi busanzwe
yashobora kugikoresha;
(q) uruhushya rutegetswe” bivuga
uruhushya rwo gukoresha ubuvumbuzi,
ubuvumbuzi buciriritse, igishushanyo
n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa mu nganda
cyangwa igishushanyo ndangamiterere
cy’urusobekerane rw’imiyoboro yo mu
rwego rwa elegitoroniki, Minisitiri aha
undi muntu nta bwumvikane bubayeho
n’ufite uburenganzira;
(r) “porogramu ya mudasobwa” bivuga
amabwiriza agizwe n’amagambo, kode,
ibimenyetso cyangwa ubundi buryo,
biramutse bishyizwe mu gikoresho
gisasanurwa na mudasobwa, bishobora
gutuma mudasobwa cyangwa ubundi
buryo bwa elegitoroniki bishobora
gutunganya amakuru, bikora umurimo
wihariye cyangwa bigera ku musaruro
w’igikorwa cyihariye;
(s) “kopi y’igihangano” bivuga ikivuye mu
gikorwa icyo ari cyo cyose cyo gutubura
igihangano;
(t) “uburenganzira bw’umuhanzi” bivuga
uburenganzira umuhanzi ahabwa bwo
kugira ububasha ku gihangano cye no
kubuza utabifitiye uruhushya kukibyaza
umusaruro;
(u) “kopi ya fonogaramu” bivuga
umuyoboro uwo ariwo wose ukubiyemo
amajwi yakuwe kuri fonogaramu ku buryo
buziguye cyangwa butaziguye kandi
ukubiyemo amajwi cyangwa igice cyayo
byafashwe kuri iyo fonogaramu;
(v) “igihangano cyakomotse ku kindi”
bivuga igihangano cyahanzwe hashingiwe
ku gihangano kimwe cyangwa byinshi
bisanzweho;
(w)“uruhushya rwihariwe” bivuga
amasezerano arebana n’uruhushya aha
uwaruhawe uburenganzira bwo gukoresha
umutungo bwite mu by’ubwenge wenyine,
hatarimo n’ufite uburenganzira ku
mutungo ;
(x) “ibihangano gakondo” bivuga uburyo
cyangwa ingiro ubumenyi ndangamuco
buvugwamo cyangwa bugaragazwamo,
harimo:
(a) imigani, ubusizi n’ibisakuzo;
(b) indirimbo na muzika ikoresha
ibikoresho gakondo;
(c) imbyino n’ikinamico ;
(d) ibihangano by’ubugeni gakondo
by’umwihariko ibishushanyo,
ibishushanyishije amarangi,
amashusho yakozwe mu biti cyangwa
mu mabuye, ibibumbano, ibihangano
bikozwe mu ibumba, ibikoze mu
gitaka, ibikomoka ku ihuzwa
ry’ibikoresho by’amabara anyuranye,
ibikozwe mu giti, ibikozwe mu cyuma,
imitako yambarwa, n’imyenda
iboshywe mu buryo bwa gakondo ;
(y) ifatwa ry’amajwi cyangwa amashusho”
bivuga ishyirwa ku gikoresho ry’amajwi,
amashusho cyangwa byombi cyangwa
ibibigaragaza, aho bishobora kubonwa,
gutuburwa cyangwa kumenyeshwa
rubanda hifashishijwe cya gikoresho;
(z) “ikimenyetso ndangahantu” bivuga
ikimenyetso kiranga icyatunganyijwe
kigaragaza aho cyakomotse haba intara,
akarere cyangwa agace by’igihugu, mu
gihe ubwiza bwacyo, ubwamamare
cyangwa akandi karango kacyo bishingiye
ku nkomoko yacyo;
(aa) “uruganda” bivuga igikorwa cya
muntu cyo gutunganya ibintu cyangwa
serivisi bibyazwa umusaruro mu rwego
rw’ubukungu;
(bb) “igishushanyo n’icyitegererezo
bikoreshwa mu nganda” bivuga
urukomatane rw’imirongo, amabara
cyangwa imiterere by’icyatunganyijwe mu
rwego rw’inganda cyangwa
rw’ubukorikori cyangwa rukaba rwafatwa
nk’icyitegererezo mu gukora
icyatunganyirijwe mu ruganda cyangwa
mu bukorikori;
(cc) “urupapurompamo rw’umutungo
bwite mu by’inganda” bivuga icyemezo
cy’iyandikwa cyatanzwe n’ubuyobozi
bubifitiye ububasha mu birebana na:
(i) ubuvumbuzi;
(ii) ubuvumbuzi buciriritse;
(iii) igishushanyo n’icyitegererezo
bikoreshwa mu ruganda;
(iv) ikirango, ikirango gihuriweho
cyangwa ikirango nyemeza;
(v) ikimenyetso ndangahantu;
(vi) igishushanyo ndangamiterere
cy’urusobekerane rw’imiyoboro yo
mu rwego rwa elegitoroniki.
(dd) “urusobekerane rw’imiyoboro ya
elegitoroniki” bivuga igikorwa
cyarangiye gutunganywa cyangwa
kigitunganywa, aho urusobekerane ruba
rugize umubyimba cyangwa imiterere
by’igikoresho kigenewe gukoreshwa
igikorwa cyo mu rwego rwa elegitoroniki;
(ee) “ubusabe ku rwego
mpuzamahanga” bivuga ubusabe bwo
guhabwa impamyabuvumbuzi, iyandikwa
ry’ikirango n’iry’igishushanyo
n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa mu nganda
hakurikijwe amasezerano mpuzamahanga
(ff) “Ibiro Mpuzamahanga” bivuga ibiro
by’Umuryango Mpuzamahanga ushinzwe
Umutungo bwite mu by’Ubwenge;
(gg) “rejisitiri mpuzamahanga” bivuga
ikusanyirizo ryemewe n’amategeko
ry’amakuru yerekeye iyandikwa ku rwego
mpuzamahanga ry’umutungo bwite mu
by’inganda rigengwa n’Ibiro
Mpuzamahanga;
(hh) “ubuvumbuzi” bivuga igitekerezo
cy’umuvumbuzi gitanga igisubizo ku
kibazo cyo mu rwego rwa tekiniki
cyangwa cyo mu rwego
rw’ikoranabuhanga, gishobora kuba
kigizwe cyangwa gifitanye isano
n’icyatunganyijwe cyangwa uburyo bwo
kukigeraho;
(ii) “gushyira ahagaragara” bivuga gushyira
ahagaragara igihangano cyangwa ikindi
kintu kirengewe mu buryo bukoresha
cyangwa budakoresha insinga ku buryo
rubanda cyangwa umuntu ku giti cye
bashobora kukigeraho ahantu n’igihe
babishakiye;
(jj) igishushanyo ndangamiterere
cy’urusobekerane rw’imiyoboro yo mu
rwego rwa elegitoroniki” bivuga
imiterere y’ibintu byagaragajwe mu buryo
bw’ibyerekezo bitatu uko byaba bimeze
kose, nibura kimwe kikaba ari cyo gikora
kandi cyose cyangwa igice cyacyo kikaba
ari urusobekerane ry’umuyoboro
ukomatanyije cyangwa iyo miterere
yagaragajwe mu buryo bw’ibyerekezo
bitatu ikaba yarateguriwe urusobekerane
rw’umuyoboro ukomatanyije rugomba
gukorwa;
(kk) “uruhushya rushingiye ku
masezerano” bivuga amasezerano
cyangwa ubwumvikane ufite umutungo
bwite mu by’ubwenge agirana n’undi
muntu amuha uruhushya rwo kuwubyaza
umusaruro;
(ll) “ikirango” bivuga ikimenyetso kigaragara
gituma icyakozwe cyangwa serivisi
y'umuntu itandukanywa n'iy’undi;
(mm) “Minisitiri” bivuga Minisitiri ufite
umutungo bwite mu by’ubwenge mu
nshingano;
(nn) “uruhushya rutihariwe” bivuga
amasezerano y’uruhushya aha abantu
babiri cyangwa benshi uburenganzira bwo
kubyaza umusaruro uburenganzira ku
mutungo bwite mu by’inganda;
(oo) “igihangano nyiracyo ataboneka ”
bivuga igihangano kirengewe ariko bikaba
bigoye cyangwa bidashoboka kumenya
aho ufite uburenganzira kuri icyo
gihangano aherereye ;
(pp) “impamyabuvumbuzi” bivuga
icyemezo gitangwa n’ubuyobozi bubifiye
ububasha mu rwego rwo kurengera
ubuvumbuzi;
(qq) “umuhanzi uririmba cyangwa ukina
igihangano” bivuga uririmba,
umunyamuziki, ubyina, uvuga cyangwa
ukina igihangano ;
(rr) “umunyamwuga ubifitemo ubumenyi
busanzwe kandi ubikoramo” bivuga
umunyarwanda cyangwa umuntu wese
usanzwe utuye mu Rwanda, akorera
umwuga we mu Rwanda, afite ubumenyi,
ubuzobere n’uburambe mu ngeri ya
tekiniki y’ubuvumbuzi umuntu asabira
kwitirirwa;
(ss)“umuntu ufite ubumuga bwo kutabona,
utabona neza cyangwa utabasha gusoma
igitabo ” bivuga umuntu:
(i) ufite ubumuga bwo kutabona
nabusa;
(ii) ufite ubumuga bwo kutabona neza
cyangwa ubwo kutabasha gusoma,
kandi ubwo bumuga bukaba
budashobora kuvurwa kugira ngo
umuntu ubufite abe yabasha
kubona mu buryo buhwanye
n’ubw’undi muntu udafite
ubumuga nk’ubwo, kubera iyo
mpamvu akaba adashobora
gusoma igitabo ku kigero
gihwanye n’icy’umuntu udafite
ubwo bumuga;
(iii)cyangwa ufite ubumuga
bw’ingingo z’umubiri, utabasha
gufata cyangwa gukoresha
igitabo, utabasha kwitegereza
cyangwa kuraranganya amaso
kugira ngo abashe gusoma.
(tt) “fonogaramu” bivuga amajwi y'ikinwa
ry’igihangano cyangwa andi majwi
yafashwe cyangwa andi majwi atari
ayafashwe ashyirwa mu gihangano
cy’iyumvabona;
(uu) “ukora fonogaramu” bivuga umuntu
wafashe bwa mbere fonogaramu;
(vv) igihangano cy’ifoto” bivuga ifoto
yatunganyijwe yafashwe hifashishijwe
urumuri cyangwa indi mirasire
hakaboneka ishusho igaragara ku
gikoresho cyangwa ishobora kuvanwa ku
gikoresho hifashishijwe uburyo
bw’ubutabire, ubwa elegitoroniki cyangwa
ubundi buryo;
(ww) “inyandiko nsobanurabuvumbuzi
y’agateganyo” bivuga inyandiko
igaragaza muri rusange, ariko atari mu
buryo bwuzuye igitekerezo
cy’ubuvumbuzi, itangwa kugira ngo
uwavumbuye ashinganishe itariki yo
gutanga abandi, mu gihe umuvumbuzi
akeneye igihe cy’inyongera cyo
gutunganya mu buryo burambuye
ubuvumbuzi bwe;
(xx) “gukina igihangano mu
ruhame” bivuga kuvuga mu mutwe
igihangano, kugikina, kukibyina cyangwa
kugikina mu bundi buryo butaziguye
cyangwa hifashishijwe ikindi gikoresho
cyangwa indi mikorere. Iyo ari igihangano
cy’iyumvabona ni ukwerekana
uruhererekane rw’amashusho yacyo
cyangwa kumvikanisha amajwi
agiherekeje. Iyo ari fonogaramu ni
ukumvikanisha amajwi yafashwe ahantu
hamwe cyangwa hanyuranye abantu
batari mu itsinda ry’umuryango cyangwa
abawegereye bahari cyangwa badahari,
hatitawe ko abo bantu baba bari cyangwa
bashobora kuba ahantu hamwe no mu gihe
kimwe cyangwa ahantu no mu bihe
bitandukanye, kandi mu gihe igihangano
gikinwa gishobora kugerwaho hatabayeho
imenyekanisha kuri rubanda;
(yy) “igihangano cyatangajwe” bivuga
kopi y’igihangano cyangwa fonogaramu
byasakajwe muri rubanda bitangiwe
uruhushya n’umuhanzi cyangwa ubifitiye
uburenganzira mu buryo bwo kukigurisha,
kugikodesha, kugitiza, kugihererekanya
cyangwa kwemera ko gishobora
kugerwaho mu buryo bwa elegitoroniki;
(zz) “uburenganzira
bushamikiyeho” bivuga uburenganzira
bw’umuhanzi ukina igihangano,
ubw’ukora fonogaramu cyangwa
ubw’ikigo cy’isakaza ridakoresha insinga;
(aaa) “gukodesha” bivuga ihererekanya
ry’igihangano cy’umwimerere cyangwa
kopi yacyo cyangwa fonogaramu mu gihe
kizwi hagamijwe inyungu;
(bbb) “gutubura” bivuga gukora kopi imwe
cyangwa nyinshi z’igihangano,
iz’igihangano gikinwa cyangwa iza
fonogaramu cyangwa iz’ibice byabyo mu
buryo ubwo ari bwo bwose, harimo ifatwa
ry’amajwi n’amashusho n’ibikwa mu
buryo buhoraho cyangwa by’igihe gito
ry’igihangano, igihangano gikinwa
cyangwa fonogaramu mu buryo bwa
elegitoroniki;
(ccc) “amakuru ku micungire
y’uburenganzira ku gihangano” bivuga
amakuru ayo ari yo yose agaragaza
umuhanzi, igihangano, umuhanzi ukina
igihangano, ukora fonogaramu,
fonogaramu, utangaza ikiganiro, ikiganiro
cyatangajwe, ufite uburenganzira ubwo ari
bwo bwose, cyangwa amakuru ayo ari yo
yose yerekeye amategeko n’amabwiriza
byo gukoresha igihangano cyangwa ibindi
bihangano, imibare cyangwa kode biranga
ayo makuru, iyo kimwe mu bigize ayo
makuru cyometswe kuri kopi
y’igihangano, iy’igihangano gikinirwa
ahantu hamwe, cyangwa kuri kopi ya
fonogaramu cyangwa iy’ikiganiro
gisakazwa ahantu hamwe, cyangwa
kigaragara ko gifitanye isano n’isakazwa,
imenyeshwa cyangwa kugeza kuri rubanda
igihangano, igihangano gikinirwa ahantu
hamwe, fonogaramu cyangwa itangazwa;
(ddd) “uruhushya rwihariwe rutari
burundu” bivuga amasezerano
y’uruhushya aha umuntu uburenganzira
bwo kubyaza umusaruro uburenganzira ku
mutungo bwite mu by’inganda, hakuwemo
abandi bantu uretse nyir’uburenganzira;
(eee) “izina ry’ubucuruzi” bivuga izina
cyangwa inyito igaragaza kandi
igatandukanya ubucuruzi bw’umuntu
n’ubw’undi ;
(fff) “ubuvumbuzi buciriritse” bivuga
ubuvumbuzi bwo mu rwego rwa tekinike
bufite imiterere cyangwa ishusho bishya
by’ikintu cyangwa by’igice cy’ikintu,
bizamura urwego rw’imikoreshereze
cyangwa akamaro kacyo;
(ggg) “igihangano” bivuga igihangano
cy’ubuvanganzo, icy’ubugeni cyangwa
igishingiye ku bumenyi;
(hhh) “igihangano cyakomotse ku muco
gakondo” bivuga igihangano cyahanzwe
ahanini hashingiwe ku bikigize byatiwe
mu muco gakondo;
(iii)“igihangano cy’ubugeni mberabyombi”
bivuga igihangano cy’ubugeni gifite
umumaro cyangwa cyakoreshejwe mu
kintu cy’agaciro, cyaba igihangano
cy’ubukorikori cyangwa icyakorewe mu
ruganda;
(jjj)“igihangano gisangiwe” bivuga
igihangano cyahanzwe ku bufatanye
bw’abahanzi babiri cyangwa benshi;
(kkk) “umuntu” bivuga umuntu ku giti cye,
ikigo cya Leta cyangwa icy’abikorera
cyangwa urwego bifite ubuzimagatozi.

articles.heading: Ibirebwa n’iri tegeko Iri tegeko rireba
articles.text:
(a) umutungo bwite mu by’inganda;
(b) uburenganzira bw’umuhanzi
n’uburenganzira
bubushamikiyeho.
INTERURO YA II: UMUTUNGO BWITE
MU BY’INGANDA
UMUTWE WA MBERE: IBIKUBIYE MU
MUTUNGO BWITE MU BY’INGANDA

articles.heading: Ibigize umutungo bwite mu by’inganda Umutungo bwite mu by’inganda ugizwe n’ibi bikurikira
Ubuvumbuzi burengerwa Ubuvumbuzi burengerwa iyo bwujuje ibi bikurikira
Ubushya bw’ubuvumbuzi (1) Ubuvumbuzi buba ari bushya iyo nta bundi bwabubanjirije ukurikije aho tekiniki
articles.text:
igeze.
(2) Mu gusuzuma aho tekiniki igeze hitabwa
ku imenyekanisha ryakorewe aho ari ho
hose ku isi, binyujijwe mu nyandiko
ifatika, mu mvugo, mu ikoreshwa
ry’icyavumbuwe cyangwa mu bundi buryo
ubwo ari bwo bwose, ariko bikaba mbere
y’itariki yo gusaba impamyabuvumbuzi,
cyangwa mbere y’itariki igaragaza ko
usaba ari we watanze abandi kuvumbura,
aho biri ngombwa.
(3) Icyakora, imeyekanisha ry’ubuvumbuzi
ntiryitabwaho mu kugena ubushya
bw’ubuvumbuzi iyo:
(a) rikozwe mu gihe cy’amezi 12
abanziriza umunsi wo gusabiraho
impamyabuvumbuzi;
(b) rikozwe mbere y’itariki y’ubusabe bwo
gutanga abandi kuvumbura, aho biri
ngombwa;
(c) riturutse ku buryo butaziguye cyangwa
buziguye ku bikorwa byakozwe
n’uwasabye icyemezo
cy’ubuvumbuzi;
(d) riturutse ku buhemu bwakozwe n’undi
muntu abukoreye uwasabye icyemezo
cyangwa uwari ugifiteho
uburenganzira.
(4) Hakurikijwe ibikubiye mu gika cya (3)
cy’iyi ngingo, imenyekanisha
ry’ubuvumbuzi ntiryitabwaho mu kugena
ubushya bw’ubuvumbuzi iyo rikozwe mu
gihe cy’amezi 12 abanziriza umunsi wo
gusabiraho impamyabuvumbuzi, cyangwa
aho bishoboka mbere y’itariki y’ubusabe
bwo gutanga abandi kuvumbura ku bireba
ibicuruzwa byamuritswe mu imurika ku
mugaragaro cyangwa mu mamurika
mpuzamahanga yemewe ku mugaragaro
yabereye ku butaka bwa Repubulika y’u
Rwanda. Usaba ashyikiriza urwego
rubifitiye ububasha mu gihe cyo gusaba,
ikimenyetso gihamya igicuruzwa
cyamuritswe n’umunsi imurika
mpuzamahanga ryemewe ryabereyeho.

articles.heading: Intambwe y’ubuvumbuzi Ubuvumbuzi bufatwa ko bugaragaza intambwe y’ubuvumbuzi iyo ukurikije aho
articles.text:
tekiniki igeze ku bijyanye n’igisabirwa
impamyabuvumbuzi, bitari kugaragarira
umunyamwuga ubifitemo ubumenyi
busanzwe.

articles.heading: Gukoresha ubuvumbuzi mu rwego rw’inganda Ubuvumbuzi bushobora gukoreshwa mu rwego rw’inganda iyo icyo bugamije kugeraho
articles.text:
cyangwa bwagezeho gishobora gukorwa
cyagwa gukoreshwa mu ruganda.

articles.heading: Gutanga dosiye isaba impamyabuvumbuzi (1) Dosiye isaba impamyabuvumbuzi ishyikirizwa ubuyobozi bubifitiye
articles.text:
ububasha.
(2) Dosiye isaba impamyabuvumbuzi iba
ikubiyemo ibi bikurikira:
(a) ubusabe bwo guhabwa
impamyabuvumbuzi;
(b) igisobanuro cy’imiterere
y’ubuvumbuzi;
(c) igishya kimwe cyangwa byinshi muri
ubwo buvumbuzi asaba kwitirirwa;
(d) igishushanyo kimwe cyangwa
byinshi bisobanura ubwo buvumbuzi,
iyo ari ngombwa;
(e) incamake y’ubuvumbuzi;
(f) icyemezo cy’uko hishyuwe
amafaranga y’ubusabe.
(3) Iteka rya Minisitiri rishobora kugena
ibindi bishyikirizwa ubuyobozi bubifitiye
ububasha mu gihe cyo gusaba
impamyabuvumbuzi.
(4) Ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha bugena
itariki bwakiriyeho dosiye isaba
impamyabuvumbuzi ifatwa ko ari yo
tariki ubusabe bwatangiweho kandi
bugatondeka ubuvumbuzi hakurikijwe
itondeka mpuzamahanga.

articles.heading: Ubusabe bwo guhabwa impamyabuvumbuzi (1) Ubusabe bwo guhabwa impamyabuvumbuzi bukorwa
articles.text:
huzuzwa inyandiko yabugenewe
ishyirwaho n’ubuyobozi bubifitiye
ububasha.
(2) Gutanga ubusabe byishyurirwa
amafaranga yagenwe.
(3) Icyakora, uburyo bwo gusaba no
gutanga impamyabuvumbuzi
yerekeranye n’umutekano w’igihugu
n’ituze rusange bugenwa n’Iteka rya
Minisitiri ufite Ingabo z’u Rwanda mu
nshingano.

articles.heading: Gusobanura ubuvumbuzi (1) Gusobanura ubuvumbuzi ni ukwerekana no kumenyekanisha mu buryo bugaragara, bwuzuye kandi
articles.text:
bwumvikana ku buryo umuntu
ubifitemo ubumenyi ashobora
gukoresha ubwo buvumbuzi.
(2) Gusobanura byerekana uburyo bwiza
bwo gukoresha ubuvumbuzi ku munsi
w’itangwa ry’ubusabe cyangwa ku
itariki y’ubusabe bwo gutanga abandi.
Aho ari ngombwa hatangwa
ibishushanyo kugira ngo ubuvumbuzi
bwumvikane.
(3) Mbere yo gutanga
impamyabuvumbuzi, ubuyobozi
bubifitiye ububasha bushobora gusaba
igihe icyo aricyo cyose ko ibisobanuro
bikubiye mu busabe
bw’impamyabuvumbuzi
z’abanyamahanga bishyirwa mu rwego
rw’ubumenyi n’ubuhanga by’umuntu
ubifitemo ubumenyi yaba
umunyarwanda cyangwa
umunyamahanga usanzwe atuye kandi
akorera umwuga we muri Repubulika
y’u Rwanda, kugira ngo habeho
ihererekanywa n’ikwirakwizwa rya
tekinoloji.

articles.heading: Gusuzuma ko imenyekanisha rihagije (1) Mu gusuzuma ko imenyekanisha rihagije, ubuyobozi bubifitiye
articles.text:
ububasha bwita ku bikubiye mu
bisobanuro byatanzwe, ibyo umuntu
asaba kwitirirwa n'ibishushanyo iyo
byagaragajwe kugeza ku munsi
w’isuzuma.
(2) Imenyekanisha ry’ubuvumbuzi
umuntu asabira kwitirirwa rifatwa ko
risobanutse bihagije kandi ryuzuye iyo
ritanga amakuru atuma umuntu
ubifitemo ubumenyi akoresha ubwo
buvumbuzi ku itariki y’ubusabe
atagombye kongera gusubira mu
igerageza.

articles.heading: Gusuzuma imenyekanisha rihagije ry’ingirabuzima ntoya Imenyekanisha ry’ubuvumbuzi bw’ingirabuzima ntoya cyangwa ubuvumbuzi
articles.text:
bwifashishije ingirabuzima ntoya zitari
zisanzwe ziboneka muri rubanda kugera ku
munsi wo gutanga ubusabe, rifatwa
nk’irihagije kandi ku buryo ubwo buvumbuzi
bwakoreshwa n’umuntu ubifitemo ubumenyi
iyo ibisabwa bikurikira byujujwe:
(a) iyo indobanwa y’ingirabuzima ntoya
yatanzwe mu kigo mpuzamahanga
zibikwamo cyemewe hakurikijwe
Amasezerano ya Budapest;
(b) iyo ubusabe bwatanzwe butanga
amakuru ahagije ya ngombwa ku
byerekeye imiterere iranga
ingirabuzima ntoya yavumbuwe;
(c) iyo itariki ingirabuzima ntoya
yashyizwe mu bubiko bw’Ikigo
mpuzamahanga zibikwamo, izina
ry’icyo kigo na nimero yo kugera ku
bubiko bwayo byagaragajwe mu
busabe;
(d) iyo usaba yagaragaje icyemezo cyo
kwakira ibikwa ry’ingirabuzima ntoya
cyatanzwe n’ikigo mpuzamahanga
zibikwamo mu gihe kitarenze amezi 12
abarwa uhereye ku itariki ubusabe
bw’impamyabuvumbuzi
bwatangiweho.

articles.heading: Inyandiko igaragaza igishya usaba impamyabuvumbuzi asaba kwitirirwa (1) Inyandiko igaragaza igishya ku
articles.text:
buvumbuzi igomba kugaragaza aho
ukurengerwa gusabwa kugarukira,
ukurengerwa k’ubuvumbuzi
kukaba kugenwa n’ibikubiye mu ngingo
zigaragaza igishya kimwe cyangwa
byinshi muri ubwo buvumbuzi.
(2) Inyandiko igaragaza igishya ku
buvumbuzi igomba kuba ihinnye
kandi yumvikana. Iyo nyandiko ishingira
gusa ku bisobanuro by’
ubuvumbuzi.
(3) Inyandiko igaragaza igishya, ibisobanuro
n’ibishushanyo bishobora kwifashishwa
mu kumva neza inyandiko igaragaza
igishya ku buvumbuzi.

articles.heading: Incamake y’ubuvumbuzi (1) Incamake ni inyandiko igaragaza mu buryo buhinnye ubuvumbuzi, ikoreshwa gusa mu
articles.text:
byerekeranye n’amakuru yo mu rwego rwa
tekiniki.
(2) Icyakora, ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha
ntibushingira ku ncamake y’ubuvumbuzi
iyo busuzuma aho uburenganzira bwo
kurengerwa bugarukira.

articles.heading: Ihuzwa ry’ubuvumbuzi (1) Ubusabe bw’iyandikwa bukorwa ku buvumbuzi bumwe cyangwa ku itsinda
articles.text:
ry’ubuvumbuzi bifitanye isano buhuzwa
iyo bugize igitekerezo kimwe
cy’ubuvumbuzi muri rusange.
(2) Icyakora, kuba ubuvumbuzi buhujwe
ntibishingirwaho mu gutambamira,
gutesha agaciro impamyabuvumbuzi
cyangwa kuba iyo mpamyabuvumbuzi
ikubiyemo ubuvumbuzi burenze bumwe
cyangwa itsinda ry’ubuvumbuzi
budafitanye isano ku buryo biba bigize
igitekerezo kimwe cy’ubuvumbuzi.

articles.heading: Gusaba impanyabuvumbuzi mu byiciro (1) Usaba impamyabuvumbuzi ashobora kugabanya ubusabe bwe mu byiciro igihe
articles.text:
cyose ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha
butaremeza ko ubusabe bwujuje ibisabwa
kugira ngo hatangwe impamyabuvumbuzi.
(2) Icyakora, buri cyiciro cy’ubusabe
ntikigomba kugira icyo gitangaza kirenze
icyari cyatangajwe mu busabe bwabanje.
(3) Buri cyiciro cy’ubusabe gihabwa itariki
y’ubusabe, kandi iyo bibaye ngombwa,
itariki yo gutanga abandi ni iy’ubusabe
bwabanje.

articles.heading: Ubusabe bushingiye ku nyandiko nsobanurabuvumbuzi y’agateganyo (1) Ubusabe bw’impamyabuvumbuzi
articles.text:
bushobora gutangwa hashingiwe ku
nyandiko nsobanurabuvumbuzi
y’agateganyo.
(2) Iyo hatanzwe ubusabe
bw’impamyabuvumbuzi bushingiye ku
inyandiko nsobanurabuvumbuzi
y’agateganyo, inyandiko
nsobanurabuvumbuzi yuzuye igomba
gutangwa mu gihe kitarenze amezi 12
abarwa uhereye ku itariki y’ubusabe bwa
mbere.
(3) Iyo inyandiko nsobanurabuvumbuzi
yuzuye yatanzwe mu gihe cy’amezi 12
avugwa mu gika cya (2) cy’iyi ngingo,
itariki yo gutanga abandi iba itariki
yatangiweho ubusabe bushingiye ku
nyandiko nsobanurabuvumbuzi
y’agateganyo.
(4) Iyo inyandiko nsobanurabuvumbuzi
yuzuye idatanzwe mu gihe cyagenwe
kivugwa mu gika cya (2) cy’iyi ngingo,
ubusabe bufatwa nk’aho bwaretswe kandi
bugasibwa muri rejisitiri.

articles.heading: Ubusabe bwinshi bushingiye ku nyandiko nsobanurabuvumbuzi y’agateganyo (1) Usaba impamyabuvumbuzi ashobora
articles.text:
gutanga mu izina ry’umuntu umwe
ubusabe burenze bumwe buherekejwe
n’inyandiko nsobanurabuvumbuzi
z’agateganyo.
(2) Iyo ubusabe buvugwa mu gika cya (1)
cy’iyi ngingo bwatanzwe ku buvumbuzi
bufitanye isano cyangwa bumwe muri bwo
bukaba bwarahinduwe mu bundi,
ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha bubona ko
ibyavumbuwe byose bishobora kuba
ubuvumbuzi bumwe kandi bushobora
guhabwa impamyabuvumbuzi imwe,
bushobora kwemera ko hatangwa
inyandiko nsobanurabuvumbuzi yuzuye
imwe mu gihe kitarenze amezi 12 abarwa
uhereye ku itariki y’ubusabe bwatanzwe
bushingiye ku nyandiko
nsobanurabuvumbuzi y’agateganyo
bwabanjirije ubundi.

articles.heading: Guhindura ubusabe bwuzuye mo ubusabe bw'agateganyo (1) Uwatanze dosiye yo gusaba impamyabuvumbuzi yuzuye ashobora
articles.text:
gusaba ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha
kuyihinduramo ubusabe bw’agateganyo
igihe cyose nta cyemezo kirafatwa kuri
dosiye isaba.
(2) Mu gihe ubusabe bw’impampabuvumbuzi
buherekejwe n’inyandiko
nsobanurabuvumbuzi bifatwa ko yuzuye,
ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha bubisabwe
mu gihe cy’amezi 12 abarwa uhereye ku
itariki yatangiyeho ubusabe bwa mbere
n’uwavumbuye, bushobora kwemeza ko
inyandiko nsobanurabuvumbuzi yuzuye
yafatwa nk’inyandiko
nsobanurabuvumbuzi y’agateganyo kandi
ubusabe bugakomeza.

articles.heading: Gusaba kwimura itariki y’ubusabe ugereranyije n’ubusabe bw’agateganyo Ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha bushobora,
articles.text:
bubisabwe n’usaba mbere yo gutanga
impamyabuvumbuzi, gutesha agaciro
ubusabe bushingiye ku nyandiko
nsobanurabuvumbuzi y’agateganyo
bukimurira itariki y’ubusabe ku munsi
inyandiko nsobanurabuvumbuzi yuzuye
yatangiweho, iyo ubusabe bushingiye ku
nyandiko nsobanurabuvumbuzi yuzuye
bwatanzwe bukurikira isaba
ry’impamyabuvumbuzi iherekejwe
n’inyandiko nsobanurabuvumbuzi
y’agateganyo.

articles.heading: Ibikubiye mu busabe bw’agateganyo (1) Ubusabe bw’agateganyo bukubiyemo– (a) inyandiko yabugenewe y’ubusabe
articles.text:
bw’agateganyo ishyirwaho
n’ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha
yujujwe n’usaba;
(b) ibisobanuro by’ubuvumbuzi bitarimo
inyandiko igaragaza
impamyabuvumbuzi cyangwa
imenyekanisha;
(c) igishushanyo kimwe cyangwa byinshi
bisobanura ubwo buvumbuzi, iyo ari
ngombwa;
(d) inyito y’ubuvumbuzi;
(e) n’icyemezo cy’uko hishyuwe
amafaranga y’ubusabe;
(2) Ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha igihe ari
ngombwa busaba ko hatangwa
igishushanyo ku busabe bw’agateganyo
kandi igishushanyo gitanzwe, uretse igihe
ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha
bwabigennye ukundi, gifatwa nka kimwe
mu bigize ibisobanuro n’ishakiro
hakurikijwe iri tegeko.
(3) Iyo ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha bubona
ko ubusabe bukwiye kongerwaho
icyitegererezo cyangwa indobanywa
by’ikintu cyose cyerekana ubuvumbuzi
cyangwa iyo ndobanywa n’icyitegererezo
bikenewe busaba ko bitangwa mbere
y’isuzumwa ry’ubusabe bwuzuye.

articles.heading: Ubuvumbuzi butarengerwa (1) Ibikurikira ntibikubiye mu birengerwa n’impamyabuvumbuzi n’ubwo byaba ari
articles.text:
ubuvumbuzi bushobora kurengerwa
n’impamyabuvumbuzi:
(a) ibyavumbuwe, amahange nyabumenyi
n’uburyo bukoreshwa mu mibare;
(b) ibishushanyo mbonera,
imitunganyirize cyangwa uburyo bwo
gukora imirimo y’ubucuruzi, imirimo
y’ubwenge cyangwa ijyanye
n’imikino;
(c) uburyo bwo kuvura umuntu cyangwa
inyamaswa mu buryo bwo kubaga
cyangwa gusuzuma umubiri w’umuntu
cyangwa inyamaswa; ariko hatarimo
ibyifashishwa mu gushyira mu bikorwa
bumwe muri ubwo buryo;
(d) ibintu kamere n’iyo byaba bisukuye,
byaravangitiranyijwe cyangwa
byarakomowe mu mutungo kamere,
ariko hatarimo uburyo bwo gukura
ibyo bintu kamere aho byari bisanzwe;
(e) ibintu kamere bisanzwe bizwi
byavumburiwe uburyo bushya bwo
kubibyaza umusaruro, ariko hatarimo
uburyo bushya ubwabwo iyo bugize
igihangano kandi uko kubikoresha
bikabyazwamo inonosora
ry’ubushobozi buzwi bw’ibyo bintu
kamere;
(f) ibimera n’inyamaswa, harimo ibice
byabyo, bitari utunyabuzima n’uburyo
bwo kugera ahanini ku binyabuzima
bugamije kubona ibindi bimera
cyangwa inyamaswa, butandukanye
n’uburyo butari ubwo kugera ku
binyabuzima n’utunyabuzima
n’ibyagezweho hakoreshejwe ubwo
buryo;
(g) ubuvumbuzi buhungabanya ituze
rusange rya rubanda kandi butubahiriza
imigenzo myiza iyo bibyajwe
umusaruro mu bucuruzi;
(h) ibijyanye n’imiti;
(i) igaragaza ryoroheje ry’amakuru;
(j) porogaramu za mudasobwa nyirizina
n’itsinda ry’amakuru yerekeranye na
zo.
(2) Iteka rya Minisitiri ufite ubuzima mu
nshingano rigena ibijyanye n’imiti
bivugwa mu gaka ka (h) k’iyi ngingo
bitarengerwa.
(3) Ibiteganyijwe mu gaka ka (j) k’iyi ngingo
ntibireba ubuvumbuzi bukurikira:
(a) uburyo bw’ubuvumbuzi ubufashe muri
rusange cyangwa mu bice byabwo,
bugizwe n’ibyiciro byinshi bikorwa na
mudasobwa kandi bukoreshwa na
porogaramu ya mudasobwa;
(b) ubuvumbuzi bw’icyakozwe bigizwe
n’ibice by’ubuvumbuzi bukorwa na
mudasobwa, bukubiyemo
by’umwihariko:
(i) imikoreshereze ya porogaramu ya
mudasobwa ibyazwa umusaruro
hakoreshejwe imashini ikaba ibitse
ku gikoresho gifatika, harimo disiki
cyangwa ububiko bwa
mudasobwa;
(ii) mudasobwa yakozwe hagamijwe
imirimo rusange, umwihariko
wayo ugereranyije n’urwego rwa
tekiniki iyibanziriza ukaba uva
ahanini ku ikomatanya ryayo na
porogaramu yihariye ya
mudasobwa;
(iii) porogaramu ya mudasobwa
hamwe n’ibindi byose byongeweho
nk’ibikoresho bya tekiniki
cyangwa imikorere yayo iri tekiniki
mu nganda no guhuza imiterere ya
mudasobwa ubwayo.
(4) Uwatanze ubusabe
bw’impamyabuvumbuzi zerekeye za
porogaramu za mudasobwa n’izerekeye
ubuvumbuzi bujyanye na za mudasobwa
bwavuzwe mu gika cya (3) cy’iyi ngingo,
areka uburenganzira bwe bwo gusaba
kurengerwa bujyana n’uburenganzira
bw’umuhanzi kuri ubwo buvumbuzi.
Icyiciro cya 2: Isuzuma n’itangwa
ry’impamyabuvumbuzi

articles.heading: Isuzuma ry’ubusabe bw’impamyabuvumbuzi (1) Mbere yo gusuzuma ireme ry’ubusabe bw’impamyabuvumbuzi, ubuyobozi
articles.text:
bubifitiye ububasha busuzuma ibi
bikurikira:
(a) ubuvumbuzi burebwa n’ubusabe
butavanywe mu bishobora
kurengerwa;
(b) ubusabe bwujuje ibisabwa byerekeye
imiterere n’ibigize ubusabe.
(2) Iyo ibisabwa bituzuye, ubuyobozi
bubifitiye ububasha busaba usaba
impamyabuvumbuzi kuzuza ibigomba
kuzuzwa mu minsi itarenze 14 ibarwa
uhereye ku itariki yabimenyesherejweho.
(3) Iyo usaba impamyabuvumbuzi yubahirije
ibyo asabwa kuzuza bivugwa mu gika cya
(2) cy’iyi ngingo, itariki yo kwakira
ubusabe bukosoye ni yo ifatwa nk’itariki
yo gusaba.
(4) Iyo ibigomba kuzuzwa ari ibishushanyo,
ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha bwandika
itariki bwakiriyeho ubusabe bwa mbere
nk’itariki y’ubusabe.
(5) Iyo usaba atujuje ibigomba kuzuzwa
cyangwa akabyuzuza mu gihe kirenze
icyagenwe ubusabe bufatwa nk’aho
bwaretswe.

articles.heading: Kuvugurura ubusabe bw’impamyabuvumbuzi mu gihe cy’isuzuma (1) Uwasabye ashobora kuvugurura ubusabe
articles.text:
bw’impamyabuvumbuzi, iyo ubuyobozi
bubifitiye ububasha butaremeza ko
ubusabe bwujuje cyangwa butujuje
ibisabwa kugira ngo hatangwe
impamyabuvumbuzi.
(2) Icyakora, ivugurura ry’ubusabe
bw’impamyabuvumbuzi ntiryemewe iyo
rigaragaza ibirenze ibyo yatanze
byatangajwe mu busabe igihe
bwatangwaga.

articles.heading: Gusuzuma ireme ry’ubusabe bw’impamyabuvumbuzi Mu gusuzuma ireme ry’ubusabe bw’impamyabuvumbuzi, ubuyobozi bubifitiye
articles.text:
ububasha bwita kuri ibi bikurikira:
(a) ibyavuye muri raporo
y’ubushakashatsi cyangwa mu
isuzuma ryakozwe n’ikigo
cyabizobereyemo cyo muri Repubulika
y’u Rwanda cyangwa umuryango wo
hanze y’u Rwanda ukora
ubushakashatsi cyangwa isuzuma;
(b) ibyavuye mu bushakashatsi ubwo ari
bwo bwose, raporo y’isuzuma
cyangwa icyemezo byatanzwe
hakurikijwe ingingo ya 252 y’iri
tegeko;
(c) ibyavuye muri raporo
y’ubushakashatsi mpuzamahanga no
muri raporo y’isuzuma mpuzamahanga
ry’ibanze zakozwe hakurikijwe
Amasezerano Mpuzamahanga
abigenga u Rwanda rwashyizeho
umukono mu byerekeye ubusabe
bwatangiwe muri Repubulika y’u
Rwanda.

articles.heading: Gutangaza ubusabe bw’impamyabuvumbuzi (1) Ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha butangaza ubusabe bw’impamyabuvumbuzi mu
Inkurikizi z’itangazwa ry’ubusabe bw’impamyabuvumbuzi (1) Uhereye ku itariki y’itangazwa ry’ubusabe
articles.text:
kugeza ku itangwa
ry’impamyabuvumbuzi, uwasabye agira
umwihariko n’uburenganzira nk’ubwo yari
kuba afite iyo impamyabuvumbuzi iba
yaratanzwe.
(2) Icyakora, iyo ubusabe
bw’impamyabuvumbuzi butambamiwe
bikemerwa, umwihariko n’uburenganzira
bita agaciro uhereye ku itariki y’ubusabe
bw’itambamira.

articles.heading: Gutambamira itangwa ry’impamyabuvumbuzi (1) Umuntu ubifitemo inyungu ashobora gutambamira itangwa
articles.text:
ry’impamyabuvumbuzi amaze kubona
kopi y’ibikubiye mu busabe
bw’impamyabuvumbuzi byose.
(2) Iteka rya Minisitiri rigena uburyo
gutambamira itangwa
ry’impamyabuvumbuzi bikorwa.

articles.heading: Kujuririra icyemezo cy’itambamira ry’itangwa ry’impamyabuvumbuzi (1) Umuntu ubifitemo inyungu ashobora
articles.text:
kujuririra icyemezo cy’itambamira
ry’itangwa ry’impamyabuvumbuzi mu
kanama k’ubujurire mu gihe kitarenze
amezi atatu abarwa uhereye ku itariki
yamenyesherejweho icyemezo
cy’ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha.
(2) Iteka rya Minisitiri rigena abagize
akanama k’ubujurire n’imikorere yako.

articles.heading: Gutanga cyangwa kwanga gutanga impamyabuvumbuzi (1) Iyo ubusabe bwujuje ibisabwa kugira ngo
articles.text:
ubuvumbuzi bushobore kurengerwa,
ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha bukora ibi
bikurikira:
(a) butanga impamyabuvumbuzi ku
wayisabye;
(b) bwandika impamyabuvumbuzi
muri rejisitiri
y’impamyabuvumbuzi;
(2) Ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha buha kopi
y’impamyabuvumbuzi umuntu wese
uyisabye amaze kwishyura amafaranga
yagenwe.
(3) Ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha bwanga
ubusabe iyo butujuje ibisabwa kugira ngo
ubuvumbuzi bushobore kurengerwa,
bukabimenyesha mu nyandiko uwasabye
icyemezo bwafashe mu gihe kitarenze
iminsi irindwi ibarwa uhereye ku itariki
bwafatiyeho icyemezo.

articles.heading: Itangazwa ry’impamyabuvumbuzi Mu gihe kitarenze amezi atatu abarwa uhereye ku itariki impamyabuvumbuzi yatangiweho,
articles.text:
ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha butangaza
impamyabuvumbuzi n’incamake
y’ubuvumbuzi yabwo mu Igazeti ya Leta ya
Repubulika y’u Rwanda.

articles.heading: Ivugurura ry’idosiye y’impamyabuvumbuzi (1) Ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha bubisabwe n’ufite uburenganzira ku
articles.text:
mpamyabuvumbuzi, bushobora guhindura
idosiye y’impamyabuvumbuzi cyangwa
ibishushanyo hagamijwe kugaragaza
imbibi z’ibirengerwa
n’impamyabuvumbuzi.
(2) Icyakora, ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha
ntibuvugurura idosiye
y’impamyabuvumbuzi iyo:
(a) ivugurura rizana ikintu gishya cyangwa
ikintu cy’ireme kitatangajwe mu
idosiye y’impamyabuvumbuzi mbere
y’uko hakorwa ivugurura,
byashingiweho hatangwa
impamyabuvumbuzi;
(b) idosiye isaba impamyabuvumbuzi
ivuguruye ishobora kuba ikubiyemo
igisabirwa kurengerwa kitashingiye ku
kintu cyatangajwe mu idosiye
y’impamyabuvumbuzi mbere
y’ivugurura.

articles.heading: Gutesha agaciro impamyabuvumbuzi (1) Umuntu ubifitemo inyungu ashobora gusaba urukiko rubifitiye ububasha
articles.text:
gutesha agaciro impamyabuvumbuzi iyo
agaragaje nibura imwe mu mpamvu
zikurikira:
(a) ubuvumbuzi butari bushya;
(b) ubuvumbuzi butagaragaza intambwe
y’ubuvumbuzi;
(c) ubuvumbuzi budashobora gukoreshwa
mu rwego rw’inganda;
(d) ubuvumbuzi bufitanye isano n’ikindi
kintu kibarirwa mu bidashobora
kurengerwa;
(e) uwasabye atari we muvumbuzi
cyangwa adafite uburenganzira bwo
gusaba impamyabuvumbuzi;
(f) ubuvumbuzi budasobanuwe ku buryo
bugaragara, bwuzuye kandi
bwumvikana n’ufite
impamyabuvumbuzi.
(2) Urukiko rubifitiye ububasha rushobora
gufata icyemezo cyo kwimurira
impamyabuvumbuzi k’uwasabye ko
ivanwaho aho kuyivanaho, iyo uwabisabye
agaragaje ko ari we muvumbuzi kandi mu
kirego yasabye ko bayimwandikaho.
(3) Umuntu ubifitemo inyungu cyangwa
umuntu wemejwe n’Urukiko ko ari we
muvumbuzi amenyesha ubuyobozi
bubifitiye ububasha icyemezo cya burundu
cy’urukiko cyo gutesha agaciro
impamyabuvumbuzi kugira ngo:
(a) bwandike icyemezo cy’urukiko muri
rejisitiri y’impamyabuvumbuzi;
(b) bushyire ku mpamyabuvumbuzi
ikimenyetso cy’uko yavanywe muri
rejisitiri y’impamyabuvumbuzi;
(c) butangaze imenyesha rivuga ku cyemezo
cy’urukiko mu gihe kitarenze iminsi 30
ibarwa uhereye ku itariki
bwakimenyesherejweho.

articles.heading: Inkurikizi zo gutesha agaciro impamyabuvumbuzi (1) Iyo impamvu zo gutesha agaciro impamyabuvumbuzi zemejwe zerekeye
articles.text:
igice cy’ubuvumbuzi, igisabirwa
kurengerwa cyerekeranye na bwo ni cyo
cyonyine kivanwaho.
(2) Impamyabuvumbuzi, igisabirwa
kurengerwa cyangwa igice cyacyo
byateshejwe agaciro bifatwa ko
byavanyweho uhereye ku itariki
impamyabuvumbuzi yatangiweho.
Icyiciro cya 3: Uburenganzira butangwa
n’impamyabuvumbuzi

articles.heading: Uburenganzira butangwa n’impamyabuvumbuzi (1) Impamyabuvumbuzi ihesha nyirayo uburenganzira bwihariye bwo gukoresha
articles.text:
ubuvumbuzi ku butaka bwa Repubulika
y’u Rwanda.
(2) Impamyabuvumbuzi ihesha kandi nyirayo
uburenganzira bwihariye bwo kubuza
umuntu uwo ari we wese utari nyirayo
gukoresha ubuvumbuzi burengewe
atabyemerewe na nyirabwo.
(3) Gukoresha ubuvumbuzi burengewe
bisobanura nibura kimwe mu bikorwa
bikurikira:
(a) iyo impamyabuvumbuzi yatanzwe ku
cyatunganyijwe:
(i) gutunganya, gutumiza mu
mahanga, gucuruza no gukoresha
icyatunganyijwe;
(ii) kubika icyatunganyijwe
hagamijwe kugicuruza,
kukidandaza cyangwa kukibyaza
umusaruro;
(b) iyo impamyabuvumbuzi yatanzwe ku:
(i) gukoresha uburyo bwo gukora;
(ii) gukora ibikorwa bivugwa mu gaka
ka (a) k’igika cya (3) cy’iyi ngingo
ku cyatunganyijwe gikomoka kuri
ubwo buryo bwo gukoresha.

articles.heading: Ikirego cy’indishyi ku ibangamirwa ry’uburenganzira ku buvumbuzi burengewe (1) Ufite uburenganzira ku
articles.text:
mpamyabuvumbuzi aregera indishyi mu
rukiko rubifitiye ububasha umuntu ubyaza
umusaruro ubuvumbuzi burengewe
cyangwa worohereza ikoreshwa
ry’ubuvumbuzi burengewe atabimuhereye
uburenganzira.
(2) Iyo impamyabuvumbuzi ifitweho
uburenganzira n’abantu benshi, buri wese
atabanje kubyemererwa n’abandi
bayifiteho uburenganzira, ashobora kurega
umuntu wabangamiye uburenganzira ku
mpamyabuvumbuzi abyaza umusaruro
ubuvumbuzi burengewe kandi
atabyemerewe n’abayifiteho
uburenganzira bose.

articles.heading: Impamyabuvumbuzi ihuriweho (1) Iyo abantu babiri cyangwa benshi bahuriye ku buvumbuzi, uburenganzira bwo gusaba
articles.text:
iyandikwa cyangwa icyemezo buba
bufitwe na buri wese muri bo.
(2) Iyo habuze ubwumvikane hagati yabo,
abahuriye ku mpamyabuvumbuzi
bashobora guhererekanya, buri wese ukwe,
uruhare bafite mu busabe kandi bakabuza
undi muntu uwo ariwe wese gukoresha
ubusabe, ariko bafatanyije bakaba
bashobora guha uruhushya undi muntu rwo
A
gukora kimwe mu bikorwa bivugwa muri
iri tegeko.

articles.heading: Kwandikwa nk’umuvumbuzi (1) Umuvumbuzi yandikwa ko ari umuvumbuzi ku mpamyabuvumbuzi
articles.text:
keretse iyo agaragarije ubuyobozi
bubifitiye ububasha ko adashaka
kwandikwa nk’umuvumbuzi ku
mpamyabuvumbuzi huzuzwa inyandiko
yabugenewe.
(2) Kuba umuvumbuzi yarijeje cyangwa
yaremereye undi muntu ko adashaka ko
izina rye ryandikwa ku
mpamyabuvumbuzi, nta gaciro bigira.

articles.heading: Aho uburenganzira ku mpamyabuvumbuzi bugarukira (1) Uburenganzira butangwa n’impamyabuvumbuzi ntibureba
articles.text:
(a) gukoresha ubuvumbuzi burengewe ku
mashini, ubwato, ibinyabiziga
n’ibyogajuru by’amahanga byinjira
by’igihe gito cyangwa bitunguranye mu
kirere, mu mazi cyangwa ku butaka bwa
Repubulika y’u Rwanda;
(b) ibikorwa bifitanye isano n’ubuvumbuzi
burengewe bwakozwe hagamijwe
ubushakashatsi mu bumenyi
n’ikoranabuhanga bikoreshwa na
rubanda hatagamijwe inyungu;
(c) ibikorwa byakozwe n’umuntu muri
Repubulika y’u Rwanda, nta buriganya
ku munsi wo gutanga inyandiko iyo
igisabwa ari uburenganzira bwo gutanga
abandi, ku munsi wo gusaba
uburenganzira bwo gutanga abandi
hashingiwe ku burenganzira bwo
gutanga abandi bwatanzwe, wabyazaga
umusaruro ubuvumbuzi cyangwa
witeguraga kuwubyaza umusaruro ku
buryo bugaragara kandi akomeje, iyo
ibyo bikorwa bidatandukanye
n’imikoreshereze ya mbere cyangwa
iteganywa gukorwa, mu miterere
cyangwa mu mumaro;
(d) ibikorwa bikozwe mu buryo
bwiherereye kandi ku rwego rutari
ubw’ubucuruzi cyangwa ku mpamvu
zitari iz’ubucuruzi, iyo ibyo bikorwa
bitabangamira ku buryo bugaragara
inyungu z’ubukungu z’ufite
uburenganzira ku mpamyabuvumbuzi;
(e) itegura ritunguranye ry’imiti mu nzu
icuruza imiti hakurikijwe imiti
yanditswe na muganga cyangwa
ibikorwa birebana n’umuti uri
gutegurwa;
(f) Ibyatunganyijwe byashyizwe ku isoko
muri Repubulika y’u Rwanda cyangwa
hanze yarwo n’ufite uburenganzira ku
mpamyabuvumbuzi cyangwa n’uwo
yabihereye uruhushya.
(2) Uburenganzira bw’uwabyaje umusaruro
impamyabuvumbuzi mbere uvugwa mu
gaka ka (c) k’igika cya (1) cy’iyi ngingo,
bushobora kwegurirwa cyangwa guhabwa
ikigo, isosiyete cyangwa igice cy’ikigo
cyangwa igice cy’isosiyete bwabyajwemo
umusaruro cyangwa yateguriwemo.
(3) Icyakora, nta gikorwa cyo kunyuranya
n’impamyabuvumbuzi kiba kibayeho iyo
gukora, gukoresha, gucuruza, kudandaza
cyangwa kwinjiza muri Repubulika y’u
Rwanda igihangano cy’ubuvumbuzi
cyahawe impamyabuvumbuzi gusa mu
mikoreshereze ifitanye isano n’iterambere
no gutanga amakuru akenewe hakurikijwe
amategeko yo mu gihugu cyangwa yo mu
mahanga agenga ikorwa, iyubakwa,
kubyazwa umusaruro cyangwa icuruzwa
ry’icyatunganyijwe.

articles.heading: Igihe uburenganzira ku mpamyabuvumbuzi bumara burengewe (1) Uburenganzira ku mpamyabuvumbuzi
articles.text:
bumara imyaka 20 ibarwa uhereye ku
itariki ubusabe bw’impamyabuvumbuzi
bwatangiweho.
(2) Kugira ngo impamyabuvumbuzi ikomeze
kugira agaciro, uwahawe
impamyabuvumbuzi yishyura amafaranga
ndemyagaciro y’impamyabuvumbuzi buri
mwaka uhereye ku itariki ubusabe
bw’impamyabuvumbuzi bwatangiweho.
(3) Itariki yo kwishyura amafaranga buri
mwaka ni imwe n’itariki ubusabe
bwatangiweho.
(4) Icyakora, hatangwa igihe cy’imbabazi
kingana n’amezi atandatu cyo kwishyura
amafaranga ndemyagaciro
y’impamyabuvumbuzi nyuma y’itariki
ntarengwa yo kwishyuriraho. Ubwishyu
bukozwe mu gihe cy’imbabazi
bwiyongeraho amafaranga y’inyongera
yagenwe.
(5) Iyo amafaranga ndemyagaciro
y’impamyabuvumbuzi atishyuwe,
impamyabuvumbuzi itakaza agaciro.
Icyiciro cya 4: Kwegurira undi muntu
impamyabuvumbuzi

articles.heading: Uburyo bwo kwegurira undi muntu impamyabuvumbuzi (1) Ubusabe bw’impamyabuvumbuzi itaratangwa cyangwa impamyabuvumbuzi
articles.text:
bishobora kwegurirwa undi muntu,
binyuze mu masezerano yanditse yo
kwegurira undi muntu
impamyabuvumbuzi, ashyirwaho
umukono n’impande zombi.
(2) Iyo impamyabuvumbuzi ifitweho
uburenganzira n’abantu benshi, buri wese
mu bayifiteho uburenganzira ashobora
kwegurira undi muntu umugabane afite
kuri iyo mpamyabuvumbuzi.
(3) Uweguriwe impamyabuvumbuzi amaze
kwishyura amafaranga yagenwe,
ashyikiriza ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha
amasezerano yo kwegurira undi muntu
impamyabuvumbuzi ariho umukono
w’impande zombi, kugira ngo bwandike
impinduka ku burenganzira ku
mpamyabuvumbuzi muri rejisitiri
y’impamyabuvumbuzi bunatangaze
ibiyikubiyemo.
(4) Kwegurira undi muntu
impamyabuvumbuzi bitangira kugira
agaciro no gukurikizwa iyo iyegurirwa
ryanditswe muri rejisitiri
y’impamyabuvumbuzi.

articles.heading: Kwanga kwandika amasezerano yo kwegurira undi muntu impamyabuvumbuzi (1) Ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha
articles.text:
ntibwandika amasezerano yerekeye
kwegurira undi muntu
impamyabuvumbuzi iyo bubona ko
ingingo imwe cyangwa nyinshi mu zigize
ayo masezerano cyangwa amasezerano
yose uko yakabaye, agambiriye, afite
inkurikizi cyangwa ashobora kugira
inkurikizi zikurikira:
(a) kubangamira ihiganwa;
(b) kubangamira ubucuruzi;
(c) gukoresha nabi ubwinganze ku isoko
bushingiye ku mpamyabuvumbuzi;
(d) cyangwa kubangamira mu buryo
budakwiye isakazwa
ry’ikoranabuhanga.
(2) Mbere yo gufata icyemezo, ubuyobozi
bubifitiye ububasha bushobora kumva
imyanzuro itangwa n’impande zagiranye
amasezerano, bushobora kandi kugisha
inama urwego rushinzwe igenzura
ry’ihiganwa.
(3) Icyemezo cyo kwanga kwandika
amasezerano yo kwegurira undi muntu
impamyabuvumbuzi gishobora kujuririrwa
mu kanama k’ubujurire mu gihe kitarenze
iminsi 30 ibarwa uhereye ku itariki
icyemezo cyamenyesherejweho
abagiranye amasezerano.
(4) Ibiteganyijwe mu masezerano bibangamira
cyangwa bibuza uweguriwe
impamyabuvumbuzi bidafitanye isano
n’igisabwa muri iri tegeko kandi nta
mpamvu za ngombwa kugira ngo harindwe
uburenganzira ku mpamyabuvumbuzi
bifatwa nk’ibifite inkurikizi ibangamira
ihiganwa mu bucuruzi.

articles.heading: Uruhushya rushingiye ku masezerano y’impamyabuvumbuzi (1) Ufite uburenganzira ku mpamyabuvumbuzi, ashobora guha, undi
articles.text:
muntu binyuze mu masezerano yanditse
yashyizweho umukono n’impande zombi,
uruhushya rw’umwihariko kuri byose,
urw’umwihariko kuri bimwe cyangwa
ntirube urw’umwihariko rwemerera uwo
muntu kugira uruhare nibura muri kimwe
mu bikorwa bigize gukoresha ubuvumbuzi
bwahawe impamyabuvumbuzi.
(2) Uwahawe uruhushya
rw’impamyabumbuzi, amaze kwishyura
amafaranga yagenwe, ashyikiriza kopi
y’amasezerano yo gutanga uruhushya
ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha kugira ngo
bwandike impamvu y’ayo masezerano
yerekeye uruhushya muri rejisitiri
y’impamyabuvumbuzi bunayibike mu
ibanga.
(3) Uruhushya rw’impamyabuvumbuzi
rutangira kugira agaciro no gukurikizwa
iyo rwanditswe muri rejisitiri
y’impamyabuvumbuzi.

articles.heading: Ivanwaho ry’uruhushya rushingiye ku masezerano y’impamyabuvumbuzi Uruhushya rushingiye ku masezerano
articles.text:
y’impamyabuvumbuzi ruvanwaho
n’ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha iyo:
(a) amasezerano yo gutanga uruhushya
aseshwe n’uruhande rumwe cyangwa
n’impande zombi;
(b) uruhushya ruteshejwe agaciro
n’urukiko.

articles.heading: Kwanga kwandika amasezerano yo gutanga uruhushya rwo gukoresha impamyabuvumbuzi (1) Ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha bwanga
articles.text:
kwandika amasezerano yo gutanga
uruhushya rwo gukoresha
impamyabuvumbuzi iyo busanze ingingo
imwe cyangwa nyinshi zigize amasezerano
cyangwa amasezerano yose uko yakabaye
zatera inkurikizi zibangamira ihiganwa.
(2) Mbere yo gufata icyemezo, ubuyobozi
bubifitiye ububasha bushobora kumva
imyanzuro itangwa n’impande zagiranye
amasezerano, bushobora kandi kugisha
inama urwego rushinzwe igenzura
ry’ihiganwa.
(3) Icyemezo cyo kwanga kwandika
amasezerano yo gutanga uruhushya rwo
gukoresha impamyabuvumbuzi gishobora
kujuririrwa mu kanama k’ubujurire mu
gihe kitarenze iminsi 30 ibarwa uhereye ku
itariki icyemezo cyamenyesherejweho
impande zombi.
(4) Ibiteganyijwe mu masezerano bibangamira
cyangwa bibuza uwahawe uruhushya
rw’impamyabuvumbuzi bidafitanye isano
n’ibisabwa muri iri tegeko kandi nta
mpamvu za ngombwa kugira ngo harindwe
uburenganzira ku mpamyabuvumbuzi
bifatwa ko bifite inkurikizi yo
kubangamira ihiganwa.

articles.heading: Ingingo z’amasezerano yo gutanga uruhushya rwo gukoresha impamyabuvumbuzi zifatwa nk’izishobora
articles.text:
kubangamira ihiganwa
(1) Ingingo z’amasezerano yo gutanga
uruhushya rwo gukoresha
impamyabuvumbuzi zikurikira zifatwa
nk’izibangamiye ihiganwa kugeza igihe
zishobora kuvuguruzwa :
(a) ingingo itegeka uwahawe uruhushya
rw’impamyabuvumbuzi kurusubiza
uwarumuhaye ku birebana
n’impamyabuvumbuzi yatanzwe nyuma
ariko ishingiye cyangwa inonosora
impamyabuvumbuzi yahaweho uruhushya
rw’umwimerere;
(b) ingingo ibuza uwahawe uruhushya
gutambamira, gusaba iyamburwa cyangwa
ivanwaho ry’itangwa
ry’impamyabuvumbuzi;
(c) ingingo ihatira uwahawe uruhushya
rw’impamyabuvumbuzi kubona
uruhushya ku birebana n’ubundi
burenganzira ku mutungo bwite mu
by’inganda nk’inkomyi yo gutanga
uruhushya rushingiye ku masezerano
y’impamyabuvumbuzi;
(d) ingingo iha uwahaye uruhushya
rw’impamyabuvumbuzi inshingano yo
kwishyura amafaranga adakwiye ku
mpamyabuvumbuzi itarabyazwa
umusaruro;
(e) ingingo iha uwahawe uruhushya
rw’impamyabuvumbuzi inshingano yo
kugura ibikoresho fatizo, ibyatunganyijwe
biciriritse cyangwa ibikoresho k’uwatanze
urwo ruhushya;
(f) ingingo ibuza uwahawe uruhushya
rw’impamyabuvumbuzi kohereza mu
mahanga ibyatunganyijwe byahawe
impamyabuvumbuzi cyangwa
bigaragaramo igihangano cy’ubuvumbuzi
cyahawe impamyabuvumbuzi cyangwa
ibuza kubyohereza mu mahanga
hatishyuwe amafaranga adakwiye
k’uwatanze urwo ruhushya;
(g) ingingo igabanya, mu buryo ubwo aribwo
bwose, amahirwe y’uwahawe uruhushya
rw’impamyabuvumbuzi yo gukoresha
impamyabuvumbuzi ku masoko yo mu
gihugu cyangwa ku yo hanze yacyo;
(h) ingingo ikubiyemo inshingano
y’inyongera, kubera imiterere yayo
cyangwa hakurikijwe imikoresherezwe mu
bucuruzi, idafite aho ihuriye n’ikigamijwe
n’ayo masezerano.
(2) Iteka rya Minisitiri rishobora kugena izindi
ngingo z’amasezerano yo gutanga
uruhushya rwo gukoresha
impamyabuvumbuzi zifatwa nk’izishobora
kubangamira ihiganwa.
Icyiciro cya 5: Uruhushya
rw’impamyabuvumbuzi rudashingiye ku
masezerano
Akiciro ka mbere: Uruhushya
rw’impamyabuvumbuzi rutangwa nta
gisabwe

articles.heading: Uburyo bwo gutanga uruhushya rw’impamyabuvumbuzi rutangwa nta gisabwe (1) Igihe cyose, nyuma yo guhabwa
articles.text:
impamyabuvumbuzi, nyirayo ashobora
gusaba, mu nyandiko, ubuyobozi
bubifitiye ububasha kwandika muri
rejisitiri y’impamyabuvumbuzi
imenyekanisha ko uruhushya
rw’impamyabuvumbuzi rutangwa nta
gisabwe ku birebana n’iyo
mpamyabuvumbuzi ruhari.
(2) Iyandikwa ry’uruhushya
rw’impamyabuvumbuzi rutangwa nta
gisabwe rihesha umuntu uburenganzira
bwo gukoresha ubuvumbuzi bwahawe
impamyabuvumbuzi hashingiwe ku
bwumvikane hagati y’ufite uburenganzira
ku mpamyabuvumbuzi n’usaba uruhushya
rw’impamyabuvumbuzi nta gisabwe kandi
bikemezwa n’ubuyobozi bubifitiye
ububasha.
(3) Iyandikwa ry’uruhushya rutangwa nta
gisabwe ntirikorwa mu gihe hari
amasezerano yerekeye uruhushya
yanditswe mbere yaho keretse uwahawe
uruhushya abyemeye.
(4) Iyandikwa ry’uruhushya
rw’impamyabuvumbuzi rutangwa nta
gisabwe, amafaranga ndemyagaciro
y’impamyabuvumbuzi yishyurwa buri
mwaka agabanukaho kimwe cya kabiri.

articles.heading: Kuvanaho uruhushya rw’impamyabuvumbuzi rutangwa nta gisabwe (1) Igihe cyose nyuma y’iyandikwa
articles.text:
ry’uruhushya rw’impamyabuvumbuzi
rutangwa nta gisabwe, ufite uburenganzira
ku mpamyabuvumbuzi ashobora gusaba
ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha kuvanaho
urwo ruhushya.
(2) Ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha bushobora
kuvanaho uruhushya
rw’impamyabuvumbuzi rwatanzwe nta
gisabwe iyo nta rundi ruhushya rwatanzwe
cyangwa iyo abaruhawe bose babyemeye.
(3) Ivanwaho ry’uruhushya
rw’impamyabuvumbuzi rwatanzwe nta
gisabwe rikorwa hamaze kwishyurwa
ikinyuranyo cy’amafaranga ndemyagaciro
y’impamyabuvumbuzi yagombaga
kwishyurwa buri mwaka iyo iyandikwa
ritakozwe.
Akiciro ka 2: Uruhushya
rw’impamyabuvumbuzi rutegetswe

articles.heading: Gusaba uruhushya rw’impamyabuvumbuzi rutegetswe (1) Amaze kwishyura amafaranga yagenwe, usaba uruhushya rw’impamyabuvumbuzi
articles.text:
rutegetswe ashyikiriza Minisitiri ubusabe
bwanditse kugira ngo abusuzume.
(2) Ubusabe bw’uruhushya
rw’impamyabuvumbuzi rutegetswe
buherekezwa n’ikimenyetso cyerekana ko
ufite uburenganzira ku mpamyabuvumbuzi
yagejejweho n’usaba urwandiko rumusaba
uruhushya rushingiye ku masezerano,
ariko ko usaba atashoboye kubona
uruhushya nk’urwo mu nzira z’ubucuruzi
ziboneye no mu gihe gikwiye.

articles.heading: Gutanga uruhushya rutegetswe rw’impamyabuvumbuzi (1) Minisitiri abisabwe n’uwifuza guhabwa uruhushya rutegetswe, amaze kumva
articles.text:
ibisobanuro by’uwahawe
impamyabuvumbuzi no kubijyaho inama
n’ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha,
ashobora guha undi muntu uruhushya rwo
gukoresha ubuvumbuzi burengewe
atabiherewe uruhushya n’ufite
uburenganzira ku buvumbuzi.
(2) Impamvu zishingirwaho mu gutanga
uruhushya rw’impamyabuvumbuzi
rutegetswe ni izi zikurikira:
(a) kuba ubuvumbuzi burengewe butarimo
gukoreshwa mu rwego rw’inganda
cyangwa urw’ubucuruzi muri Repubulika
y’u Rwanda;
(b) kuba ubuvumbuzi burengewe burimo
gukoreshwa muri Repubulika y’u Rwanda
mu buryo budahagije mu rwego
rw’inganda cyangwa urw’ubucuruzi
kubera ko ubuvumbuzi burengewe
cyangwa icyatunganyijwe kigaragaramo
ubuvumbuzi butaboneka mu gukora
cyangwa kugitumiza mu mahanga:
(i) ku ngano ihagije ishobora guhaza isoko
ryo mu gihugu;
(ii) mu bwiza buboneye bujyanye
n’igikenewe;
(iii) ku giciro gikwiye;
(c) kuba ufite uburenganzira ku
mpamyabuvumbuzi arimo gukoresha
uburenganzira yihariye ubuvumbuzi
burengewe cyangwa arimo kwirengagiza
gufata ingamba zo kubuza uwahawe
uruhushya rw’impamyabuvumbuzi
gukoresha uburenganzira yaherewe
uruhushya ku buvumbuzi burengewe mu
buryo bufite icyo bugamije, inkurikizi
cyangwa bushobora kugira inkurikizi
zikurikira:
(i) kubangamira ihiganwa;
(ii) kubangamira ubucuruzi;
(iii) gukoresha nabi umwanya
w’ubushobozi isoko rifite cyangwa
ubwiganze rikesha
impamyabuvumbuzi;
(iv) cyangwa kubangamira mu buryo
budakwiye isakazwa
ry’ikoranabuhanga;
(d) kuba ubuvumbuzi buvugwa ko buri mu
mpamyabuvumbuzi yatanzwe nyuma
budashobora gukoreshwa muri Repubulika
y’u Rwanda butanyuranyije
n’impamyabuvumbuzi yari yatanzwe
mbere.
(3) Usaba guhabwa uruhushya rutegetswe
agomba kugaragaza ko yasabye ufite
uburenganzira ku mpamyabuvumbuzi
uruhushya rwo gukoresha ubuvumbuzi
burengewe ntaruhabwe.

articles.heading: Ibisabwa mu gusaba uruhushya rw’impamyabuvumbuzi rutegetswe kubera kudakoreshwa cyangwa gukoreshwa ku buryo budahagije
articles.text:
(1) Ibisabwa mu gusaba uruhushya
rw’impamyabuvumbuzi rutegetswe kubera
kutabyazwa cyangwa kubyazwa
umusaruro ku buryo budahagije
impamyabuvumbuzi ni ibi bikurikira:
(a) kuba hashize imyaka ine
ibarwa uhereye ku itariki inyandiko
isaba impamyabuvumbuzi
yatangiweho cyangwa nyuma y’igihe
cy’imyaka itatu ibarwa uhereye ku
itariki impamyabuvumbuzi
yatangiweho;
(b) n’ubushobozi bwo gukoresha mu
rwego rw’ubucuruzi cyangwa
urw’inganda ubuvumbuzi burengewe
ugahaza isoko ryo mu gihugu.
(2) Minisitiri abyibwirije, abisabwe
n’ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha cyangwa
umuntu ubifitemo inyungu ashobora
gutangaza irangira ry’uburenganzira ku
mpamyabuvumbuzi, iyo itangwa
ry’uruhushya rutegetswe rutari kuba
ruhagije mu rwego rwo kwirinda kubyaza
uruhushya umusaruro udahagije.
(3) Ubusabe bwo kwambura cyangwa gutesha
agaciro uruhushya rutegetswe ntibutangwa
mbere y’irangira ry’imyaka ibiri ibarwa
uhereye ku itariki uruhushya rwa mbere
rutegetswe rwatangiweho.

articles.heading: Ibishingirwaho mu gutanga uruhushya rw’impamyabuvumbuzi rutegetswe mu gihe impamyabuvumbuzi ari
articles.text:
magirirane
Minisitiri ashobora gutanga uruhushya
rw’impamyabuvumbuzi rutegetswe mu gihe
impamyabuvumbuzi ari magirirane iyo:
(a) ubuvumbuzi bwabayeho nyuma
bufitwe n’usaba budashobora
kubyazwa umusaruro hatifashishijwe
ubuvumbuzi bwabubanjirije bufitwe
n’undi muntu;
(b) n’ubuvumbuzi bwabayeho nyuma
bugaragaza iterambere rifatika muri
tekiniki kandi bukaba bufite inyungu
nyinshi mu bukungu ugereranyije
n’ubuvumbuzi buvugwa mu
mpamyabuvumbuzi yatanzwe mbere.

articles.heading: Ibyubahirizwa mu gukoresha uruhushya rw’impamyabuvumbuzi rutegetswe mu gihe impamyabuvumbuzi ari magirirane
articles.text:
Uruhushya rw’impamyabuvumbuzi
rutegetswe mu gihe impamyabuvumbuzi ari
magirirane rukoreshwa iyo ibi bikurikira
byubahirijwe:
(a) kuba ufite uburenganzira ku
mpamyabuvumbuzi bwabayeho mbere
afite uburenganzira ku ruhushya
hakurikijwe ibisabwa byumvikana mu
gukoresha ubuvumbuzi bwabayeho
nyuma;
(b) kuba gukoresha impamyabuvumbuzi
yabayeho mbere hakurikijwe
uruhushya rutegetswe ishobora
gukoreshwa gusa iherekejwe
n’uruhushya rw’impamyabuvumbuzi
yatanzwe nyuma.

articles.heading: Ibikubiye mu ruhushya rw’impamyabuvumbuzi rutegetswe (1) Uruhushya rw’impamyabuvumbuzi rutegetswe rugaragaza ibi bikurikira
articles.text:
(a) imbibi z’aho rukurikizwa n’icyo
rugiye gukoreshwa ;
(b) igihe rumara ;
(c) igihe uwaruhawe atangirira gukoresha
ubuvumbuzi burengewe;
(d) ingano y’igihembo gihabwa ufite
uburenganzira ku mpamyabuvumbuzi
n’ibisabwa kugira ngo agihabwe.
(2) Uruhushya rw’impamyabuvumbuzi
rutegetswe rukoreshwa gusa mu mbibi za
Repubulika y’u Rwanda kandi
ntirushobora kwiharirwa.

articles.heading: Kuregera urukiko ku cyemezo gitanga uruhushya rw’impamyabuvumbuzi rutegetswe Icyemezo gitanga uruhushya
articles.text:
rw’impamyabuvumbuzi rutegetswe cyangwa
ibindi byose bisabwa bijyanye n’urwo
ruhushya bishobora kuregerwa mu rukiko
rubifitiye ububasha n’umuntu ubifitemo
inyungu.
Akiciro ka 3: Uruhushya
rw’impamyabuvumbuzi rutegetswe
rutangwa nta mpaka

articles.heading: Ibishingirwaho mu gutanga uruhushya rw’impamyabuvumbuzi rutegetswe rutangwa nta mpaka Minisitiri ashobora gufata icyemezo cyo guha
articles.text:
urwego rwa Leta cyangwa umuntu wagenwe,
uruhushya rwo gukoresha ubuvumbuzi
burengewe, bidasabye ko ufite uburenganzira
ku mpamyabuvumbuzi abyemera ariko ahawe
ingurane hashingiwe ku gaciro k’ubuvumbuzi
burengerwa, icyo gihe kubera impamvu
zikurikira:
(a) inyungu rusange, by’umwihariko :
(i) umutekano w’igihugu ;
(ii) ubuzima rusange;
(iii) kubungabunga ibidukikije.
(b) icyemezo cy’urukiko cyangwa
icy’ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha
gihamya ko ufite uburenganzira ku
buvumbuzi cyangwa uwo yahaye
uruhushya rw’impamyabuvumbuzi abyaza
umusaruro ubuvumbuzi burengewe mu
buryo bw’ihiganwa ritemewe
n’amategeko.

articles.heading: Itangwa ry’uruhushya rw’impamyabuvumbuzi rutegetswe rutangwa nta mpaka (1) Mbere yo gutanga uruhushya
articles.text:
rw’impamyabuvumbuzi rutegetswe
rutangwa nta mpaka, Minisitiri agirana
imishyikirano n’ufite uburenganzira ku
mpamyabuvumbuzi ku ruhushya
rushingiye ku masezerano
y’impamyabuvumbuzi mu nzira
z’ubucuruzi ziboneye no mu gihe gikwiye.
(2) Iteka rya Minisitiri rigena uburyo n’igihe
uruhushya rw’impamyabuvumbuzi
rutegetswe rutangwa nta mpaka
rutangwamo.
(3) Gukoresha ubuvumbuzi ntibirenga icyo
uruhushya rw’impamyabuvumbuzi
rutegetswe rutangwa nta mpaka
rwatangiwe n’ubwiganze mu kugemura
ibyatunganyijwe ku isoko ryo mu Rwanda.

articles.heading: Gutangaza icyemezo cyo gutanga uruhushya rw’impamyabuvumbuzi rutegetswe rutangwa nta mpaka
articles.text:
Icyemezo cyo gutanga uruhushya
rw’impamyabuvumbuzi rutegetswe rutangwa
nta mpaka gitangazwa mu Igazeti ya Leta ya
Repubulika y’u Rwanda mu gihe kitarenze
iminsi 15 y’akazi ibarwa uhereye ku itariki
icyemezo cyafatiweho.

articles.heading: Guhindura cyangwa kuvanaho uruhushya rutegetswe rutangwa nta mpaka (1) Bisabwe n’urwego rwa Leta rwahawe
articles.text:
uruhushya rutegetswe rutangwa nta mpaka
cyangwa undi muntu wemerewe gukoresha
ubuvumbuzi burengewe, Minisitiri
ashobora, nyuma yo kumva impande
zibifitemo inyungu, guhindura ibikubiye
mu ruhushya rutegetswe rutangwa nta
mpaka.
(2) Minisitiri avanaho uruhushya rutegetswe
rutangwa nta mpaka nyuma yo kumva
impande zibifitemo inyungu iyo asanze:
(a) impamvu zatumye atanga uruhushya
rutegetswe rutangwa nta mpaka
zitakiriho kandi ko bishoboka cyane ko
zitazongera kubaho;
(b) cyangwa urwego rwa Leta cyangwa
undi muntu yahaye uburenganzira
batubahirije ibikubiye mu ruhushya
rutegetswe rutangwa nta mpaka.

articles.heading: Gukoresha uburenganzira iyo hatanzwe uruhushya rutegetswe rutangwa nta mpaka ku mpamyabuvumbuzi
articles.text:
(1) Itangwa ry’uruhushya rutegetswe
rutangwa nta mpaka ntiribuza ufite
uburenganzira ku mpamyabuvumbuzi:
(a) gukomeza gukoresha ubuvumbuzi mu
gihe ashyira mu bikorwa
uburenganzira bwe;
(b) no gutanga uruhushya.
(2) Iyo Minisitiri ahaye undi muntu uruhushya
rutegetswe rutangwa nta mpaka, urwo
ruhushya ntirushobora kwegurirwa undi,
gukodeshwa undi cyangwa
guhererekanywa keretse Minisitiri
abitangiye uruhushya.
(3) Icyemezo cya Minisitiri cyerekeye itangwa
ry’uruhushya rutegetswe rutangwa nta
mpaka gishobora kuregerwa mu rukiko
rubifitiye ububasha.
Icyiciro cya 6: Ubusabe bwo ku rwego
rw’akarere cyangwa ubwo ku rwego
mpuzamahanga

articles.heading: Ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha nk’ibiro byakira ubusabe (1) Ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha bukora
articles.text:
nk’ibiro byakira ubusabe bwo ku rwego
mpuzamahanga cyangwa bwo ku rwego
rw’akarere keretse iyo biteganyijwe
ukundi mu masezerano mpuzamahanga
cyangwa mu imenyesha.
(2) Abemerewe gutanga ubusabe ku rwego
rw’akarere cyangwa ku rwego
mpuzamahanga bateganyijwe mu ngingo
ya 250 y’iri tegeko.

articles.heading: Ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha nk’ibiro byagenwe Ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha bukora nk’ibiro byagenwe mu bijyanye n’ubusabe
articles.text:
bwo ku rwego rw’akarere cyangwa ubwo ku
rwego mpuzamahanga u Rwanda ruvugwamo
burebana no guhabwa icyemezo
cy’impamyabuvumbuzi yo ku rwego
rw’Igihugu hakurikijwe Amasezerano
y’Ubufatanye mu byerekeye
impamyabuvumbuzi n’aya Harare.

articles.heading: Iyinjizwa ry’ubusabe mu rwego rw’igihugu (1) Mu rwego rw’ubusabe bwo ku rwego mpuzamahanga u Rwanda ruvugwamo
articles.text:
nk’Igihugu cyagenwe hakurikijwe
Amasezerano y’Ubufatanye mu byerekeye
impamyabuvumbuzi, usaba ashobora
gusaba impamyabuvumbuzi mu rwego
rw’Igihugu nyuma yo:
(a) gushyikiriza ubusabe ubuyobozi
bubifitiye ububasha;
(b) kwishyura ubuyobozi bubifitiye
ububasha amafaranga yagenwe;
(c) kohereza inyandiko y’ubusabe bwo ku
rwego mpuzamahanga ihinduye mu
rurimi rusabwa, iyo ari ngombwa.
(2) Iyo usaba atubahirije ibivugwa mu gaka ka
(b) n’aka (c) tw’igika cya (1) cy’iyi
ngingo, ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha
bumusaba kubyuzuza mu gihe kitarenze
iminsi 30 ibarwa uhereye ku itariki
yatangiye dosiye, iyo usaba atabikoze muri
icyo gihe cyagenwe ubusabe bufatwa
nk’aho bwaretswe.

articles.heading: Agaciro k’ubusabe bw’impamyabuvumbuzi bwo ku rwego rw’akarere cyangwa bwo ku rwego mpuzamahanga
articles.text:
Ubusabe bw’impamyabuvumbuzi bwo ku
rwego rw’akarere cyangwa bwo ku rwego
mpuzamahanga u Rwanda ruvugwamo
nk’igihugu cyagenwe bugira agaciro kamwe
nk’ubusabe bw’impamyabuvumbuzi iyo
bigaragajwe mu busabe bwo ku rwego
rw’akarere cyangwa ubwo ku rwego
mpuzamahanga kandi impamyabuvumbuzi
yatanzwe ku rwego mpuzamahanga cyangwa
ku rwego rw’akarere igira agaciro
nk’impamyabuvumbuzi yatangiwe muri
Repubulika y’u Rwanda, keretse iyo
ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha bumenyesheje
ibiro mpuzamahanga cyangwa ibyo ku rwego
rw’akarere, ku bijyanye n’ubwo busabe ko
ibisabirwa kurengerwa biri mu bidashobora
kurengerwa muri Repubulika y’u Rwanda.

articles.heading: Isuzuma ry’ubusabe ku rwego rw’akarere cyangwa ku rwego mpuzamahanga bw’impamyabuvumbuzi u Rwanda ruvugwamo nk’igihugu cyagenwe
articles.text:
(1) Ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha
ntibutangira gusuzuma ubusabe
bw’impamyabuvumbuzi bwo ku rwego
rw’akarere cyangwa ku rwego
mpuzamahanga mbere y’irangira ry’igihe
ntarengwa cyagenewe isuzuma ry’ubusabe
bwo ku rwego mpuzamahanga
giteganyijwe mu masezerano
mpuzamahanga yerekeranye n’ubufatanye
mu byerekeye ubuvumbuzi cyangwa
amasezerano yo ku rwego rw’akarere ya
Harare.
(2) Icyakora, usaba impamyabuvumbuzi
ashobora gusaba ubuyobozi bubifitiye
ububasha ko busuzuma ubusabe
hadakurikijwe igihe giteganywa
n’amasezerano mpuzamahanga cyangwa
yo ku rwego rw’akarere hishyuwe
amafaranga yagenwe.
(3) Mu gihe ubusabe bwatanzwe mu rurimi
rutari mu ndimi zemewe mu butegetsi,
usaba atanga kopi y’ubusabe ihinduye
muri rumwe mu ndimi zemewe mu
butegetsi.
(4) Iyo usaba atubahirije ibivugwa mu gika
cya (3) cy’iyi ngingo, ubusabe bufatwa
nk’aho bwaretswe.

articles.heading: Itariki y’ubusabe mpuzamahanga bwatanzwe hakurikijwe Amasezerano y’Ubufatanye mu byerekeye Impamyabuvumbuzi
articles.text:
Itariki y’ubusabe mpuzamahanga u Rwanda
ruvugwamo nk’igihugu cyagenwe bwatanzwe
hakurikijwe Amasezerano y’Ubufatanye mu
byerekeye Impamyabuvumbuzi ifatwa
nk’itariki ubusabe bw’impamyabuvumbuzi
bwakozwe hakurikijwe iri tegeko.

articles.heading: Isubiranwa ry’uburenganzira ku busabe bwafashwe nk’ubwaretswe (1) Iyo ubusabe bw’impamyabuvumbuzi bwo
articles.text:
ku rwego mpuzamahanga cyangwa ubwo
ku rwego rw’akarere bwafashwe
nk’ubwaretswe, usaba ashobora gusaba
ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha gusubirana
uburenganzira bwe, iyo agaragaje
impamvu zumvikana.
(2) Ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha, mu
isuzumwa ry’ubusabe
bw’impamyabuvumbuzi bwo ku rwego
mpuzamahanga cyangwa ubwo ku rwego
rw’akarere ntibwanga ubusabe butabanje
kumva usaba, mu gihe kitarenze iminsi 30
ibarwa uhereye itariki ubusabe
bw’impamyabuvumbuzi bwo ku rwego
mpuzamahanga cyangwa ubwo ku rwego
rw’akarere bwafashwe nk’ubwaretswe.

articles.heading: Isubiranwa ry’uburenganzira bwo gutanga abandi ku busabe bwo ku rwego rw’akarere cyangwa ubwo ku rwego mpuzamahanga
articles.text:
(1) Uwatanze ubusabe bwo ku rwego
rw’akarere cyangwa ubwo ku rwego
mpuzamahanga watakaje uburenganzira
bwo gutanga abandi kubera ko bwarengeje
igihe giteganywa ariko icyo gihe kikaba
kitarenze amezi abiri abarwa uhereye
itariki yatakarije uburenganzira bwo
gutanga abandi ashobora gusaba
gusubizwa ubwo burenganzira.
(2) Ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha
busubizaho uburenganzira bwo gutanga
abandi ku busabe bwo ku rwego
rw’akarere cyangwa ku rwego
mpuzamahanga, iyo busanze ko kuba
ubusabe bwo ku rwego rw’akarere
cyangwa ku rwego mpuzamahanga
butaratanzwe mu gihe cyo gutanga abandi:
(a) byari bitagambiriwe;
(b) cyangwa byarabaye nubwo usaba yari
yakoze ibisabwa byose kugira ngo
bikorwe.
(3) Ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha ntibwanga
ubusabe bwo ku rwego rw’akarere
cyangwa ku rwego mpuzamahanga
butabanje kumva usaba, mu gihe kitarenze
iminsi 30 ibarwa uhereye ku itariki
yabimenyesherejweho.

articles.heading: Isuzumwa ry’ubusabe bwo ku rwego rw’akarere n’ubwo ku rwego mpuzamahanga (1) Iyo usaba yujuje ibisabwa byose,
articles.text:
ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha
busuzuma ubusabe bwo ku rwego
rw’akarere cyangwa ubwo ku rwego
mpuzamahanga hashingiwe ku
bidashobora kurengerwa kandi
rukanamenyesha ibiro byo ku rwego
rw’akarere n’ibyo ku rwego
mpuzamahanga icyemezo cyo
kwemera cyangwa kwanga ubwo
busabe.
(2) Iyo usaba yasabye ko ubusabe bwe
buhita busuzumwa hadakurikijwe
amasezerano mpuzamahanga, ubusabe
bwe busuzumwa nk’uko ubusabe
bwatangiwe mu gihugu busuzumwa.
UMUTWE WA III: KURENGERA
UBUVUMBUZI BUCIRIRITSE
Icyiciro cya mbere: Ibisabwa mu kurengera
ubuvumbuzi buciriritse

articles.heading: Ubuvumbuzi buciriritse burengerwa Ubuvumbuzi buciriritse burengerwa iyo bwujuje ibi bikurikira
Ubushya bw’ubuvumbuzi buciriritse Ibyerekeye ubushya bw’ubuvumbuzi buciriritse bikorwa mu buryo bumwe
articles.text:
nk’ubuteganyijwe mu gika cya (1) n’icya (2)

articles.heading: Igihe uburenganzira ku cyemezo cy’ubuvumbuzi buciriritse bumara burengewe (1) Uburenganzira ku cyemezo
articles.text:
cy’ubuvumbuzi buciriritse burengerwa mu
gihe cy’imyaka icumi ibarwa uhereye ku
itariki inyandiko isaba icyemezo
cy’ubuvumbuzi buciriritse yatangiweho.
(2) Nyuma y’imyaka itanu ibarwa uhereye ku
itariki ubusabe bw’icyemezo
cy’ubuvumbuzi buciriritse bwatangiweho,
ufite uburenganzira ku cyemezo
cy’ubuvumbuzi buciriritse yishyura
amafaranga kugira ngo icyemezo
cy’ubuvumbuzi buciriritse gikomeze
kugira agaciro mu myaka itanu ikurikira.
(3) Icyakora, hatangwa igihe cy’imbabazi
kingana n’amezi atandatu cyo kwishyura
amafaranga ndemyagaciro y’icyemezo
cy’ubuvumbuzi buciriritse nyuma y’itariki
ntarengwa yo kwishyuriraho. Ubwishyu
bukozwe mu gihe cy’imbabazi
bwiyongeraho amafaranga y’inyongera
yagenwe.
(4) Iyo amafaranga ndemyagaciro y’icyemezo
cy’ubuvumbuzi buciriritse atishyuwe,
icyemezo gitakaza agaciro.
Icyiciro cya 4: Kwegurira undi muntu
icyemezo cy’ubuvumbuzi buciriritse

articles.heading: Kwegurira undi muntu icyemezo cy’ubuvumbuzi buciriritse Ibyerekeye uburyo bwo kwegurira undi muntu
articles.text:
icyemezo cy’ubuvumbuzi buciriritse, kwanga
kwandika amasezerano yo kwegurira undi
muntu icyemezo cy’ubuvumbuzi buciriritse,
uruhushya rushingiye ku masezerano
y’icyemezo cy’ubuvumbuzi buciriritse,
ivanwaho ry’uruhushya rushingiye ku
masezerano y’icyemezo cy’ubuvumbuzi
buciriritse, kwanga kwandika uruhushya
rushingiye ku masezerano y’icyemezo
cy’ubuvumbuzi buciriritse n’ingingo
z’amasezerano yo gutanga uruhushya rwo
gukoresha icyemezo cy’ubuvumbuzi
buciriritse zifatwa nk’izishobora kubangamira
ihiganwa bikorwa mu buryo bumwe
nk’ubuteganyijwe mu ngingo ya 42, iya 43, iya
44, iya 45, iya 46 n’iya 47 z’iri tegeko nk’uko
bikurikirana.

cy’ubuvumbuzi buciriritse rudashingiye ku

articles.heading: Uruhushya rw’icyemezo cy’ubuvumbuzi buciriritse rudashingiye ku masezerano Ibyerekeye uburyo bwo gutanga uruhushya
articles.text:
rw’icyemezo cy’ubuvumbuzi buciriritse
rutangwa nta gisabwe, kuvanaho uruhushya
rw’icyemezo cy’ubuvumbuzi buciriritse
rutangwa nta gisabwe, gusaba uruhushya
rw’icyemezo cy’ubuvumbuzi buciriritse
rutegetswe, gutanga uruhushya rw’icyemezo
cy’ubuvumbuzi buciriritse rutegetswe,
ibisabwa mu gusaba uruhushya rw’icyemezo
cy’ubuvumbuzi buciriritse rutegetswe kubera
kutabyazwa umusaruro cyangwa kubyazwa
umusaruro ku buryo budahagije, ibikubiye mu
ruhushya rw’icyemezo cy’ubuvumbuzi
buciriritse rutegetswe no kuregera urukiko ku
cyemezo gitanga uruhushya rw’icyemezo
cy’ubuvumbuzi buciriritse rutegetswe bikorwa
mu buryo bumwe nk’ubuteganyijwe mu
ngingo ya 48, iya 49, iya 50, iya 51, iya 52, iya
55 n’iya 56 z’iri tegeko nk’uko bikurikirana.
UMUTWE WA IV: KURENGERA
IGISHUSHANYO N’ICYITEGEREREZO
BIKORESHWA MU NGANDA
Icyiciro cya mbere: Ibisabwa mu kurengera
igishushanyo n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa
mu nganda

articles.heading: Igishushanyo n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa mu nganda bishobora kwandikishwa (1) Igishushanyo n’icyitegererezo bihurije
articles.text:
hamwe imirongo, amabara cyangwa isura
y’icyatunganyijwe mu rwego rw’inganda
cyangwa urw’ubukorikori bifatwa
nk’icyitegererezo mu gukora igikomoka
mu ruganda cyangwa mu bukorikori
gishobora kuba mu bigize igishushanyo
n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa mu nganda.
(2) Igishushanyo n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa
mu nganda bishobora kwandikishwa iyo
ari bishya.
(3) Kwandikisha igishushanyo
n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa mu nganda
ntibireba ibice bigize igishushanyo
n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa mu nganda
byakoreshejwe gusa kugira ngo haboneke
icyo cyabyajwe mu rwego rwa tekiniki.

articles.heading: Inyandiko igaragaza igishya usaba icyemezo asaba kwitirirwa n’incamake y’igishushanyo n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa mu nganda
articles.text:
Ibyerekeye inyandiko igaragaza igishya usaba
icyemezo asaba kwitirirwa n’incamake
by’igishushanyo n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa
mu nganda bikorwa mu buryo bumwe
nk’ubuteganyijwe mu ngingo ya 14 n’iya 15
z’iri tegeko nk’uko bikurikirana.

articles.heading: Igishushanyo n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa mu nganda bidashobora kwandikishwa Igishushanyo n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa mu
articles.text:
nganda bihungabanya ituze rusange rya
rubanda cyangwa bitubahiriza imigenzo myiza
ntibishobora kwandikishwa.

articles.heading: Ubushya bw’igishushanyo n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa mu nganda (1) Igishushanyo n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa
articles.text:
mu nganda biba ari bishya iyo nta bindi
byakibanjirije ukurikije aho tekiniki igeze.
(2) Mu gusuzuma aho tekiniki igeze hitabwa
ku imenyekanisha ryakorewe aho ari ho
hose ku isi, binyujijwe mu nyandiko
ifatika, mu mvugo, mu ikoreshwa
ry’icyahanzwe cyangwa mu bundi buryo
ubwo ari bwo bwose, ariko bikaba mbere
y’itariki yo gusaba kwandikisha
igishushanyo n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa
mu nganda cyangwa mbere y’itariki
igaragaza ko usaba ari we watanze abandi
guhanga icyo gishushanyo
n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa mu nganda,
aho biri ngombwa.
(3) Icyakora, imenyekanisha ry’igishushanyo
n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa mu nganda
ntiryitabwaho mu kugena ubushya
bw’igishushanyo n’icyitegererezo
bikoreshwa mu nganda iyo:
(a) rikozwe mu gihe cy’amezi atandatu
abanziriza umunsi w’ubusabe bwo
kwandikisha igishushanyo
n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa mu
nganda cyangwa rikozwe mbere
y’itariki y’ubusabe bwo gutanga
abandi guhanga icyo gishushanyo, aho
biri ngombwa;
(b) riturutse ku buryo butaziguye cyangwa
buziguye ku bikorwa byakozwe
n’uwasabye icyemezo cyo
kwandikisha igishushanyo
n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa mu
nganda;
(c) riturutse ku buhemu bwakozwe n’undi
muntu abukoreye uwasabye icyemezo
cyo kwandikisha igishushanyo
n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa mu
nganda cyangwa uwari ugifiteho
uburenganzira.
Icyiciro cya 2: Ubusabe bwo kwandikisha
igishushanyo n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa
mu nganda

articles.heading: Gutanga inyandiko isaba kwandikisha igishushanyo n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa mu nganda (1) Inyandiko isaba kwandikisha igishushanyo
articles.text:
n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa mu nganda
ishyikirizwa ubuyobozi bubifitiye
ububasha.
(2) Ubusabe bwo kwandikisha igishushanyo
n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa mu nganda
bukorwa huzuzwa inyandiko yabugenewe
ishyirwaho n’ubuyobozi bubifitiye
ububasha.
(3) Inyandiko y’ubusabe bwo kwandikisha
igishushanyo n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa
mu nganda ishobora kuba ikubiyemo
ibishushanyo bikoreshwa mu nganda
bitarenga 100, iyo ibyatunganyijwe
birebwa n’ibyo bishushanyo biri mu
itondeka mpuzamahanga rimwe
n’icyatunganyijwe ku bireba ibishushanyo
bikoreshwa mu nganda.
(4) Ubusabe bwo kwandikisha igishushanyo
n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa mu nganda
bushobora kuba buherekejwe
n’icyitegererezo cy’ikintu kigaragaramo
igishushanyo n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa
mu nganda iyo ubusabe bwerekeye
igishushanyo n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa
mu nganda cyo mu byerekezo bibiri.
(5) Idosiye y’ubusabe bwo kwandikisha
igishushanyo n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa
mu nganda yishyurirwa amafaranga
yagenwe hatitawe ku mubare
w’ibishushanyo bikoreshwa mu nganda
biyikubiyemo.
(6) Ubusabe bwo kwandikisha igishushanyo
n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa mu nganda
bushobora kuba burimo ubusabe bw’uko
bimaze kwandikishwa, itangazwa
ry’ibishushanyo bikoreshwa mu nganda
riba rihagaritswe mu gihe cy’amezi 12
abarwa uhereye ku itariki ubusabe
bwatangiweho cyangwa, iyo hasabwe
uburenganzira bwo gutanga abandi,
uhereye ku itariki bwasabiweho.

articles.heading: Kugena itariki y’ubusabe bwo kwandikisha igishushanyo n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa mu nganda
articles.text:
(1) Ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha bugena
itariki bwakiriyeho ubusabe nk'itariki
ubusabe bwatanzwe hakurikijwe ibikubiye
mu ngingo ya 109 y’iri tegeko.
(2) Icyakora, iyo ibisabwa bituzuye,
ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha
bumenyesha usaba kuzuza ibibura mu gihe
kitarenze iminsi 14 ibarwa uhereye ku
itariki yabimenyesherejweho.
(3) Iyo usaba yubahirije ibyo asabwa gukora,
itariki ibyaburaga byakiriweho ni yo ifatwa
nk’itariki y’ubusabe.
(4) Iyo usaba atubahirije ibyo asabwa gukora,
ubusabe bufatwa nk’aho bwaretswe.
Icyiciro cya 3: Isuzuma n’itangazwa
ry’ubusabe bwo kwandikisha igishushanyo
n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa mu nganda

articles.heading: Isuzuma ry’ubusabe bwo kwandikisha igishushanyo n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa mu nganda Mbere yo gusuzuma ireme ry’ubusabe bwo
articles.text:
kwandikisha igishushanyo n’icyitegererezo
bikoreshwa mu nganda, ubuyobozi bubifitiye
ububasha busuzuma ko bwujuje ibisabwa
biteganywa mu ngingo ya 109 n’iya 110 z’iri
tegeko kugira ngo igishushanyo
n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa mu nganda
bishobore kwandikwa.

articles.heading: Isuzuma ry’ireme ry’ubusabe bwo kwandikisha igishushanyo n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa mu nganda
articles.text:
Mu gihe cyo gusuzuma ireme ry’ubusabe bwo
kwandikisha igishushanyo n’icyitegererezo
bikoreshwa mu nganda, ubuyobozi bubifitiye
ububasha bwita kuri ibi bikurikira:
(a) ibyavuye muri raporo
y’ubushakashatsi mpuzamahanga no
muri raporo y’isuzuma mpuzamahanga
ry’ibanze zakozwe hakurikijwe
Amasezerano ya Harare cyangwa andi
masezerano mpuzamahanga u Rwanda
rwemeje ku bireba ubusabe
bwatangiwe muri Repubulika y’u
Rwanda;
(b) ibyavuye mu bushakashatsi bwose,
isuzuma hamwe n’icyemezo icyo ari
cyo cyose byatanzwe hakurikijwe iri
tegeko;
(c) ibyavuye mu bushakashatsi ubwo ari
bwo bwose cyangwa muri raporo
y’isuzuma ryakozwe n’ikigo
cyabizobereyemo cyo muri Repubulika
y’u Rwanda cyangwa umuryango wo
hanze y’u Rwanda ukora
ubushakashatsi n’isuzuma.

articles.heading: Itangazwa ry’ubusabe bwo kwandikisha igishushanyo n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa mu nganda (1) Ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha butangaza
articles.text:
ubusabe bwo kwandikisha igishushanyo
n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa mu nganda
mu Igazeti ya Leta ya Repubulika y’u
Rwanda nyuma y’amezi atatu abarwa
uhereye ku itariki ibisabwa byuzurijweho.
(2) Itangazwa ry’ubusabe bwo kwandikisha
igishushanyo n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa
mu nganda rigaragaza amakuru akurikira:
(a) inomero y’ubusabe;
(b) amazina y’usaba n’ay’umuhanzi
w’igishushanyo n’icyitegererezo
bikoreshwa mu nganda;
(c) itariki ubusabe bwatangiweho;
(d) amakuru arambuye y’ubusabe
bw’uburenganzira bwo gutanga abandi
mu busabe;
(e) itondeka mpuzamahanga;
(f) nibura igishushanyo kimwe ariko
bitarenze ibishushanyo bitanu, ifoto
cyangwa ibindi birango bigaragaramo
igishushanyo n’icyitegererezo
bikoreshwa mu nganda;
(g) igisobanuro cy’ibyatunganyijwe
bigenewe gukoreshwamo
igishushanyo n’icyitegererezo
bikoreshwa mu nganda.

articles.heading: Itangazwa ry’iyandikwa ry’igishushanyo n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa mu nganda
Guhagarika itangazwa ry’igishushanyo n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa mu nganda (1) Igihe hari ubusabe bwo guhagarika
articles.text:
itangazwa ry’igishushanyo
n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa mu nganda
bwatanzwe hakurikijwe ibiteganyijwe mu
gika cya (6) cy’ingingo ya 109 y’iri tegeko,
idosiye yerekeye igishushanyo
n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa mu nganda
cyandikishijwe ntishyikirizwa rubanda
kugira ngo igenzurwe mu gihe ihagarikwa
ryasabwe rimara, kandi ubuyobozi
bubifitiye ububasha butangaza gusa:
(a) inyandiko yerekeye ihagarikwa
ry’itangazwa ry’igishushanyo
n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa mu
nganda;
(b) umwirondoro w’ufite uburenganzira ku
gishushanyo cyandikishwa;
(c) itariki ubusabe bwatangiweho;
(d) igihe ihagarikwa ry’itangazwa ryasabwe
rizamara.
(2) Iyo igihe cy’ihagarikwa kirangiye,
ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha bushyira
ahagaragarira rubanda kopi z’igishushanyo
n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa mu nganda
cyandikishijwe hamaze kwishyurwa
amafaranga yagenwe.

articles.heading: Gutesha agaciro iyandikwa ry’igishushanyo n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa mu nganda (1) Umuntu ubifitemo inyungu ashobora
articles.text:
gusaba urukiko rubifitiye ububasha
gutesha agaciro iyandikwa
ry’igishushanyo n’icyitegererezo
bikoreshwa mu nganda iyo agaragaje imwe
mu mpamvu zikurikira:
(a) ko igishushanyo n’icyitegererezo
bikoreshwa mu nganda atari bishya;
(b) ko igishushanyo n’icyitegererezo
bikoreshwa mu nganda bidashobora
kwandikishwa;
(c) ko ufite uburenganzira ku gishushanyo
n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa mu nganda
byanditswe atari we muhanzi cyangwa
nta burenganzira yari afite bwo gusaba
kubyandikisha.
(2) Urukiko rubifitiye ububasha rushobora
kwemeza ko igishushanyo
n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa mu nganda
byandikwa ku wasabye ko iyandikwa
riteshwa agaciro, iyo uwasabye agaragaje
ko ari we muhanzi w’igishushanyo
n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa mu nganda
kandi mu kirego yasabye ko
bakimwandikaho.
(3) Umuntu ubifitemo inyungu amenyesha
ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha icyemezo
cya burundu cy’urukiko cyo kuvanaho
iyandikwa ry’igishushanyo
n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa mu nganda
kugira ngo:
(a) bwandike icyemezo cy’urukiko muri
rejisitiri y’ibishushanyo
n’ibyitegererezo bikoreshwa mu
nganda;
(b) bushyire ku gishushanyo
n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa mu
nganda ikimenyetso cy’uko
cyateshejwe agaciro muri rejisitiri
y’ibishushanyo n’ibyitegererezo
bikoreshwa mu nganda;
(c) butangaze imenyesha rivuga ku
cyemezo cy’urukiko mu gihe kitarenze
iminsi 30 ibarwa uhereye ku itariki
bwakimenyesherejweho.

articles.heading: Inkurikizi zo gutesha agaciro iyandikwa ry’igishushanyo n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa mu nganda
articles.text:
(1) Iyo impamvu zo gutesha agaciro
iyandikwa ry’igishushanyo
n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa mu nganda
zerekeye igice cy’igishushanyo
n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa mu nganda
gisabirwa kwandikishwa cyerekeranye na
cyo ni cyo cyonyine kivanwaho.
(2) Igishushanyo n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa
mu nganda, igisabirwa kwandikishwa
cyangwa igice cyacyo byateshejwe agaciro
bifatwa ko byavanyweho uhereye ku itariki
icyemezo cy’igishushanyo
n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa mu nganda
cyatangiweho.

articles.heading: Kwimurira ku wundi muntu iyandikwa ry’igishushanyo n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa mu nganda Ibyerekeye kwimurira ku wundi muntu
articles.text:
iyandikwa ry’igishushanyo n’icyitegererezo

Icyiciro cya 5: Uburenganzira butangwa
n’iyandikwa ry’igishushanyo
