RY’UBUCURUZI
Icyiciro cya mbere: Ikirango
Akiciro ka mbere: Ikirango kirengerwa

articles.heading: Ikirango gishobora kwandikwa (1) Ikirango gishobora kwandikwa ni ikigizwe n’ikimenyetso cyangwa urwunge
articles.text:
rw’ibimenyetso bishobora kugaragaza
itandukaniro hagati y’ibicuruzwa cyangwa
serivisi bitangwa n’umuntu n’ibindi
bicuruzwa cyangwa serivisi bitangwa
n’undi muntu.
(2) Ibimenyetso bikurikira bishobora
kwandikishwa nk’ikirango:
(a) amagambo, amazina bwite, inyuguti,
imibare ndetse n’impine z’amagambo;
(b) ibigaragaza amasura, harimo:
(i) ibishushanyo;
(ii) ibipfunyikwamo;
(iii)imiterere y’ibikoresho
(iv)cyangwa amasura shusho.
(c) amabara cyangwa urwunge
rw’amabara;
(d) urwunge urwo ari rwo rwose
rw’ibimenyetso byavuzwe haruguru.

articles.heading: Ibisabwa mu kwandikisha ikirango (1) Ikirango cyandikwa iyo
articles.text:
(a) gitandukanya ;
(b) kitari urwiganwa;
(c) kidatera urujijo;
(d) kidasobanura .
(2) Icyakora, ikirango ntigishobora
kwandikwa iyo ubusabe bwakoranwe
uburiganya cyangwa bibangamira
ihiganwa.
(3) Ikirango gishobora kwandikishwa
gishobora kuba gifite ibikigize
bitarengewe, keretse iyo bigabanya
ibiranga ubutandukane bw’ikirango
cyangwa bibangamira uburenganzira
bw’abandi bantu.

articles.heading: Ikirango gitandukanya (1) Ikirango kiba gitandukanya iyo mu miterere yacyo gishobora gutandukanya
articles.text:
ibicuruzwa cyangwa serivisi bitangwa
n’umuntu n’ibicuruzwa cyangwa serivisi
bitangwa n’undi muntu.
(2) Icyakora, ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha
bushobora kwemeza ko ikirango kitujuje
ibisabwa biteganyijwe mu gika cya (1)
cy’iyi ngingo gishobora gutandukanya iyo
kimaze igihe gikoreshwa.

articles.heading: Ikirango cy’urwiganwa (1) Ikirango kiba ari urwiganwa iyo
articles.text:
(a) gifite isura ihwanye, cyangwa isura isa
ku buryo itera urujijo n’iy’ikirango
cyangwa izina ry’ubucuruzi cyangwa
iyo kigizwe n’ikirango cyangwa izina
ry’ubucuruzi ryahinduwe mu zindi
ndimi bisanzwe byaramamaye muri
Repubulika y’u Rwanda, ku bicuruzwa
cyangwa serivisi bihwanye cyangwa
bifite isura isa n’iby’undi muntu;
(b) gifite isura ihwanye, cyangwa isura isa ku
buryo itera urujijo n'iy'ikirango cyangwa
izina ry'ubucuruzi, cyangwa iyo kigizwe
n'ikirango cyangwa izina ry'ubucuruzi
cyahinduwe mu zindi ndimi cyamamaye
muri Republika y’u Rwanda mu
bicuruzwa cyangwa servisi bidafite isura
ihwanye cyangwa isura isa n'igisabirwa
iyandikwa, iyo:
(i) ikoreshwa ry’ikirango cy’usaba ku
bireba ibicuruzwa cyangwa serivisi
bigaragaza isano iri hagati y’ibyo
bicuruzwa cyangwa serivisi n’ufite
uburenganzira ku kirango
cyamamaye;
(ii) inyungu z’ufite uburenganzira ku
kirango cyamamaye zishobora
kubangamirwa n’iryo koreshwa;
(c) gifite isura ihwanye n’iy’ikirango
gitunzwe n’undi muntu kandi gisanzwe
cyanditswe cyangwa ubusabe bwatanzwe
mbere cyangwa cyarahawe
uburenganzira bwo gutanga abandi ku
bireba:
(i) ibicuruzwa cyangwa serivisi
bimwe;
(ii) ibicuruzwa cyangwa serivisi bisa,
kandi ikoreshwa ryabyo rikaba
rishobora kuyobya cyangwa guteza
urujijo;
(d) cyangwa gifite isura isa n’iy’ikirango
cyandikishijwe gitunzwe n’undi muntu
cyangwa ubusabe bwatanzwe mbere
cyangwa cyarahawe uburenganzira bwo
gutanga abandi ku bireba ibicuruzwa na
serivisi bimwe cyangwa bisa, kandi
ikoreshwa ryacyo rikaba rishobora
kuyobya cyangwa guteza urujijo.
(2) Kugaragaza ko ikirango cyamamaye
bishingira ku ntera cyangwa ku rwego
kiriho mu kumenyekana muri rubanda mu
gice gikoreshwamo muri Repubulika y’u
Rwanda, harimo no ku rwego cyagezeho
kimenyekana binyuze mu kucyamamaza.

articles.heading: Ikirango giteza urujijo (1) Ikirango kiba giteza urujijo iyo gishobora gutuma abaguzi, rubanda cyangwa
Ikirango gisobanura Ikirango kiba gisobanura iyo kigaragaza mu bikigize amagambo cyangwa imvugo
articles.text:
(a) bikoreshwa gusa mu kwerekana ubwoko,
ubwiza, ingano, ikigamijwe, agaciro,
ahantu bikomoka, igihe ibicuruzwa
byakorewe cyangwa serivisi zatangiwe
cyangwa ibindi bibiranga by’ibanze
bigaragaza ibicuruzwa cyangwa serivisi;
(b) bikoreshwa muri rusange n’abaguzi ku
bireba ibicuruzwa cyangwa serivisi
by’ikirango cyasabiwe iyandikwa;
(c) bikoreshwa muri rusange ku rwego rwa
tekiniki ku bireba ibicuruzwa cyangwa
servisi by’ikirango cyasabiwe iyandikwa.

articles.heading: Ubusabe bw’iyandikwa ry’ikirango bwakoranwe uburiganya Ikirango nticyandikwa iyo ubusabe bukoranywe uburiganya, cyangwa iyo
articles.text:
iyandikwa ry’ikirango rifite inkurikizi
cyangwa rishobora kugira inkurikizi
zikurikira:
(a) kubangamira ihiganwa;
(b) kubuza ubucuruzi;
(c) cyangwa gukoresha nabi umwanya
w’ubushobozi isoko rifite cyangwa
ubwiganze rikesha ikirango.

articles.heading: Ikirango kidashobora kwandikishwa cyangwa gukoreshwa Ikirango nticyandikwa cyangwa ngo gikoreshwe, iyo
articles.text:
(a) kitubahirije amategeko ndemyagihugu
n’imigenzo myiza;
(b) cyandukura, cyigana cyangwa
gikubiyemo ibice bigize ibirango
by’igihugu, amabendera cyangwa
ibindi birango, izina, impine
z’amagambo cyangwa inyuguti
zihagarariye izina cyangwa ikashe
y’igihugu ikoreshwa mu kugenzura no
kwemeza ibikorwa bya Leta cyangwa
iby’umuryango mpuzamahanga
washyizweho n’amasezerano
mpuzamahanga, keretse iyo Leta
cyangwa uwo muryango
mpuzamahanga bibitangiye uruhushya.
Akiciro ka 2: Ubusabe bwo kwandikisha
ikirango

articles.heading: Gutanga ubusabe bwo kwandikisha ikirango (1) Ubusabe bw’iyandikwa ry’ikirango bukorwa huzuzwa inyandiko
articles.text:
yabugenewe ishyirwaho n’ubuyobozi
bubifitiye ububasha.
(2) Gutanga ubusabe byishyurirwa
amafaranga yagenwe.

articles.heading: Kugena itariki y’ubusabe bw’iyandikwa ry’ikirango (1) Ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha bugena itariki bwakiriyeho ubusabe bw’iyandikwa
articles.text:
ry’ikirango nk'itariki ubusabe hakurikijwe
ibikubiye mu ngingo ya 190 y’iri tegeko.
(2) Icyakora, iyo ibisabwa bituzuye,
ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha
bumenyesha usaba kuzuza ibibura mu gihe
kitarenze iminsi 14 ibarwa uhereye ku
itariki yabimenyesherejweho.
(3) Iyo usaba yubahirije ibyo asabwa gukora,
itariki ibyaburaga byakiriweho ni yo ifatwa
nk’itariki y’ubusabe.
(4) Iyo usaba atubahirije ibyo asabwa gukora,
ubusabe bufatwa nk’ubwaretswe.
Akiciro ka 3: Isuzuma n’itangazwa
ry’iyandikwa ry’ikirango

articles.heading: Gusuzuma ireme ry’ubusabe bwo kwandikisha ikirango (1) Iyo ubusabe bwo kwandikisha ikirango
articles.text:
bwujuje ibisabwa biteganywa mu ngingo
ya 190 y’iri tegeko, ubuyobozi bubifitiye
ububasha busuzuma ireme ryabwo
hakurikijwe ibiteganywa mu ngingo ya
183 n’iya 189 z’iri tegeko kugira ngo
ikirango cyandikwe.
(2) Ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha bushobora
gusaba uwatanze ubusabe kwemeza ko
bimwe mu bice bigize ikirango bidahabwa
uburenganzira bwihariye.
(3) Uwatanze ubusabe nawe ashobora gusaba
ko ibice bivuzwe mu gika cya (2) cy’iyi
ngingo bidahabwa uburenganzira
bwihariye kuri icyo kirango asabira
kwandikwa.
(4) Iyo ubusabe butujuje ibisabwa, ubuyobozi
bubifitiye ububasha bwanga ubusabe bwo
kwandikisha ikirango, bukabimenyesha
mu nyandiko usaba mu minsi itarenze 14
ibarwa uhereye ku itariki icyemezo
cyafatiwe.

articles.heading: Itangazwa ry’ubusabe bwo kwandikisha ikirango (1) Ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha butangaza ubusabe bwemewe bwo kwandikisha
Itambamira ry’iyandikwa ry’ikirango Umuntu ubifitemo inyungu ashobora gutambamira iyandikwa ry’ikirango yuzuza
Uburyo bukurikizwa mu itambamira ry’ikirango (1) Ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha bumenyesha uwatanze inyandiko isaba
articles.text:
kwandika ikirango itambamira
ry’iyandikwa ry’ikirango, mu gihe
kitarenze iminsi irindwi ibarwa uhereye ku
itariki bwayakiriyeho, kugira ngo atange
ibisobanuro ku mpamvu z’itambamira.
(2) Uwatanze inyandiko isaba kwandika
ikirango atanga ibisobanuro ku mpamvu
z’itambamira mu gihe kitarenze iminsi 30
ibarwa uhereye ku itariki
yamenyesherejweho itambamira.
(3) Iyo uwatanze inyandiko isaba kwandika
ikirango adatanze ibisobanuro ku mpamvu
z’itambamira, ubusabe bufatwa nk’aho
bwaretswe.
(4) Iyo uwatanze inyandiko isaba kwandika
ikirango atanze ibisobanuro ku mpamvu
z’itambamira, ubuyobozi bubifitiye
ububasha bwoherereza kopi y’igisubizo
uwakoze itambamira.
(5) Nyuma yo kumva impande zombi no
gusuzuma ishingiro ry’itambamira,
ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha bwanzura
niba bikwiye ko ikirango cyandikwa
cyangwa kitandikwa, mu gihe kitarenze
iminsi 30 ibarwa uhereye ku itariki ya
nyuma wo kumva ibisobanuro byatanzwe
n’impande zombi.

articles.heading: Ubujurire ku cyemezo cy’itambamira ry’iyandikwa ry’ikirango (1) Umuntu ubifitemo inyungu ashobora
articles.text:
kujuririra icyemezo ku itambamira
ry’iyandikwa ry’ikirango mu kanama
k’ubujurire mu gihe kitarenze iminsi 30
ibarwa uhereye ku itariki
yamenyesherejweho icyemezo
cy’ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha.
(2) Iteka rya Minisitiri rigena abagize
akanama k’ubujurire n’imikorere yako.

articles.heading: Agaciro k’uburenganzira mu gihe cy’itangazwa (1) Nyuma yo gutangaza ubusabe na mbere yo kwandika ikirango, uwatanze ubusabe
articles.text:
agira umwihariko n’uburenganzira bimwe
nk’ibyo yari kuba afite iyo ikirango kiba
cyaranditswe.
(2) Icyakora, iyo ubusabe bwo kwandikisha
ikirango butambamiwe bikemerwa, uwo
mwihariko n’ubwo burenganzira bihita
biba imfabusa uhereye ku itariki ubusabe
bwatangiweho.
Akiciro ka 4: Iyandikwa ry’kirango,
itangazwa n’iteshagaciro by’iyandikwa

articles.heading: Iyandikwa ry’ikirango Iyo ubusabe bwo kwandikisha ikirango bwujuje ibisabwa, ubuyobozi bubifitiye
articles.text:
ububasha bukora ibi bikurikira:
(a) bwandika icyemezo cy’iyandikwa
ry’ikirango muri rejisitiri y’ibirango;
(b) buha uwatanze idosiye y’ubusabe
icyemezo cy’iyandikwa ry’ikirango.

articles.heading: Itangazwa ry’iyandikwa ry’ikirango Ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha butangaza iyandikwa ry’ikirango mu Igazeti ya Leta ya
articles.text:
Repubulika y’u Rwanda mu gihe kitarenze
iminsi 30 ibarwa uhereye ku itariki ikirango
cyandikiweho.

articles.heading: Gutesha agaciro iyandikwa ry’ikirango (1) Umuntu ubifitemo inyungu ashobora gusaba urukiko rubifitiye ububasha
articles.text:
gutesha agaciro iyandikwa ry’ikirango
agaragaje nibura imwe mu mpamvu
zikurikira:
(a) iyo ikirango kidatandukanya;
(b) iyo ikirango ari urwiganwa;
(c) iyo ikirango giteza urujijo;
(d) iyo ikirango gisobanura;
(e) iyo ikirango cyandikishijwe mu
buriganya;
(f) n’iyo ubusabe bw’iyandikwa
ry’ikirango bwatanzwe hagamijwe
kubangamira ihiganwa.
(2) Urukiko rubifitiye ububasha rushobora
kwemeza ko ikirango cyandikwa ku
wasabye ko iyandikwa riteshwa agaciro,
iyo uwasabye agaragaje ko ari we ufite
uburenganzira ku kirango kandi mu
kirego yasabye ko bakimwandikaho.
(3) Umuntu ubifitemo inyungu amenyesha
ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha icyemezo
cya burundu cy’urukiko cyo kuvanaho
iyandikwa ry’ikirango kugira ngo:
(a) bwandike icyemezo cy’urukiko muri
rejisitiri y’ibirango;
(b) bushyire ku kirango ikimenyetso
cy’uko cyateshejwe agaciro muri
rejisitiri y’ibirango;
(c) butangaze imenyesha rivuga ku
cyemezo cy’urukiko mu gihe kitarenze
iminsi 30 ibarwa uhereye ku itariki
bwakimenyesherejweho.

articles.heading: Inkurikizi zo gutesha agaciro iyandikwa ry’ikirango Iyandikwa ry’ikirango ryateshejwe agaciro
articles.text:
rifatwa nk’iridafite agaciro uhereye ku itariki
ikirango cyandikishirijweho.
Akiciro ka 5: Kurengera uburenganzira
butangwa n’iyandikwa ry’ikirango n’igihe
bimara

articles.heading: Uburenganzira butangwa n’iyandikwa ry’ikirango (1) Iyandikwa ry’ikirango rihesha nyiracyo uburenganzira bwihariwe bwo
articles.text:
kugikoresha ku butaka bwa Repubulika
y’u Rwanda.
(2) Iyandikwa ry’ikirango rihesha kandi
nyiracyo uburenganzira bwihariwe bwo
kubuza umuntu uwo ari we wese utari
nyiracyo kugikoresha ku butaka bwa
Repubulika y’u Rwanda, atabiherewe
uruhushya na nyiracyo.

articles.heading: Ikirego cy’indishyi ku ibangamirwa ry’ikirango cyandikishijwe Ufite uburenganzira ku kirango
articles.text:
cyandikishijwe, ashobora kuregera indishyi
mu rukiko rubifitiye ububasha, arega umuntu
ukoresha ikirango cyandikishijwe, cyangwa
worohereza cyangwa ugura ibyazwamusaruro
ry’ikirango cyandikishijwe atabimwemereye
cyangwa worohereza cyangwa ugurisha
ibyazwamusaruro ry’ikirango cy’urwiganwa
k’ufite uburenganzira ku kirango
cyandikishijwe.

articles.heading: Gukura ikirango muri rejisitiri y’ibirango kubera ko kidakoreshwa (1) Ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha,
articles.text:
bubyibwirije cyangwa bubisabwe
n’umuntu ubifitemo inyungu, bumenyesha
ufite uburenganzira ku kirango
cyandikishijwe, ikurwa ry’ikirango muri
rejisitiri y’ibirango kubera impamvu z’uko
kitakoreshejwe na nyiracyo
wacyandikishije cyangwa uwahawe
uruhushya mu gihe kingana nibura
n’imyaka itatu ikurikirana ibarwa uhereye
ku itariki ikirango cyandikishirijweho.
(2) Ufite uburenganzira ku kirango
cyandikishijwe cyangwa uwahawe
uruhushya, mu gihe cy’iminsi 30 ibarwa
uhereye ku itariki yakiriyeho imenyesha
ryo gukura ikirango muri rejisitiri, atanga
impamvu zamubujije gukoresha ikirango.
(3) Iyo ufite uburenganzira ku kirango
cyandikishijwe cyangwa uwahawe
uruhushya atanze impamvu zumvikana
zamubujije kugikoresha, ikirango
ntigikurwa muri regisitiri.
(4) Iyo ufite uburenganzira ku kirango
cyandikishijwe cyangwa uwahawe
uruhushya adatanze impamvu cyangwa
atanze impamvu zitumvikana zamubujije
kugikoresha, ikirango gikurwa muri
rejisitiri y’ibirango.

articles.heading: Aho uburenganzira bugarukira n’irangira ryabwo (1) Uburenganzira butangwa n’ikirango cyanditswe ntibureba ibikorwa byerekeye
articles.text:
ibyatunganyijwe cyangwa serivisi
byashyizwe mu bucuruzi ku buryo
bwemewe n’amategeko muri Repubulika
y’u Rwanda na nyir’ukucyandikisha
cyangwa abitangiye uruhushya.
(2) Haseguriwe ibikubiye mu ngingo ya 204
y’iri tegeko, Minisitiri abyibwirije,
abisabwe n’ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha
cyangwa abisabwe n’umuntu ubifitemo
inyungu afite ububasha bwo gutangaza ko
uburenganzira ku cyemezo cy’ikirango
bwarangiye, muri icyo gihe akemera ko
abandi bantu batumiza mu mahanga
icyatunganyijwe cyahawe icyemezo
cy’ikirango cyangwa icyatunganyijwe mu
buryo butaziguye cyangwa buziguye
hakoreshejwe ikirango cyatangiwe
icyemezo cy’iyandikwa cyitwa
“icyatunganyijwe” cyaturutse ku butaka
bw’ikindi gihugu mu gihe:
(a) icyatunganyijwe:
(i) kitaboneka ku butaka bw’u
Rwanda;
(ii) kiboneka ku butaka bw’u Rwanda
kitubahirije ubuziranenge
busabwa;
(iii)kitaboneka ku buryo gishobora
guhaza abaguzi b’imbere mu
gihugu;
(iv)gifite igiciro Minisitiri asanga
kidakwiye;
(b) biturutse ku yindi mpamvu iyo ari yo
yose igamije inyungu rusange, harimo
no gukumira ibikorwa byabangamira
ihiganwa.
(3) Mu ifatwa ry’icyemezo hitabwa kuri ibi
bikurikira:
(a) icyatunganyijwe kigomba kuba
cyarashyizwe ku isoko mu gihugu
kizaturukamo n’ufite uburenganzira ku
cyemezo cy’ikirango cyangwa uwo
yabyemereye;
(b) icyemezo cy’ikirango gisaba
kwitirirwa icyatunganyijwe cyangwa
uburyo bwo kugitunganya kigomba
kuba gifite agaciro mu gihugu
kizaturukamo kandi kikaba gifitwe
n’umuntu umwe ari na we ufite
uburenganzira ku cyemezo cy’ikirango
gifite agaciro muri Repubulika y’u
Rwanda cyangwa umuntu afiteho
ububasha.
(4) Iyo uwinjije mu gihugu icyatunganyijwe
atujuje ibisabwa byatumye Minisitiri afata
icyo cyemezo cyo gutangaza ko
uburenganzira ku cyemezo cy’ikirango
bwarangiye, Minisitiri afite ububasha bwo
kuvanaho urwo ruhushya, abyibwirije
cyangwa abisabwe n’ufite uburenganzira
ku cyemezo cy’ikirango.
(5) Ibikubiye mu gika cya (1) cy’iyi ngingo
ntibireba gukoresha ikirango cyanditswe
mu rwego rw’imenyeshamakuru, nko
kumenyekanisha ibicuruzwa cyangwa
iyamamaza rigereranya, mu gihe gukora
gutyo bidakorwa ku buryo bitera rubanda
kwibeshya cyangwa bitaba ari igikorwa
cy’ihiganwa ry’ubucuruzi kirimo
uburiganya.
(6) Minisitiri ufite ubuzima mu nshingano
afite ububasha bwo gufata icyemezo cyo
kugabanya ikoreshwa ry’ibirango,
hagamijwe koroshya iyandikwa
n’ikoreshwa ry’imiti ikomoka ku miti
y’umwimerere, ndetse n’ibikoresho byo
kwa muganga cyangwa gufata icyemezo
kibuza abantu gufata imiti yagaragaye ko
yangiza ubuzima, mu gihe ibyo
bitabangamira ku buryo bukabije
ubushobozi bw’icyo kirango, mu
gutandukanya umuti uyu n’uyu wemewe
kunyobwa n’undi muti na wo wemewe
gukoreshwa.

articles.heading: Igihe kurengera ikirango cyandikishijwe bimara n’igihe cy’inyongera (1) Ikirango cyandikishijwe kirengerwa mu
articles.text:
gihe cy’imyaka 10 ibarwa uhereye ku
itariki ubusabe bw’iyandikwa
bwatangiweho.
(2) Igihe cyo kurengera ikirango
cyandikishijwe gishobora guhora
cyongererwa igihe cy’inyongera kimara
imyaka 10, iyo bisabwe n’ufite
uburenganzira ku kirango cyandikishijwe.
Kongera igihe cyo kurengera ikirango
cyandikishijwe byishyurirwa amafaranga
yagenwe.
(3) Icyakora, hatangwa igihe cy’imbabazi
kingana n’amezi atandatu cyo kwishyura
amafaranga yo kongera igihe cyo
kurengera ikirango cyandikishijwe nyuma
y’itariki ntarengwa yo kwishyuriraho.
Ubwishyu bukozwe mu gihe cy’imbabazi
bwiyongeraho amafaranga y’inyongera
yagenwe.
(4) Iyo amafaranga yo kongerera ikirango
igihe atishyuwe, kurengera ikirango
cyandikishijwe bitakaza agaciro.
Akiciro ka 6: Ukwegurira undi muntu
ikirango

articles.heading: Uburyo bwo kwegurira undi muntu uburenganzirira ku kirango (1) Ikirango cyandikishijwe gishobora
articles.text:
kwegurirwa undi muntu binyuze mu
masezerano yanditse yo kwegurira undi
muntu ikirango cyanditse, ashyirwaho
umukono n’impande zombi.
(2) Amaze kwishyura amafaranga yagenwe,
uweguriwe ikirango ashyikiriza ubuyobozi
bubifitiye ububasha amasezerano yanditse
yo kwegurira undi muntu ikirango ariho
umukono kugira ngo bwandike muri
rejisitiri y’ibirango impinduka ku
burenganzira ku kirango kandi
bunazitangaze.
(3) Ukwegurira undi muntu ikirango bitangira
kugira agaciro no gukurikizwa gusa iyo
kimaze kwandikwa muri rejisitiri
y’ibirango.

articles.heading: Kwanga kwandika amasezerano yo kwegurira undi muntu uburenganzirira ku kirango Ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha ntibwandika
Uruhushya rushingiye ku masezerano y’ikirango
Ivanwaho ry’uruhushya rushingiye ku masezerano y’ikirango Uruhushya rushingiye ku masezerano
articles.text:
y’ikirango ruvanwaho n’ubuyobozi bubifitiye
ububasha iyo:
(a) amasezerano yerekeye uruhushya
rw’ikirango asheshwe na rumwe
cyangwa impande zombi;
(b) iyandikwa ry’ikirango riteshejwe
agaciro.

articles.heading: Kwanga kwandika amasezerano yo gutanga uruhushya rw’ikirango (1) Ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha
articles.text:
ntibwandika amasezerano yo gutanga
uruhushya rw’ikirango, iyo busanze ayo
masezerano afite ingingo imwe cyangwa
nyinshi, cyangwa amasezerano yose uko
yakabaye yabangamira ihiganwa cyangwa
iyo guha uruhushya icyo kirango bishobora
kuyobya, gutuma abaguzi bibeshya
cyangwa bishobora kubateza urujijo ku
bireba:
(a) aho gikomoka;
(b) ireme;
(c) imiterere;
(d) ibikiranga;
(e) uburyo cyakozwemo;
(f) kuba kibereye kubyazwa umusaruro
mu byo kigamije ku bicuruzwa
cyangwa serivisi ikirango cyasabiwe
iyandikwa n’usaba.
(2) Mbere yo gufata icyemezo, ubuyobozi
bubifitiye ububasha bushobora kumva
imyanzuro itangwa n’impande zagiranye
amasezerano, bushobora kandi kugisha
inama urwego rushinzwe igenzura
ry’ihiganwa.
(3) Icyemezo cyo kwanga kwandika
uruhushya rw’ikirango gishobora
kujuririrwa mu kanama k’ubujurire mu
gihe kitarenze iminsi 30 ibarwa uhereye ku
itariki icyemezo cyamenyesherejweho
impande zombi.
(4) Ibiteganyijwe mu masezerano
bibangamira cyangwa bibuza uwahawe
uruhushya rw’ikirango bidafitanye isano
n’ibisabwa muri iri tegeko kandi nta
mpamvu za ngombwa kugira ngo harindwe
uburenganzira ku kirango cyandikishijwe
bifatwa ko bifite ingaruka zibangamira
ihiganwa.

articles.heading: Ingingo z’amasezerano yo gutanga uruhushya rw’ikirango zishobora kubangamira ihiganwa Ubwoko bw’ingingo z’amasezerano yo
articles.text:
gutanga uruhushya rw’ikirango bukurikira
butera ugukeka gushobora kuvuguruzwa ku
bibangamira ihiganwa:
(a) ingingo ibuza uwahawe uruhushya
rw’ikirango gutambamira, gusaba
iyamburwa iteshwagaciro ry’iyandikwa
ry’ikirango;
(b) ingingo ihatira uwahawe uruhushya
rw’ikirango kubona uruhushya ku birebana
n’ubundi burenganzira ku mutungo mu
by’inganda nk’inkomyi yo gutanga
uruhushya rushingiye ku masezerano ku
kirango cyandikishijwe;
(c) ingingo iha uwahawe uruhushya
rw’ikirango inshingano yo kwishyura
amafaranga adakwiye ku kirango
kitarakoreshwa;
(d) ingingo iha uwahawe uruhushya
rw’ikirango inshingano yo kugura
ibikoresho fatizo, ibyatunganyijwe
biciriritse cyangwa ibikoresho ku watanze
urwo ruhushya;
(e) ingingo ibuza uwahawe uruhushya
rw’ikirango kohereza mu mahanga
ibicuruzwa biriho ikirango cyangwa ibuza
kohereza hanze ibyo bicuruzwa
hatishyuwe amafaranga adakwiye ku
watanze urwo ruhushya;
(f) ingingo igabanya, mu buryo ubwo aribwo
bwose, amahirwe y’uwahawe uruhushya
rw’ikirango kugira ngo agurishe
ibicuruzwa biriho ikirango ku masoko yo
mu gihugu cyangwa ayo hanze yacyo;
(g) ingingo ikubiyemo inshingano
y’inyongera, kubera imiterere yayo
cyangwa hakurikijwe imikoreshereze mu
bucuruzi, idafite aho ihuriye n’ikigamijwe
n’ayo masezerano.
Akiciro ka 8: Ikirango gihuriweho

articles.heading: ikirango gihuriweho Ikirango gishobora gutandukanya ibicuruzwa cyangwa serivisi by’abanyamuryango
articles.text:
b’ishyirahamwe n’ibicuruzwa cyangwa
serivisi by’abantu batari abanyamuryango
b’iryo shyirahamwe cyasabiwe iyandikwa mu
buryo bwagenwe gishobora kwandikishwa
nk’ikirango gihuriweho ku bireba ibicuruzwa
cyangwa serivisi byanditswe mu izina ry’iryo
shyirahamwe.

articles.heading: Ubusabe bw’iyandikwa ry’ikirango gihuriweho Ibyerekeye ibisabwa mu kwandikisha ikirango gihuriweho, ikirango gihuriweho kidashobora
articles.text:
kwandikishwa cyangwa gukoreshwa, kugena
itariki y’ubusabe bw’iyandikwa ry’ikirango
gihuriweho, gusuzuma ireme ry’ubusabe bwo
kwandikisha ikirango gihuriweho, itangazwa
ry’ubusabe bwo kwandikisha ikirango
gihuriweho, itambamira ry’iyandikwa
ry’ikirango gihuriweho, uburyo bukurikizwa
mu itambamira ry’ikirango gihuriweho,
ubujurire ku cyemezo cy’itambamira
ry’iyandikwa ry’ikirango gihuriweho, agaciro
k’uburenganzira mu gihe cy’itangazwa,
iyandikwa ry’ikirango gihuriweho, itangazwa
ry’iyandikwa ry’ikirango gihuriweho n’igihe
kurengera ikirango gihuriweho cyandikishijwe
bimara n’igihe cy’inyongera bikorwa mu
buryo bumwe nk’ubuteganyijwe mu ngingo ya
183 , iya 189, iya 191, iya 192, iya 193, iya
194, iya 195 , iya 196, iya 197 , iya 198, iya
199 n’iya 206 z’iri tegeko nk’uko bikurikirana.

articles.heading: Gutanga ubusabe bwo kwandikisha ikirango gihuriweho (1) Ubusabe bw’iyandikwa ry’ikirango gihuriweho bukorwa huzuzwa inyandiko
articles.text:
yabugenewe ishyirwaho n’ubuyobozi
bubifitiye ububasha.
(2) Ubusabe bw’iyandikwa ry’ikirango
gihuriweho buherekezwa na kopi
y’inyandiko igaragaza imikoreshereze
yumvikanweho n’abahuriye ku kirango
gihuriweho igena ibisabwa mu
mikoreshereze y’ikirango gihuriweho.
(3) Ufite uburenganzira ku kirango
gihuriweho cyandikishijwe amenyesha
ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha impinduka
zose zakozwe kuri iyo nyandiko.
(4) Gutanga ubusabe byishyurirwa
amafaranga yagenwe.

articles.heading: Uburenganzira butangwa n’iyandikwa ry’ikirango gihuriweho (1) Iyandikwa ry’ikirango gihuriweho rihesha
articles.text:
abanyamuryango b’ishyirahamwe
uburenganzira bwihariwe bwo
kugikoresha ku butaka bwa Repubulika
y’u Rwanda.
(2) Icyakora, ikirango gihuriweho
cyandikishijwe ntigishobora gukorerwa
amasezerano yo gutanga uruhushya.

articles.heading: Gutesha agaciro iyandikwa ry’ikirango gihuriweho (1) Umuntu ubifitemo inyungu ashobora gusaba urukiko rubifitiye ububasha
articles.text:
gutesha agaciro iyandikwa ry’ikirango
gihuriweho ashingiye nibura kuri imwe
mu mpamvu zikurikira:
(a) iyo umwe mu bahuriye ku kirango
ariwe wenyine ugikoresha;
(b) iyo umwe mu bahuriye ku kirango
yemerera undi muntu kugikoresha mu
buryo bunyuranyije n’inyandiko
igaragaza imikoreshereze
yumvikanweho n’abahuriye ku
ikirango gihuriweho ishyirwaho
n’abahuriye ku kirango igena ibisabwa
mu mikoreshereze y’ikirango
gihuriweho;
(c) iyo umwe mu bahuriye ku kirango
yemereye undi muntu kugikoresha
cyangwa yamenye cyangwa yagombye
kuba yaramenye ko kirimo gukoreshwa
mu buryo buyobya, bubeshya cyangwa
buteza urujijo mu baguzi cyangwa
abacuruzi ku bireba:
(i) aho gikomoka;
(ii) ireme;
(iii) imiterere;
(iv)ibikiranga;
(v) uburyo cyakozwemo;
(vi)kuba kibereye gukoreshwa mu
byo kigamije ku bicuruzwa
cyangwa serivisi bifitanye
isano n’icyo kirango
gihuriweho.
Akiciro ka 9: Ikirango nyemeza

articles.heading: Ikirango nyemeza Ikirango cyerekana itandukaniro hagati y’ibicuruzwa na serivisi byahawe icyemezo
articles.text:
n’umuntu wabiherewe ububasha ku birebana
n’ahantu byakomotse, ibikoresho fatizo,
uburyo byakozwemo, ireme, ugukorwa neza
n’ikindi kintu kibiranga n’ibicuruzwa cyangwa
serivisi bitahawe icyemezo, kiba gishobora
kwandikishwa nk’ikirango nyemeza.

articles.heading: Ubusabe bw’iyandikwa ry’ikirango nyemeza Ibyerekeye ibisabwa mu kwandikisha ikirango nyemeza, ikirango nyemeza
articles.text:
kidashobora kwandikishwa cyangwa
gukoreshwa, gutanga ubusabe bwo
kwandikisha ikirango nyemeza, kugena itariki
y’ubusabe bw’iyandikwa ry’ikirango
nyemeza, gusuzuma ireme ry’ubusabe bwo
kwandikisha ikirango nyemeza, itangazwa
ry’ubusabe bwo kwandikisha ikirango
nyemeza, itambamira ry’iyandikwa
ry’ikirango nyemeza, uburyo bukurikizwa mu
itambamira ry’ikirango nyemeza, ubujurire ku
cyemezo cy’itambamira ry’iyandikwa
ry’ikirango nyemeza, agaciro k’uburenganzira
mu gihe cy’itangazwa, iyandikwa ry’ikirango
nyemeza, itangazwa ry’iyandikwa ry’ikirango
nyemeza n’igihe kurengera ikirango nyemeza
cyandikishijwe bimara n’igihe cy’inyongera
bikorwa mu buryo bumwe nk’ubuteganyijwe
mu ngingo ya 183, iya 189, iya 191, iya 192,
iya 193, iya 194, iya 195, iya 196, iya 197 ,
iya 198, iya 199 n’iya 206 z’iri tegeko nk’uko
bikurikirana.

articles.heading: Uburenganzira butangwa n’iyandikwa ry’ikirango nyemeza (1) Iyandikwa ry’ikirango nyemeza rihesha
articles.text:
ufite uburenganzira ku kirango nyemeza
uburenganzira bwihariwe bwo
kugikoresha ku butaka bwa Repubulika
y’u Rwanda.
(2) Umuntu wese wagaragaje ko ibicuruzwa
bye cyangwa serivisi atanga byubahiriza
amabwiriza ya tekiniki n’ibindi
bikurikizwa mu nyandiko igena
imikoreshereze y’ikirango nyemeza
ashobora gusaba uburenganzira bwo
gukoresha ikirango nyemeza mu buryo
bumwe n’ubwashyizweho n’iyo nyandiko.
(3) Icyakora, ufite uburenganzira ku kirango
nyemeza ntashobora gukoresha ikirango
nyemeza kugira ngo agaragaze cyangwa
yemeze ibicuruzwa cyangwa serivisi bye
bwite.

articles.heading: Gutesha agaciro iyandikwa ry’ikirango nyemeza (1) Umuntu ubifitemo inyungu ashobora gusaba urukiko rubifitiye ububasha
articles.text:
gutesha agaciro iyandikwa ry’ikirango
nyemeza ashingiye nibura kuri imwe mu
mpamvu zikurikira:
(a) iyo ufite uburenganzira ku kirango
nyemeza cyandikishijwe ari we wenyine
ugikoresha;
(b) iyo ufite uburenganzira ku kirango
nyemeza yemerera undi muntu
kugikoresha mu buryo bunyuranyije
n’inyandiko ishyirwaho n’abahuriye ku
kirango igena ibisabwa mu
mikoreshereze y’ikirango nyemeza;
(c) iyo ufite uburenganzira ku kirango
nyemeza yemereye undi muntu
kugikoresha, cyangwa yamenye
cyangwa yagombye kuba yaramenye ko
kirimo gukoreshwa mu buryo buyobya,
bubeshya cyangwa buteza urujijo mu
baguzi cyangwa abacuruzi ku bireba:
(i) aho gikomoka;
(ii) ireme;
(iii) imiterere;
(iv) ibikiranga;
(v) uburyo cyakozwemo;
(vi) kuba kibereye gukoreshwa mu
byo kigamije ku bicuruzwa
cyangwa serivisi bifitanye
isano n’icyo kirango nyemeza.
Icyiciro cya 2: Kurinda izina ry’ubucuruzi
n’izina ndangarubuga yo ku rwego rwa
kabiri

articles.heading: Gukoresha izina ry’ubucuruzi n’izina ndangarubuga yo ku rwego rwa kabiri (1) Izina cyangwa inyito ntibishobora
articles.text:
gukoreshwa nk’izina ry’ubucuruzi
cyangwa izina ndangarubuga ryo ku rwego
rwa kabiri iyo:
(a) mu miterere yaryo cyangwa mu
kurikoresha bihungabanya ituze
rusange rya rubanda cyangwa
bitubahiriza imigenzo myiza;
(b) rishobora kuyobya umuntu uwo
ariwe wese ku byerekeye imiterere
y’isosiyete riranga;
(c) risa neza cyangwa riteye kimwe
n’ikirango cyanditse cyangwa
kizwi na benshi muri Repubulika
y’u Rwanda;
(d) ari ihindurarurimi ry’ikirango
cyandikishijwe cyangwa kizwi na
benshi muri Repubulika y’u
Rwanda.
(2) Hashingiwe ku ngingo z’amategeko
ziteganya iyandikwa ry’izina ry’ubucuruzi
cyangwa izina ndangarubuga ryo ku rwego
rwa kabiri, iryo zina riba rirengewe ku
gikorwa cy’undi muntu kinyuranyije
n’amategeko haba mu kurigira izina
ry’ubucuruzi, ikirango cyangwa ikirango
gihuriweho, mu buryo bumwe bwo
gukoresha izina ry’ubucuruzi cyangwa
ikindi kirango gisa na byo bishobora
kuyobya abantu.
Icyiciro cya 3: Ubusabe n’iyandikwa
mpuzamahanga ry’ikirango

articles.heading: Ibisabwa ku busabe mpuzamahanga bw’iyandikwa ry’ikirango Umuntu ashobora gutanga ubusabe mpuzamahanga bw’iyandikwa ry’ikirango
articles.text:
agaragaza u Rwanda nk’igihugu ubusabe
bukomokamo cyangwa nk'igihugu cyagenwe
n’usaba, iyo kimwe mu bisabwa bikurikira
cyubahirijwe:
(a) iyo usaba afite ikigo cyo mu rwego
rw’inganda cyangwa
urw’ubucuruzi gikorera muri
Repubulika y’u Rwanda ku buryo
buhoraho;
(b) iyo usaba atuye muri Repubulika
y’u Rwanda;
(c) iyo usaba afite ubwenegihugu
bw’Igihugu cyashyize umukono ku
masezerano y’i Madrid.

articles.heading: Ishingiro ry’ubusabe mpuzamahanga bw’iyandikwa ry’ikirango mu gihe ubusabe bukomoka mu Rwanda
articles.text:
Ubusabe mpuzamahanga bw’iyandikwa
ry’ikirango mu gihe bukomoka muri
Repubulika y’u Rwanda bugira ishingiro iyo
kimwe mu bikurikira cyubahirijwe:
(a) iyo usaba yatanze ubusabe
bw’iyandikwa ry’ikirango bw’ibanze
hakurikijwe iri tegeko kandi ubusabe
bukaba bwaremewe n’ubuyobozi
bubifitiye ububasha;
(b) iyo ikirango cyandikishijwe muri
Repubulika y’u Rwanda.

articles.heading: Kugenzura, Kwemeza no kohereza ubusabe mpuzamahanga bw’iyandikwa ry’ikirango (1) Iyo ubusabe mpuzamahanga
articles.text:
bw’iyandikwa ry’ikirango butanzwe,
ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha bugenzura
niba:
(a) u Rwanda rufatwa nk’igihugu
ubusabe bukomokamo ku bireba
ubwo busabe hashingiwe ku
biteganyijwe mu ngingo ya 223
y’iri tegeko;
(b) ireme ry’ubusabe mpuzamahanga
rihuje n’ireme ry’ubusabe
bw’ibanze cyangwa
iry’iyandikishwa ry’ibanze.
(2) Iyo ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha
busanze ubusabe mpuzamahanga bwujuje
ibisabwa, bwoherereza ubwo busabe Ibiro
Mpuzamahanga, kandi bukemeza itariki
bwakiriyeho ubusabe mpuzamahanga.
(3) Iyo ubusabe mpuzamahanga butujuje
ibisabwa, ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha
ntibubwohereza mu Biro Mpuzamahanga
ahubwo bubimenyesha uwasabye.
(4) Kwemeza no gushyikiriza Ibiro
Mpuzamahanga ubusabe mpuzamahanga
bw’iyandikwa ry’ikirango byishyurirwa
amafaranga yagenwe.

articles.heading: Gusuzuma ubusabe mpuzamahanga buvugwamo u Rwanda nk’Igihugu cyagenwe (1) Ubusabe mpuzamahanga bwo
articles.text:
kwandikisha ikirango u Rwanda
ruvugwamo nk’igihugu cyagenwe
busuzumwa n’ubuyobozi bubifitiye
ububasha hakurikijwe ibiteganyijwe mu
ngingo ya 183 n’iya 189 z’iri tegeko.
(2) Iyo ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha
busanze ubusabe mpuzamahanga bwujuje
ibisabwa kugira ngo ikirango cyandikwe,
ubwo busabe buratangazwa kandi
bushobora gutambamirwa hakurikijwe
ibiteganyijwe mu ngingo ya 193 n’iya 194
z’iri tegeko.
(3) Ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha bufata
icyemezo ku busabe mpuzamahanga
bw’iyandikwa ry’ikirango mu gihe
kitarenze amezi 12 abarwa uhereye ku
itariki ubusabe mpuzamahanga
bw’iyandikwa ry’ikirango bwakiriweho,
bukanamenyesha Ibiro Mpuzamahanga
icyemezo bwafashe.

articles.heading: Kwanga by’agateganyo ubusabe mpuzamahanga u Rwanda ruvugwamo nk’igihugu cyagenwe Ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha bushobora
articles.text:
kwanga by’agateganyo iyandikwa ry’ubusabe
mpuzamahanga bukabimenyesha nyirabwo
binyujijwe ku Biro Mpuzamahanga mu gihe
kitarenze amezi 12 abarwa uhereye ku itariki
ubusabe mpuzamahanga bwakiriweho.
Imenyesha riba rikubiyemo ibi bikurikira:
(a) impamvu icyemezo cyashingiyeho;
(b) inyandiko yose ikenewe kandi
ishyigikira icyemezo cyafashwe;
(c) ibisobanuro birambuye by’itambamira,
iyo ubusabe bwanzwe hashingiwe ku
itambamira ryahawe agaciro;
(d) ibisobanuro birambuye by’uburyo
usaba ashobora gusaba isubirishwamo
ry’icyemezo mu gihe cy’amezi atatu
abarwa uhereye ku itariki
yamenyesherejweho iyangwa
ry’agateganyo ry’ubusabe bwe.

articles.heading: Kwemera cyangwa kwanga ubusabe mpuzamahanga bw’iyandikwa ry’ikirango Ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha busuzuma
articles.text:
ibisobanuro byatanzwe n’usaba isubirishamo
ry’icyemezo bugafata icyemezo cya burundu
cyo kwanga cyangwa cyo kwemera ubusabe
bukabimenyesha Ibiro Mpuzamahanga.

articles.heading: Inkurikizi zo kutamenyesha Ibiro Mpuzamahanga icyemezo cyo kwemera cyangwa kwanga iyandikwa
articles.text:
Iyo ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha
butamenyesheje Ibiro Mpuzamahanga
icyemezo cyo kwemera cyangwa kwanga
iyandikwa mu gihe cy’amezi 12 abarwa
uhereye ku itariki ubusabe mpuzamahanga
bwakiriwe, iyandikwa rifatwa nk’aho
ryemewe.

articles.heading: Kumenyesha iteshagaciro ry’iyandikishwa ry’ibanze ry’ikirango ku Biro Mpuzamahanga Mu gihe cy’iyandikwa mpuzamahanga
articles.text:
ry’ikirango, iyo iyandikishwa ry’ibanze
ryateshejwe agaciro n’urukiko kandi iryo
teshagaciro rikaba ritakijuririwe, ubuyobozi
bubifitiye ububasha bumenyesha Ibiro
Mpuzamahanga iryo teshagaciro kandi
bukerekana ibi bikurikira:
(a) urukiko rwategetse iteshagaciro
n’itariki urubanza rwasomewe;
(b) nomero y’iyandikwa
mpuzamahanga n’izina
ry’uyitunze;
(c) ibicuruzwa cyangwa serivisi
birebwa n’iryo teshagaciro.

articles.heading: Inkurikizi z’uburenganzira hakurikijwe ubusabe mpuzamahanga (1) Umuntu watanze ubusabe mpuzamahanga
articles.text:
hakurikijwe iri tegeko bugaragaza u
Rwanda nk’igihugu cyagenwe afite
uburenganzira n’uburyo bwo gusaba
kurenganurwa nk’undi muntu wese
wasabye iyandikwa ry’ikirango
hakurikijwe iri tegeko.
(2) Iyandikwa mpuzamahanga rigaragaza u
Rwanda nk’igihugu cyagenwe rigira
inkurikizi zimwe, uhereye ku itariki
ubusabe bw’iyandikwa mpuzamahanga
bwabereye, nk’aho ubusabe bw’iyandikwa
ry’ikirango bwashyikirijwe mu buryo
butaziguye ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha
hakurikijwe iri tegeko.
(3) Iyandika ryose rikozwe muri rejisitiri
mpuzamahanga yabugenewe ku bireba
iyandikwa mpuzamahanga u Rwanda
rugaragaramo nk’igihugu cyagenwe, rigira
inkurikizi zimwe nk’aho riba ryarakozwe
n’ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha muri
rejisitiri y’ibirango hakurikijwe iri tegeko.

articles.heading: Irangira ry’agaciro k’ubusabe bw’ibanze cyangwa iyandikishwa ry’ibanze Mu gihe cy’imyaka itanu ibarwa uhereye ku
articles.text:
itariki yo gutanga ubusabe bw’ibanze cyangwa
ku itariki y’iyandikishwa ry’ibanze, iyo
kimwe muri byo gitakaje agaciro, ubuyobozi
bubifitiye ububasha bubimenyesha Ibiro
Mpuzamahanga.

articles.heading: Inkurikizi ku busabe mpuzamahanga bwavanyweho Igihe ubusabe mpuzamahanga bwavanweho bisabwe n’ibiro by’igihugu ubusabe bw’ibanze
articles.text:
bukomokamo ku byerekeye ibicuruzwa byose
cyangwa bimwe muri byo ikirango
gikoreshwaho, uwasabye iyandikwa
mpuzamahanga ry’ikirango ashobora gusaba
iyandikwa ry’icyo kirango mu buyobozi
bubifitiye ububasha kandi ubwo busabe
bufatwa nk’aho bwatanzwe ku itariki
y’ubusabe bw’iyandikisha mpuzamahanga
ry’icyo kirango kandi ubwo busabe
mpuzamahanga iyo bwatangaga
uburenganzira bwo gutanga abandi nibyo
bukurikizwa ku busabe bushya igihe:
(a) ubwo busabe bwatanzwe mu gihe
cy’amezi atatu abarwa uhereye itariki
iyandikwa mpuzamahanga ry’ikirango
ryavaniweho;
(b) ibicuruzwa na serivisi byagaragajwe
mu busabe ari bimwe n’ibyari
byagaragajwe mu iyandika
mpuzamahanga;
(c) ubwo busabe bwubahiriza ibisabwa
kugira ngo ikirango cyandikwe
biteganwa mu ngingo ya 183 n’iya 190
z’iri tegeko.
UMUTWE WA VII: KURENGERA
IKIMENYETSO NDANGAHANTU
Icyiciro cya mbere: Ibisabwa mu kurengera
ikimenyetso ndangahantu

articles.heading: Ikimenyetso ndangahantu kirengerwa (1) Ikimenyetso ndangahantu kirengerwa iyo
articles.text:
(a) cyerekana intara, akarere, cyangwa
agace by’Igihugu igicuruzwa
gikomokamo;
(b) kigaragaza umwimerere no
kwamamara kw’igicuruzwa cyangwa
indi miterere yihariye y’icyo
gicuruzwa bishobora guharirwa
inkomoko y’ahantu cyaturutse.
(2) Icyakora, ikimenyetso ndangahantu kiba
kirengewe cyaba cyandikishijwe cyangwa
kitandikishijwe.

articles.heading: Iyandikwa ry’ibimenyetso ndangahantu bihuye (1) Mu kwandika ikimenyetso ndangahantu gifite ikindi ikimenyetso ndangahantu
articles.text:
bihuye mu mivugire, mu myandikire
ndetse bifite ishusho imwe kandi
bikomoka mu bice bitandukanye,
ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha bushobora
gushyiraho ibikurikizwa mu kucyandika
hagamijwe ko:
(a) ikimenyetso gitandukanywa n’ikindi
bihuje amazina;
(b) ikimenyetso gihuje izina n’ikindi
kidateza urujijo cyangwa kitayobya
rubanda;
(c) abatunganya ibicuruzwa bireba bose
bafatwa kimwe.
(2) Haseguriwe ibivugwa mu gika cya (1)
cy’iyi ngingo, iyo amazina y’ikimenyetso
ndangahantu ahuye ku byerekeye za divayi
cyangwa inzoga z’ibyotsi, kurengera
bikorerwa buri kimenyetso ndangahantu.
(3) Iteka rya Minisitiri rishobora kugena ibindi
bicuruzwa byiyongera ku bivugwa mu gika
cya (2) cy’iyi ngingo.

articles.heading: Ikimenyetso ndangahantu kidashobora kurengerwa Ikimenyetso ndangahantu ntigishobora kurengerwa iyo
articles.text:
(a) giteye ku buryo umwimerere wacyo,
uko kizwi cyangwa ikindi kintu
cyihariye kiranga igicuruzwa
kidashobora kwitirirwa ahantu
gikomoka;
(b) gihungabanya ituze rusange rya
rubanda cyangwa kitubahiriza
imigenzo myiza;
(c) kiri mu bitarengerwa cyangwa kiri mu
bitakirengerwa mu gihugu
gikomokamo;
(d) kiyobya kandi gituma rubanda rufata
ibicuruzwa nk’aho bikomoka ahantu
hatandukanye;
(e) gisa neza n’inyito gakondo mu rurimi
ruhuriweho muri Repubulika y’u
Rwanda nk’izina risanzwe ryahawe
igicuruzwa;
(f) kibangamira ikirango cyasabiwe
kwandikwa cyangwa cyanditswe,
cyangwa cyabonywe binyuze mu
mikorere nta buriganya muri
Repubulika y’u Rwanda.
Icyiciro cya 2: Ubusabe bw’iyandikwa
ry’ikimenyetso ndangahantu

articles.heading: Uburenganzira bwo gusaba iyandikwa ry’ikimenyetso ndangahantu Iyandikwa ry’ikimenyetso ndangahantu
articles.text:
bisabwa na:
(a) ishyirahamwe ry’abantu berekana mu
busabe bwabo ko bakorera ibikorwa
bibyara umusaruro mu gace k’ahantu
havugwa mu busabe;
(b) ikigo gifite ubuzimagatozi gikorera
ahantu hagaragajwe mu busabe, ku
bijyanye n’igicuruzwa kivugwa mu
busabe gikora igikorwa kibyara
umusaruro harimo icy’ubuhinzi
n’icy’ubukorikori cyangwa ikindi cyose;
(c) urwego rwa Leta rufite ubuzimagatozi
kandi rufite inyungu mu kwandikisha
ikimenyetso ndangahantu.

articles.heading: Gutanga ubusabe bwo kwandikisha ikimenyetso ndangahantu (1) Ubusabe bw’iyandikwa ry’ikimenyetso
articles.text:
ndangahantu bukorwa huzuzwa inyandiko
yabugenewe ishyirwaho n’ubuyobozi
bubifitiye ububasha.
(2) Gutanga ubusabe byishyurirwa
amafaranga yagenwe.

articles.heading: Kugena itariki y’ubusabe bw’iyandikwa ry’ikimenyetso ndangahantu (1) Ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha bugena
articles.text:
itariki bwakiriyeho ubusabe bw’iyandikwa
ry’ikimenyetso ndangahantu nk'itariki
ubusabe bwatangiweho hakurikijwe
ibikubiye mu ngingo ya 238 y’iri tegeko.
(2) Icyakora, iyo ibisabwa bituzuye,
ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha
bumenyesha usaba kuzuza ibibura mu gihe
kitarenze iminsi 14 ibarwa uhereye ku
itariki yabimenyesherejweho.
(3) Iyo usaba yubahirije ibyo asabwa gukora,
itariki ibyaburaga byakiriweho ni yo ifatwa
nk’itariki y’ubusabe.
(4) Iyo usaba atubahirije ibyo asabwa gukora,
ubusabe bufatwa nk’aho bwaretswe.
Icyiciro cya 3: Isuzuma n’itangazwa
ry’iyandikwa ry’ikimenyetso ndangahantu
(i) akarere k’ahantu harebwa
n’ikimenyetso ndangahantu
gisabwa;
(ii) ibicuruzwa birebwa n’ikimenyetso
ndangahantu;
(iii) umwimerere w’igicuruzwa, uko
cyamamaye cyangwa ikindi
kiranga ibyo bicuruzwa.

articles.heading: Gusuzuma ireme ry’ubusabe bwo kwandikisha ikimenyetso ndangahantu
Itangazwa ry’ubusabe bwo kwandikisha ikimenyetso ndangahantu
Itambamira ry’iyandikwa ry’ikimenyetso ndangahantu Ibyerekeye itambamira ry’iyandikwa, uburyo
articles.text:
bukurikizwa mu itambamira n’ubujurire ku
cyemezo cy’itambamira ry’iyandikwa
ry’ikimenyetso ndangahantu bikorwa mu
buryo bumwe nk’ubuteganyijwe mu ngingo ya
194, iya 195 n’iya 196 z’iri tegeko nk’uko
bikurikirana.
Icyiciro cya 4: iyandikwa ry’ikimenyetso
ndangahantu, itangazwa n’iteshagaciro
by’iyandikwa

articles.heading: Iyandikwa n’itangazwa ry’iyandikwa ry’ikimenyetso ndangahantu Ibyerekeye iyandikwa n’itangazwa
articles.text: ry’iyandikwa ry’ikimenyetso ndangahantu

articles.heading: Ivugurura ry’iyandikwa ry’ikimenyetso ndangahantu
Gutesha agaciro iyandikwa ry’ikimenyetso ndangahantu Umuntu ubifitemo inyungu ashobora gusaba
articles.text:
urukiko rubifitiye ububasha gutesha agaciro
iyandikwa ry’ikimenyetso ndangahantu iyo
agaragaje nibura imwe mu mpamvu zikurikira:
(a) iyo ikimenyetso ndangahantu
kitagaragaza intara, akarere, cyangwa
agace by’Igihugu igicuruzwa
gikomokamo;
(b) iyo ikimenyetso ndangahantu
kitagaragaza umwimerere no kwamamara
kw’igicuruzwa cyangwa indi miterere
yihariye y’icyo gicuruzwa bishobora
guharirwa inkomoko y’ahantu cyaturutse;
(c) iyo ikimenyetso ndangahantu giteye ku
buryo umwimerere wacyo, uko
cyamamaye cyangwa ikindi kintu
cyihariye kiranga igicuruzwa kidashobora
kwitirirwa ahantu gikomoka;
(d) iyo ikimenyetso ndangahantu
gihungabanya ituze rusange rya rubanda
cyangwa kitubahiriza imigenzo myiza;
(e) iyo ikimenyetso ndangahantu kiri mu
bitarengerwa cyangwa kiri mu
bitakirengerwa mu gihugu gikomokamo;
(f) iyo ikimenyetso ndangahantu kiyobya
kandi gituma rubanda ifata ibicuruzwa
nk’aho bikomoka ahantu hatandukanye;
(g) iyo ikimenyetso ndangahantu gisa neza
n’inyito gakondo mu rurimi ruhuriweho
muri Repubulika y’u Rwanda nk’izina
risanzwe ryahawe igicuruzwa;
(h) iyo ikimenyetso ndangahantu
kibangamira ikirango cyasabiwe
kwandikwa cyangwa cyanditswe cyangwa
cyakoreshejwe muri Repubulika y’u
Rwanda.
Icyiciro cya 5: Uburenganzira butangwa
n’iyandikwa ry’ikimenyetso ndangahantu

articles.heading: Uburenganzira bwo kubyaza umusaruro ikimenyetso ndangahantu (1) Iyandikwa ry’ikimenyetso ndangahantu
articles.text:
rihesha ba nyiracyo uburenganzira
bwihariwe bwo kugikoresha ku butaka
bwa Repubulika y’u Rwanda.
(2) Icyakora, ikimenyetso ndangahantu
cyandikishijwe ntigishobora gukorerwa
amasezerano yo gutanga uruhushya.

articles.heading: Gutanga ikirego ku ibangamirwa ry’uburenganzira bwo gukoresha ikimenyetso ndangahantu Umuntu ubifitemo inyungu ashobora kuregera
articles.text:
urukiko rubifitiye ububasha kugira ngo
rukumire cyangwa ruhagarike, ibikorwa
byerekeye ikimenyetso ndangahantu
bikurikira:
(a) gukoresha, mu kwita cyangwa
kugaragaza igicuruzwa, uburyo bwose
bwerekana cyangwa bushobora
kwerekana ko icyo gicuruzwa
gikomoka ahandi hantu ku buryo
byayobya umuntu ku byerekeye aho
icyo gicuruzwa gikomoka;
(b) gukoresha ikimenyetso ndangahantu
mu buryo ubwo ari bwo bwose binyuze
mu ihiganwa ritemewe;
(c) gukoresha ikimenyetso ndangahantu
kigaragaza za divayi kuri za divayi
zidakomoka mu gace kagaragazwa
n’ikimenyetso ndangahantu kivugwa
cyangwa kigaragaza inzoga z’ibyotsi
ko ari inzoga z’ibyotsi bidakomoka mu

articles.heading: Kwanga kwandika ikirango gisa cyangwa kirimo ikimenyetso ndangahantu
Igihe kurengera ikimenyetso ndangahantu cyandikishijwe bimara n’igihe cy’inyongera (1) Ikimenyetso ndangahantu cyandikishijwe
articles.text:
kirengerwa mu gihe cy’imyaka 10 ibarwa
uhereye ku itariki ubusabe bw’iyandikwa
bwatangiweho.
(2) Igihe cyo kurengera ikimenyetso
ndangahantu cyandikishijwe gishobora
guhora cyongererwa igihe cy’inyongera
kimara imyaka 10, iyo bisabwe n’ufite
uburenganzira ku kimenyetso ndangahantu
cyandikishijwe. Kongera igihe cyo
kurengera ikimenyetso ndangahantu
cyandikishijwe byishyurirwa amafaranga
yagenwe.
(3) Icyakora, hatangwa igihe cy’imbabazi
kingana n’amezi atandatu cyo kwishyura
amafaranga yo kongera igihe cyo
kurengera ikimenyetso ndangahantu
cyandikishijwe nyuma y’itariki ntarengwa
yo kwishyuriraho. Ubwishyu bukozwe mu
gihe cy’imbabazi bwiyongeraho
amafaranga y’inyongera yagenwe.
(4) Iyo amafaranga yo kongerera ikimenyetso
ndangahantu atishyuwe, kurengera
ikimenyetso ndangahantu cyandikishijwe
bitakaza agaciro.
UMUTWE WA VIII: INGINGO
ZIHURIWEHO KU MUTUNGO BWITE
MU BY’INGANDA

articles.heading: Umuntu wemerewe kwandikisha umutungo bwite mu by’inganda Uwemerewe kwandikisha umutungo bwite mu
articles.text:
by’inganda ni:
(a) umunyarwanda utuye muri Repubulika
y’u Rwanda cyangwa ikigo gifite
ubuzimagatozi gifite icyicaro gikuru
muri Repubulika y’u Rwanda cyangwa
ikigo cy’ubucuruzi cyangwa uruganda
bigaragara kandi bikorera muri
Repubulika y’u Rwanda;
(b) umwenegihugu w’igihugu cyemeye
Amasezerano y’i Paris yerekeye
kurengera umutungo bwite mu
by’inganda cyangwa umwenegihugu
w’igihugu kiri mu Muryango
Mpuzamahanga w’Ubucuruzi ku
bireba ubusabe ubwo ari bwo bwose
bwashyikirijwe ubuyobozi bubifitiye
ububasha n’ikurikizwa
ry’uburenganzira bwabo muri
Repubulika y’u Rwanda;
(c) umwenegihugu w’igihugu kitemeye
Amasezerano y’i Paris yerekeye
kurengera umutungo bwite mu
by’inganda n’umwenegihugu
w’igihugu kitari mu Muryango
Mpuzamahanga w’Ubucuruzi
ubarizwa cyangwa ufite ikigo
cy’inganda cyangwa cy’ubucuruzi
kigaragara ariko gikorera muri kimwe
mu bihugu byemeye Amasezerano y’i
Paris cyangwa kiri mu Muryango
Mpuzamahanga w’Ubucuruzi ku
bireba ubusabe ubwo ari bwo bwose
bwashyikirijwe ubuyobozi bubifitiye
ububasha n’ikurikizwa
ry’uburenganzira bwabo muri
Repubulika y’u Rwanda;
(d) umuntu utavugwa mu gaka ka (a), aka
(b) n’aka (c) tw’iyi ngingo ashobora
gusaba iyandikwa cyangwa kurengera
umutungo bwite mu by’inganda bitewe
n’inyungu bifitiye u Rwanda cyangwa
mu gihe igihugu akomokamo cyangwa
abarizwamo kirengera abanyarwanda
mu buryo buhwanye n’uko kirengera
abenegihugu bacyo.

articles.heading: Intumwa yabiherewe uruhushya mu byerekeye umutungo bwite mu by’inganda (1) Usaba iyandikwa cyangwa utanze ubusabe
articles.text:
bw’icyemezo ku mutungo bwite mu
by’inganda utuye muri Repubulika y’u
Rwanda ashobora guhagararirwa
n’intumwa yabiherewe uruhushya
n’ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha.
(2) Usaba udatuye muri Repubulika y’u
Rwanda cyangwa icyicaro gikuru
cy’ubucuruzi bwe kikaba kiri hanze ya
Repubulika y’u Rwanda ahagararirwa
n’intumwa yahawe uruhushya
n’ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha mu
byerekeye umutungo bwite mu by’inganda
bwo gukora umwuga wayo muri
Repubulika y’u Rwanda.
(3) Usaba iyandikwa yifashishije intumwa
yabiherewe uruhushya mu byerekeye
umutungo bwite mu by’inganda ku busabe
ubwo ari bwo bwose, amenyesha
ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha mu
nyandiko intumwa yagennye.
(4) Iteka rya Minisitiri rigena ibisabwa ku
mikorere y’intumwa mu byerekeye
umutungo bwite mu by’inganda
n’imiterere y’inyandiko itanga ububasha.

articles.heading: Gutanga amakuru n’inyandiko ku busabe bwakorewe mu mahanga yerekeye umutungo bwite mu by’inganda
articles.text:
(1) Usaba kurengera umutungo bwite mu
by’inganda muri Repubulika y’u Rwanda
usa n’uwo yatangiye ubusabe mu mahanga
agaragariza ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha
itariki na nomero by’ubusabe yatanze mu
mahanga.
(2) Ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha bushobora
gusaba uwasabye gutanga inyandiko
zikurikira:
(a) kopi y’inyandiko yerekeye
ibyagezweho n’ubushakashatsi
cyangwa isuzuma ryakozwe ku
byerekeye ubusabe bwakorewe mu
mahanga ;
(b) kopi y’urupapuro mpamo yemejwe ko
ihuye n’urupapuro mpamo
rwerekeranye no kurengera umutungo
bwite mu by’inganda rwatanzwe
hakurikijwe ubusabe bwakorewe mu
mahanga;
(c) kopi y’icyemezo cya burundu
kigaragaza ko ubusabe bwanzwe
hakurikijwe ubusabe bwakorewe mu
mahanga;
(d) kopi y’icyemezo cya burundu gitesha
agaciro umutungo bwite mu
by’inganda cyangwa urundi
rupapurompamo rwerekeranye no
kurengera umutungo bwite mu
by’inganda.

articles.heading: Uburenganzira ku mutungo bwite mu by’inganda Umuntu ufite umutungo bwite mu by’inganda agira uburenganzira bwihariye kuri uwo
articles.text: mutungo ari uko wandikishijwe.

articles.heading: Gutanga icyemezo cy’iyakira ry’ubusabe bw’iyandikwa ry’umutungo bwite mu by’inganda Ubusabe bw’iyandikwa ry’umutungo bwite
articles.text:
mu by’inganda bwujuje ibisabwa, buhesha
uwasabye uburenganzira bwo guhabwa
icyemezo cy’iyakira ry’ubusabe gitangwa
n’ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha kigaragaza
ibi bikurikira:
(a) itariki n’isaha ubusabe bwatangiweho;
(b) inomero y’ubusabe;
(c) n’andi makuru akenewe agenwa
n’ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha.

articles.heading: Uburenganzira bwo gutanga abandi (1) Ubusabe bwo kwandikisha umutungo bwite mu by’inganda bushobora kuba
articles.text:
bukubiyemo ubusabe bw’uburenganzira
bwo gutanga abandi hakurikijwe
Amasezerano y’i Paris cyangwa andi
masezerano mpuzamahanga yemejwe n’u
Rwanda.
(2) Ubusabe bwo gutanga abandi bushobora
gutangwa hashingiwe ku busabe bumwe
cyangwa bwinshi bwo ku rwego
rw’Igihugu, urw’Akarere cyangwa
Mpuzamahanga bwatanzwe n’usaba
cyangwa umuhagarariye mu gihugu
cyemeje amasezerano y’i Paris cyangwa
kiri mu bigize Umuryango
Mpuzamahaganga w’Ubucuruzi.
(3) Igihe cyo gutanga abandi ni amezi 12
abarwa uhereye ku itariki ubusabe bwa
A
mbere bwatangiweho busaba
uburenganzira bwo gutanga abandi.
Icyakora, igihe cyo gutanga abandi ni
amezi atandatu ku birango.

articles.heading: Ibisabwa mu gutanga ubusabe ku burenganzira bwo gutanga abandi (1) Ubusabe bwo gutanga abandi bwemerwa
articles.text:
iyo:
(a) bwerekana itariki na nomero
y’ubusabe bwabanje n’igihugu
bwatanzwemo;
(b) usaba agaragaje kopi y’ubusabe
yemejwe n’ubuyobozi bwakiriye
ubusabe bwa mbere.
(2) Mu gihe kopi y’ubusabe bwa mbere
yatanzwe iri mu rurimi rutari mu ndimi
zemewe mu butegetsi mu Rwanda, usaba
agaragaza ihindura ry’ubusabe muri
rumwe mu ndimi zemewe mu butegetsi mu
Rwanda.
(3) Iyo ubusabe butujuje ibisabwa
biteganyijwe mu gaka ka (b) k’igika cya
(1) cy’iyi ngingo, ubuyobozi bubifitiye
ububasha busaba uwasabye kuzuza
ibisabwa mu gihe kitarenze iminsi 30
ibarwa uhereye ku itariki usaba
yabimenyesherejweho.
(4) Iyo usaba atujuje ibisabwa mu gihe
giteganywa mu gika cya (3) cy’iyi ngingo
ubwo busabe ntibwemerwa.

articles.heading: Agaciro ko gutanga abandi Ubusabe butanzwe bukubiyemo ubusabe bw’uburenganzira bwo gutanga abandi muri
articles.text:
Repubulika y’u Rwanda hakurikijwe
ibiteganywa mu ngingo ya 255 y’iri tegeko,
butesha agaciro ubusabe bwakorewe muri
Repubulika y’u Rwanda busa nabwo niyo haba
harakozwe ibikorwa birimo itangazwa
cyangwa gukoresha umutungo bwite mu
by’inganda bireba.

articles.heading: Kuvanaho ubusabe bw’iyandikwa ry’umutungo bwite mu by’inganda (1) Uwatanze ubusabe bwo kwandikisha
articles.text:
umutungo bwite mu by’inganda ashobora
kubuvanaho igihe cyose bugisuzumwa
bikozwe mu nyandiko ishyikirizwa
ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha.
(2) Iyo ubusabe bwavanyweho, ubundi busabe
bushobora gutangwa kuri uwo mutungo
bwite mu by’inganda bireba. Iyo ubwo
busabe bundi bukozwe bufatwa nk’aho ari
ubwa mbere kuri uwo mutungo bwite mu
by’inganda bireba.
(3) Uburenganzira bwo gutanga abandi
ntibutangwa hashingiwe ku busabe
bwavanyweho.

articles.heading: Gukosora amakosa (1) Ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha busaba uwatanze ubusabe mu nyandiko gukosora
articles.text:
amakosa y’imyandikire arimo ayakozwe
mu guhindura mu ndimi, ukwibeshya
biboneka mu busabe cyangwa mu
nyandiko yabushyikirijwe mu gihe
bidahindura ireme ry’ubusabe.
(2) Igihe cyose bibaye ngombwa, uwatanze
ubusabe ashobora gusaba mu nyandiko
ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha
uburenganzira bwo gukosora amakosa
y’imyandikire avugwa mu gika cya (1)
cy’iyi ngingo.

articles.heading: Kongera igihe (1) Ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha bubisabwe n’umuntu ubifitemo inyungu kandi ku
articles.text:
mpamvu zumvikana bushobora kongera
igihe kingana n’igiteganyijwe muri iri
tegeko ku byerekeye gukosora amakosa ari
mu busabe, kuzuza dosiye y’ubusabe,
kujuririra icyemezo, itambamira cyangwa
ivanwaho ry’uburenganzira kubera
kudakoresha umutungo bwite mu
by’inganda.
(2) Ubusabe bwo kongeresha igihe bukorwa
mu nyandiko iherekejwe n’ikimenyetso
kigaragaza impamvu zo kongeresha igihe
bigakorwa mbere y’uko igihe
cyateganyijwe kirangira, hamaze
kwishyurwa amafaranga yagenwe.

articles.heading: Kubika Rejisitiri zandikwamo umutungo bwite mu by’inganda (1) Ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha bubika
Guhuza amakuru n’igihe (1) Ufite uburenganzira ku mutungo bwite mu by’inganda wandikishijwe amenyesha
articles.text:
ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha impinduka
kuri ibi bikurikira:
(a) aderesi y’ufite uburenganzira ku
mutungo bwite mu by’inganda;
(b) intumwa mu byerekeye umutungo
bwite mu by’inganda yabiherewe
uruhushya;
(c) n’andi makuru yo mu rwego
rw’ubutegetsi adashingiye ku ireme
asabwa.
(2) Ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha buhuza
amakuru n’igihe muri rejisitiri
yabugenewe.
(3) Guhuza amakuru n’igihe byishyurirwa
amafaranga yagenwe.

articles.heading: Gusubizaho uburenganzira (1) Ufite uburenganzira ku mutungo bwite mu by’inganda watakaje uburenganzira kuri
articles.text:
uwo mutungo kubera kutongeresha igihe
cyo kuwurengera mu gihe giteganywa
muri iri tegeko ku mpamvu yumvikana,
ashobora gusaba ubuyobozi bubifitiye
ububasha gusubizwa uburenganzira.
(2) Gusaba gusubizwa uburenganzira bikorwa
mu nyandiko mu gihe kitarenze amezi 12
abarwa uhereye ku itariki ntarengwa wo
kongeresha igihe kandi hamaze
kwishyurwa amafaranga yagenwe.

articles.heading: Ihame ry’uwatanze abandi gutanga ubusabe Iyo abantu barenze umwe bahuriye ku buvumbuzi, ku buvumbuzi bucirirtse, ku
articles.text:
gishushanyo n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa mu
nganda, igishushanyo ndangamiterere
cy’urusobekerane rw’imiyoboro yo mu rwego
rwa elegitoroniki cyangwa ikirango ariko buri
wese yabikoze ukwe, mu gutanga itariki
y’ubusabe hubahirizwa ihame ry’uwatanze
abandi mu gutanga ubusabe.

articles.heading: Ufite uburenganzira ku mutungo bwite mu by’inganda wakozwe mu gihe cyo gushyira mu bikorwa amasezerano y’umurimo
articles.text:
(1) Iyo ubuvumbuzi, ubuvumbuzi buciriritse,
igishushanyo n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa
mu nganda cyangwa igishushanyo
ndangamiterere cy’urusobekerane
rw’imiyoboro yo mu rwego rwa
elegitoroniki bikozwe n’umukozi mu gihe
cyo gushyira mu bikorwa amasezerano
y’umurimo, uburenganzira bwo gusaba
iyandikwa cyangwa icyemezo buba ari
ubw’umukoresha, keretse iyo biteganyijwe
ukundi mu masezerano y’umurimo.
(2) Iyo ubuvumbuzi, ubuvumbuzi buciriritse,
igishushanyo n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa
mu nganda cyangwa igishushanyo
ndangamiterere cy’urusobekerane
rw’imiyoboro yo mu rwego rwa
elegitoroniki bifite agaciro mu
by’ubukungu karenze ako impande zombi
zateganyaga mu gihe hakorwaga
amasezerano y’umurimo, umukozi agira
uburenganzira ku gihembo gikwiranye
n’agaciro k’ubuvumbuzi, ubuvumbuzi
buciritse, igishushanyo n’icyitegererezo
bikoreshwa mu nganda cyangwa
igishushanyo ndangamiterere
cy’urusobekerane rw’imiyoboro yo mu
rwego rwa elegitoroniki.

articles.heading: Ufite uburenganzira ku mutungo bwite mu by’inganda wakozwe bidateganyijwe mu masezerano y’umurimo
articles.text:
(1) Umukozi afite uburenganzira bwo gusaba
iyandikwa ry’icyemezo cy’ubuvumbuzi,
ubuvumbuzi buciritse, cyangwa iyandikwa
ry’igishushanyo n’icyitegererezo
bikoreshwa mu nganda cyangwa
igishushanyo ndangamiterere
cy’urusobekerane rw’imiyoboro yo mu
rwego rwa elegitoroniki iyo yabikoze:
(a) atabitegetswe n’amasezerano
y’umurimo;
(b) mu rwego rw’ibikorwa by’umukoresha
we;
(c) yifashishije amakuru, uburyo cyangwa
ubumenyi yungutse muri ako kazi.
(2) Iyo umukoresha agaragarije umukozi ko
afite inyungu kuri ubwo buvumbuzi,
ubuvumbuzi buciriritse, igishushanyo
n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa mu nganda
cyangwa igishushanyo ndangamiterere
cy’urusobekerane rw’imiyoboro yo mu
rwego rwa elegitoroniki ashobora gusaba
guhabwa uburenganzira bwose cyangwa
bumwe muri bwo ku buvumbuzi,
ubuvumbuzi buciriritse, igishushanyo
n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa mu nganda
cyangwa igishushanyo ndangamiterere
cy’urusobekerane rw’imiyoboro yo mu
rwego rwa elegitoroniki, umukozi ahawe
ingurane y’igihembo yumvikanyeho
n’umukoresha.
(3) Iyo umukozi n’umukoresha badashoboye
kumvikana, biyambaza urukiko rubifitiye
ububasha.

articles.heading: Gukoresha icyemezo cy’umutungo bwite mu by’inganda nk’ubwishingizi cyangwa ingwate Icyemezo cy’umutungo bwite mu by’inganda
articles.text:
gishobora gutangwaho ubwishingizi cyangwa
ingwate.

articles.heading: Izungurwa ry’uburenganzira ku mutungo bwite mu by’inganda Uburenganzira bwihariwe ku buvumbuzi, ku
articles.text:
buvumbuzi buciriritse, ku gishushanyo
n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa mu nganda, ku
gishushanyo ndangamiterere
cy’urusobekerane rw’imiyoboro yo mu rwego
rwa elegitoroniki no ku kirango bushobora
kuzungurwa.
UMUTWE WA IX: GUKUMIRA
IBIKORWA BY’IHIGANWA BIRIMO
UBURIGANYA
Icyiciro cya mbere: Amahame rusange

articles.heading: Gukumira ihiganwa ririmo uburiganya Igikorwa cy’ubucuruzi, icy’inganda cyangwa icy’ubugeni gikomoka ku mutungo bwite mu
articles.text:
by’ubwenge urengewe kirindwa ihiganwa
ririmo uburiganya.
Icyiciro cya 2: Ibikorwa by’ihiganwa ririmo
uburiganya

articles.heading: Ibikorwa by’ihiganwa ririmo uburiganya Mu kurengera umutungo bwite mu by’ubwenge, ibikorwa bikurikira bifatwa
Gutera urujijo mu kigo cy’undi cyangwa mu mirimo ye (1) Igikorwa cyangwa imigirire mu mirimo
articles.text:
y’inganda cyangwa iy’ubucuruzi bitera
cyangwa bikaba bishobora gutera urujijo,
mu kigo cy’ukora imirimo imwe cyangwa
ibicuruzwa bimwe nk’iby’undi cyangwa
umuntu cyangwa ibikorwa bye mu rwego
rw’ibyatunganyijwe cyangwa imirimo
itangwa n’ikigo, igize igikorwa
cy’ihiganwa ririmo uburiganya gitera
urujijo.
(2) Urujijo rushobora kugaragarira muri ibi
bikurikira:
(a) ikirango cyandikishijwe cyangwa
kitandikishijwe;
(b) izina ry’ubucuruzi;
(c) ikimenyetso cyihariye cy’ubucuruzi,
kitari ikirango cyangwa kitari izina
ry’ubucuruzi;
(d) isura y’icyatunganyijwe;
(e) imiterere y’icyatunganyijwe cyangwa
y’umurimo;
(f) ukwamamara cyangwa ukumenyekana
kw’akarango mpisho.

articles.heading: Amagambo atesha agaciro ikigo cy’undi cyangwa ibikorwa bye (1) Amagambo y’ibinyoma cyangwa afifitse
articles.text:
atesha agaciro cyangwa ashobora gutesha
agaciro imirimo y’inganda cyangwa
y’ubucuruzi y’ikigo cy’ukora imirimo
imwe cyangwa ibicuruzwa bimwe
n’iby’undi cyangwa umuntu cyangwa
ibikorwa bye, mu rwego
rw’ibyatunganyijwe n’imirimo bitangwa
n’icyo kigo, afatwa nk’igikorwa
cy’ihiganwa ririmo uburiganya ritesha
agaciro ikigo cy’undi cyangwa ibikorwa
bye.
(2) Gutesha agaciro bishobora gukorwa
binyuze mu iyamamaza cyangwa
imenyekanisha mu rwego rw’ubucuruzi
kandi bikaba bishingiye kuri ibi bikurikira:
(a) uburyo icyatunganyijwe cyakozwemo;
(b) ubushobozi bwihariye
bw’icyatunganyijwe cyangwa
umurimo mu gukora icyo byagenewe;
(c) ubuziranenge cyangwa ubwinshi
cyangwa utundi turango
tw’icyatunganyijwe;
(d) uburyo ibyatunganyijwe cyangwa
imirimo bigezwa ku bantu cyangwa
bitangwa;
(e) ikiguzi cy’ibyatunganyijwe, imirimo
cyangwa uburyo bwo kubibara.

articles.heading: Igikorwa cyo kujijisha rubanda (1) Ikimenyetso cyangwa amagambo ajijisha cyangwa ashobora kujijisha rubanda ku
articles.text:
byerekeye ikigo n’imirimo yacyo,
by’umwihariko ibyatunganyijwe
n’imirimo imwe cyangwa ibicuruzwa
bimwe n’iby’undi, ikigo gikora mu rwego
rw’imirimo y’inganda n’iy’ubucuruzi
bifatwa nk’ibikorwa by’ihiganwa ririmo
uburiganya bijijisha rubanda.
(2) Igikorwa cyo kujijisha rubanda gishobora
gukomoka ku iyamamaza cyangwa
imenyekanisha mu rwego rw’ubucuruzi
kandi kikaba gishingiye kuri ibi bikurikira:
(a) uburyo icyatunganyijwe cyakozwemo;
A
(b) ubushobozi bwihariye
bw’icyatunganyijwe cyangwa imirimo
mu gukora icyo byagenewe;
(c) ubuziranenge cyangwa ubwinshi
cyangwa utundi turango
tw’icyatunganyijwe;
(d) imiterere y’icyatunganyijwe,
ibishushanyo, ibirango
n’impamyabuvumbuzi by’ukora
imirimo cyangwa ikigo gikora imirimo
nk’iy’ikindi kigo;
(e) aho icyatunganyijwe cyangwa imirimo
bikomoka;
(f) uburyo ibyatunganyijwe cyangwa
imirimo bigezwa ku bantu cyangwa
bitangwa;
(g) ikiguzi cy’ibyatunganyijwe cyangwa
cy’imirimo cyangwa uburyo bwo
kubibara.

articles.heading: Igikorwa cyanduza isura cyangwa gitesha agaciro ikigo cy’undi cyangwa ibikorwa bye (1) Igikorwa cyanduza isura cyangwa gitesha
articles.text:
agaciro ikigo cy’undi cyangwa ibikorwa
bye, gifatwa nk’igikorwa cy’ihiganwa
ririmo uburiganya iyo igikorwa usanga ko
mu mirimo y’inganda cyangwa
y’ubucuruzi ari igikorwa cyangwa
imigirire ihungabanya isura cyangwa
gitesha agaciro ukora imirimo imwe
cyangwa ibicuruzwa bimwe nk’iby’undi
cyangwa undi muntu n’ubwo icyo gikorwa
cyangwa iyo migirire byaba bidatera
urujijo.
(2) Guhungabanya isura cyangwa gutesha
agaciro bishobora guturuka
by’umwihariko ku gusisibiranya isura
cyangwa ubwamamare bijyana na:
(a) ikirango cyandikishijwe cyangwa
kirengewe kubera ubwamamare
kitandikishijwe;
(b) izina ry’ubucuruzi;
(c) ikimenyetso cyihariye cy’ubunyemari,
kitari ikirango cyangwa kitari izina
ry’ubucuruzi;
(d) isura y’icyatunganyijwe;
(e) imiterere y’icyatunganyijwe cyangwa
y’umurimo;
(f) ubwamamare cyangwa imenyekana
ry’akarango mpisho.
(3) Muri iyi ngingo, “gusisibiranya isura
cyangwa gutesha agaciro” bivuga
kugabanya imbaraga n’akamaro
by’akarango kihariye cyangwa agaciro
kamenyekanisha ikirango, izina
ry’ubucuruzi cyangwa ikindi kimenyetso
cyihariye cy’ubunyemari, isura
y’icyatunganyijwe, imiterere yacyo
cyangwa umurimo cyangwa ubwamamare
cyangwa imenyekana ry’akarango mpisho.

articles.heading: Ikoreshwa ry’ubumenyi ngiro bwa tekiniki bw’undi utabifitiye uruhushya Igikorwa cyo gukoresha nta ruhushya,
articles.text:
ubuvumbuzi, ubuvumbuzi buciriritse,
igishushanyo n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa mu
nganda, ikirango, indemeko n’uruhurirane bya
tekiniki cyangwa imikorere y’umuntu ukora
imirimo imwe cyangwa ibicuruzwa bimwe
nk’iby’undi cyangwa uko ikindi kigo gikora
ibintu gifatwa nk’igikorwa cy’ihiganwa ririmo
uburiganya.

articles.heading: Igikorwa cy’ihiganwa kirimo uburiganya ku byerekeye amakuru y’ibanga (1) Igikorwa cyangwa imigirire bituma undi
articles.text:
muntu amenya amakuru y’ibanga, akagera
cyangwa agakoresha ayo makuru
atabiherewe uruhushya n’umuntu
wemerewe n’amategeko gutunga ayo
makuru kandi bigakorwa ku buryo
bunyuranyije n’imigirire y’ubucuruzi
buzira ubuhemu bifatwa nk’igikorwa
cy’ihiganwa ririmo uburiganya mu rwego
rw’inganda n’ubucuruzi.
(2) Guhishura, kugera no gukoresha amakuru
y’ibanga utabifitiye uruhushya bishobora
guterwa by’umwihariko n’impamvu
zikurikira:
(a) ubutasi mu nganda no mu bucuruzi;
(b) gusesa amasezerano;
(c) ubuhemu;
(d) gushishikariza gukora kimwe mu
bikorwa bivugwa mu duka kuva ku ka
(a) kugeza ku ka (c) tw’iki gika;
(e) kugera ku makuru y’ibanga bikozwe
n’uruhande rwari ruzi ko kimwe mu
bikorwa bivugwa mu duka kuva ku ka
(a) kugeza ku ka (d) tw’iki gika cyari
cyaratangiye mu gihe cy’imenyekana
ry’ayo makuru, cyangwa rwerekanaga
ko rutabizi.
(3) Muri iyi ngingo, inkuru yitwa inkuru
y’ibanga ku mpamvu zikurikira:
(a) kuba itazwi cyangwa idashobora
kugerwaho ku buryo bworoshye bitewe
n’imiterere n’uko iyo nkuru ibitswe;
(b) kuba ifite agaciro mu bucuruzi kubera
ko iba ari ibanga;
(c) kuba nyirayo yarakoze ibishoboka
byose kugira ngo ikomeze kuba ibanga.

articles.heading: Ikirego cy’indishyi kijyanye n’ihiganwa ririmo uburiganya Ufite umutungo bwite mu by’ubwenge
articles.text:
urenganyijwe cyangwa ubona ko
uburenganzira bwe bushobora kubangamirwa
afite uburenganzira bwo kuregera urukiko
rubifitiye ububasha asaba indishyi cyangwa
guhagarikisha icyo gikorwa iyo habaye
uburiganya mu rwego rw’inganda
n’ubucuruzi, aho umunyenganda, umucuruzi,
ukora imirimo yo gutunganya cyangwa
umunyabugeni, amutesha agaciro,
amwambura abaguzi cyangwa akabangamira
ubushobozi bwe bwo gupiganwa.
