articles.heading: Ibigize uburenganzira bw’umuhanzi n’uburenganzira bushamikiyeho Ibigize uburenganzira bw’umuhanzi
Ibihangano birengerwa Ibihangano by’ubuvanganzo, iby’ubugeni cyangwa by’ubumenyi by’umwimerere
articles.text:
birengerwa birimo ibi bikurikira:
(a) ibihangano by’ubuvanganzo bigaragajwe
mu buryo bw’inyandiko kandi byerekeye
ibishushanyo byatangajwe mu buryo
ubwo aribwo bwose, harimo na
porogaramu za mudasobwa;
(b) ibiganiro mbwirwaruhame, za disikuru
ndende na za disikuru ngufi, amasomo,
inyigisho z’amadini n’ibindi bihangano
bigizwe n’amagambo kandi bivugwa;
(c) indirimbo ziherekejwe n’inyandiko
cyangwa zitayifite;
(d) ibihangano by’ikinamico biri byonyine
cyangwa bijyanye n’indirimbo;
(e) imbyino n’imikino y’amarenga;
(f) ibihangano by’iyumvabona;
(g) ibihangano by’ubugeni, harimo
n’ibishushanyo, ibishushanyishije
amarangi, ibihangano by’ubukwaruzi,
ibibajije mu maharaza, ibyanditse ku
mabuye n’ibiboshye mu misengo;
(h) ibihangano byo mu budaraza;
(i) ibihangano bishingiye ku mafoto, harimo
n’ibikoresheje ubuhanga busa
n’ubw’amafoto;
(j) ibihangano by’ubugeni mberabyombi,
harimo iby’ubukorikori cyangwa
ibyahanzwe bihereye ku buhanga
mvaruganda;
(k) ibishushanyo nsobanuro, amakarita
y’ubumenyi bw’isi, ibishushanyo ngero,
ibishushanyishije amarangi,
ibishushanyo ngereranyo, ibihangano
nyerekweshatu byerekeye ubumenyi
bw’isi, imiterere y’ubutaka, ubudaraza
cyangwa ubumenyi;
(l) ibihangano bifatiye ku bugeni nyarwanda
gakondo.

articles.heading: Ibihangano byakomotse ku bindi cyangwa ibyakusanyijwe birengerwa (1) Ibihangano byakomotse ku bindi
articles.text:
birengerwa birimo ibihangano byahinduwe
mu zindi ndimi, mu miterere,
ibyatunganyijwe n’ibyahindaguwemo
ibindi.
(2) Ibihangano byakusanyijwe birengerwa
birimo ibihangano gakondo cyangwa
ibikubiyemo ibyabayeho cyangwa
imbonwa zisanzwe byakusanyijwe
nk’inkomatanyabumenyi, ibikubiyemo
indobanure z’inyandiko, imbonwa
zakusanyijwe, byaba byarashyizwe ku
bikoresho imashini zishobora kugaragaza
cyangwa bifite indi miterere, iyo ibyo
bihangano byakusanyijwe ari ibihangano
by’ubwenge, by’umwimerere hashingiwe
ku itoranywa cyangwa ku mitunganyirize
y’ibibigize.
(3) Kurengera ibihangano byakomotse ku
bindi cyangwa ibyakusanyijwe,
ntibibangamira irengerwa ry’ibihangano
byahereweho mu gutunganya ibihangano
byabikomotseho.

articles.heading: Igihangano kirengerwa hashingiye ku ifasi Kurengera igihangano cyo mu rwego rw’ubuvanganzo, urw’ubugeni cyangwa
articles.text:
urw’ubumenyi hashingiwe ku ifasi bireba ibi
bikurikira:
(a) igihangano cy’umuhanzi cyangwa ufite
uburenganzira ku gihangano ukomoka,
utuye cyangwa ufite icyicaro muri
Repubulika y’u Rwanda;
(b) igihangano cy’iyumvabona,
cy’uwishingiye imirimo yo gukora
igihangano ukomoka, utuye cyangwa ufite
icyicaro muri Repubulika y’u Rwanda ;
(c) igihangano cyatangarijwe bwa mbere muri
Repubulika y’u Rwanda;
(d) igihangano cy’ubudaraza cyubatse ku
butaka bwa Repubulika y’u Rwanda
n’ikindi gihangano cyose cy’ubugeni kiri
ku nyubako iri ku butaka bwa Repubulika
y’u Rwanda;
(e) ibihangano birengerwa nk’uko biteganywa
n’Amasezerano ya Berne yerekeye
ibihangano by’ubuvanganzo n’ubugeni
cyangwa andi masezerano mpuzamahanga
ayo ari yo yose u Rwanda rwemeje;
(f) iyo igihugu umuhanzi akomokamo
cyangwa atuyemo kirengera ibihangano
bikomoka muri Repubulika y’u Rwanda
mu buryo buhwanye n’ubw’ibyabo.

articles.heading: Ibihangano bitarengerwa Kurengera ibihangano ntibireba
articles.text:
(a) inyandiko za Leta zerekeye amategeko,
ubuyobozi n’ubucamanza n’inyandiko
zazo zahinduwe mu zindi ndimi ku buryo
bwemewe;
(b) amakuru y’umunsi cyangwa amakuru
yerekeye ibintu binyuranye bifite imiterere
y’ibintu bisanzwe by’amakuru yo mu
itangazamakuru ;
(c) igitekerezo, uburyo bwo gukora, imiterere,
uburyo bw’imikoreshereze, ibisobanuro,
amahame, ibyavumbuwe cyangwa
imbonwa zisanzwe, n’iyo ibyo byaba
byatangajwe, byagaragarijwe imiterere,
byasobanuwe, byatangiwe ingero cyangwa
byashyizwe mu gihangano.

articles.heading: Ibishingirwaho mu kurengera igihangano (1) Igihangano kirengerwa iyo ari umwimerere
articles.text:
(2) Igihangano cy’umwimerere kirengerwa
cyaba cyandikishijwe cyangwa
kitandikishijwe.
(3) Kurengera igihangano cy’umwimerere
bitangira kuva igihangano gihimbwa, n’iyo
cyaba kitarashyizwe ku gikoresho gifatika.
(4) Igihangano cy’umwimerere cyitwa ko
cyahimbwe igihe cyatangiye gutunganywa
n’iyo cyaba kitarashyirwa ahagaragara,
cyaba kitararangira cyangwa igihe
umuhanzi akikinoza.
(5) Kurengera igihangano ntibyita ku buryo
gikoze, ku miterere yacyo, ku kamaro
kacyo, ku bwiza bwacyo cyangwa ku cyo
kigamije.

articles.heading: Umwimerere w’igihangano Igihangano kiba ari umwimerere iyo gikomoka ku muhanzi, atari kopi, cyarakoranywe
articles.text: ubuhanga, imbaraga n’ubushishozi bihagije.

articles.heading: Gufatwa nk’ufite uburenganzira ku gihangano (1) Umuhanzi w’igihangano afatwa ko ari we ufite uburenganzira kuri icyo gihangano
articles.text:
(2) Umuhanzi w’igihangano kitandikishijwe
afatwa nka nyiracyo iyo bihagije kugira
ngo izina rye rigaragare kuri icyo
gihangano.
(3) Ibiteganyijwe mu gika cya (2) cy’iyi
ngingo birubahirizwa n’iyo izina ari
irihimbano mu gihe ridatera urujijo mu
kumenyekanisha ufite uburenganzira ku
gihangano.
(4) Iyo igihangano kitanditseho izina
ry’uwagihanze cyangwa cyanditseho izina
ry’irihimbano mu gihe ritera urujijo,
uwatangaje icyo gihangano n’izina rye
rikaba rigaragara ku gihangano, iyo nta
kimenyetso kibivuguruza, afatwa
nk’uhagarariye umuhanzi, bikanamuhesha
uburenganzira bwo kubahiriza no gutuma
abandi bubahiriza uburenganzira
bw’umuhanzi ndetse no kuba yatanga
ikirego mu gihe uburenganzira
buhungabanyijwe.
(5) Ibiteganyijwe mu gika cya (4) cy’iyi
ngingo ntibikurikizwa iyo umuhanzi
yamenyekanishije umwirondoro we
akagaragaza n’uburenganzira afite.

articles.heading: Gutanga ubusabe bw’iyandikwa ry’igihangano (1) Ubusabe bwo kwandikisha igihangano bukorwa huzuzwa inyandiko yabugenewe
articles.text:
ishyirwaho n’ubuyobozi bubifitiye
ububasha.
(2) Gutanga ubusabe byishyurirwa
amafaranga yagenwe.

articles.heading: Kugena itariki y’ubusabe bw’iyandikwa ry’igihangano Ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha bugena itariki
articles.text:
bwakiriyeho ubusabe bw’iyandikwa
ry’igihangano nk’itariki ubusabe
bwatangiweho, bukandika igihangano
n’uburenganzira bugishamikiyeho mu gitabo
cyandikwamo uburenganzira bw’abahanzi.
Icyiciro cya 2: Uburenganzira burengerwa
Akiciro ka mbere: Uburenganzira
nyamuntu

articles.heading: Uburenganzira nyamuntu bw’umuhanzi (1) Umuhanzi w’igihangano afite uburenganzira nyamuntu bukurikira
articles.text:
(a) kwitirirwa igihangano cye,
by’umwihariko afite uburenganzira
bwo gushyira izina rye ku gihangano
cyangwa kuri kopi y’igihangano,
ndetse iyo bishobotse no ku buryo
busanzwe, iyo igihangano cye
cyakoreshejwe cyerekanwa mu
ruhame;
(b) kwanga ko igihangano cye cyangizwa,
cyononwa cyangwa gihindurirwa
imiterere no kwanga ko igihangano cye
cyahungabanywa ku buryo ubwo ari
bwo bwose iyo bibangamira icyubahiro
cye cyangwa uko asanzwe azwi mu
bandi;
(c) kudatangaza amazina ye cyangwa
gukoresha izina ry’irihimbano.
(2) Uburengenzira nyamuntu bw’umuhanzi
ntibushobora kwegurirwa undi muntu
cyangwa gutangwaho uruhushya.
kiciro ka 2: Uburenganzira mu bukungu

articles.heading: Uburenganzira mu bukungu bw’umuhanzi (1) Umuhanzi afite uburenganzira bwihariye bwo gukora cyangwa bwo gutanga
articles.text:
uruhushya rwo gukora ibikorwa bikurikira:
(a) gutubura igihangano cye;
(b) guhindura igihangano cye mu zindi
ndimi;
(c) guhindura imiterere, imitunganyirize
y’igihangano cye mu bundi buryo
cyangwa kukibyazamo ibindi bintu;
(d) gukodesha, gutiza, gutanga uruhushya
rwo gukodesha cyangwa urwo gutiza
rubanda igihangano cye
cy’umwimerere, kopi y’igihangano
cy’iyumvabona, kopi y’igihangano
cyashyizwe kuri fonogaramu n’iya
porogaramu ya mudasobwa, keretse
iyo uko gukodesha cyangwa gutiza ari
ku mpamvu z’uburezi cyangwa
zitagamije inyungu bikozwe mu
nyungu z’abaturage muri rusange;
(e) gukwirakwiza cyangwa gutanga
uruhushya rwo gukwirakwiza muri
rubanda igihangano cy’umwimerere
cyangwa kopi y’igihangano cye ngo
kigurishwe;
(f) guhererekanya uburenganzira ku
gihangano;
(g) gutangaza igihangano cye mu ruhame
akoresheje uburyo ubwo ari bwo
bwose, harimo kugisakaza cyangwa
kugikina mu ruhame.
(2) Uburenganzira bwo gukwirakwiza
igihangano ntibukurikizwa ku mwimerere
cyangwa kuri kopi y’igihangano
cyashyizwe ku isoko cyangwa
cyagurishijwe cyangwa irindi hererekanya
ry’uburenganzira ryatangiwe uruhushya
n’ufite uburenganzira ku gihangano.
(3) Iyo ari igihangano cy’igishushanyo
cyangwa imiterere y’ikintu cyagaragajwe
mu buryo bw’ibyerekezo bitatu
by’ubugeni cyangwa inyandiko y’intoki
y’umwimerere, ufite uburenganzira ku
gihangano cyangwa abazungura be bafite
uburenganzira ntavogerwa bwo guhabwa
umugabane ku giciro gishya igihangano
cyagurishijweho nyuma y’uko ufite
uburenganzira ku gihangano yeguriye undi
muntu uburenganzira kuri icyo gihangano.
(4) Ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha bugena
ingano y’umugabane ku giciro gishya
igihangano cyagurishijweho.

articles.heading: Uburenganzira mu bukungu ku gihangano cyakomotse ku muco gakondo (1) Ibikorwa bikurikira byishyurirwa
articles.text:
igihembo cy’uruhushya iyo:
(a) gukoresha igihangano cyakomotse ku
muco gakondo w’igihugu hagamijwe
inyungu;
(b) ihererekanya ry’uburenganzira ku
gihangano cyose cyangwa ku gice
cyacyo, hagamijwe inyungu ku
gihangano cyakomotse ku muco
gakondo cyangwa gutanga uruhushya
rwihariye rujyanye n’igihangano
giteye gityo, hagamijwe inyungu.
(2) Ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha bugena
igihembo cy’uruhushya mu gukoresha
cyangwa ihererekanya ry’uburenganzira
ku gihangano cyakomotse ku muco
gakondo hagamijwe inyungu n’uburyo
yishyurwamo.
(3) Makumyabiri na gatanu ku ijana
by’igihembo cy’uruhushya icyo ari cyo
cyose cyishyuwe giharirwa gutera inkunga
ibikorwa bigamije guteza imbere
ibihangano by’ubuhanzi.
Akiciro ka 3: Aho uburenganzira mu
bukungu ku gihangano bugarukira

articles.heading: Gutubura igihangano hagamijwe ko gikoreshwa n’umuntu ku giti cye (1) Gutubura igihangano cyatangajwemo kopi
articles.text:
imwe gusa, hagamijwe ko ikoreshwa
n’umuntu ku giti cye biremewe
bidatangiwe uruhushya rw’umuhanzi, nta
n’igihembo cy’uruhushya gitanzwe.
(2) Icyakora, ibivugwa mu gika cya (1) cy’iyi
ngingo ntibireba gutubura:
(a) igihangano cyo mu budaraza gifite
isura y’inzu cyangwa iy’izindi
nyubako zisa na cyo;
(b) hakoreshejwe ikoporora, igitabo cyose
uko cyakabaye cyangwa igice cyacyo
cy’ingenzi cyangwa kwandukura
indirimbo mu buryo
bw’iyandikishamanota;
(c) ububiko bwose bw’imbonwa cyangwa
ibice byabwo by’ingenzi,
hakoreshejwe iyandikishamibare;
(d) porogaramu za mudasobwa.

articles.heading: Gutubura igihangano by’igihe gito byemewe Gutubura igihangano by’igihe gito byemerwa iyo
articles.text:
(a) bikozwe mu gihe cyo kohereza igihangano
hakoreshejwe iyandikishamibare cyangwa
mu bikorwa byo kugaragaza igihangano
cyabitswe hakoreshejwe
iyandikishamibare;
(b) bikozwe n’umuntu ku giti cye wabiherewe
uruhushya cyangwa ikigo gifite
uburenganzira bwo kohereza icyo
gihangano cyangwa kukigaragaza;
(c) bifite agaciro ko hasi ukurikije
ibyoherejwe, bigakorwa mu buryo
busanzwe bukoreshwa n’ibyuma
byabugenewe, kandi bigahita bisibwa ku
buryo igihangano kitakongera
kugaragazwa hakoreshejwe uburyo bwa
elegitoroniki, hagamijwe kugikoresha
ibindi uretse ibiteganyijwe n’agaka ka (a)
n’aka (b) tw’iyi ngingo.

articles.heading: Ubwisanzure mu gukoresha ibango ry’igihangano cyatangajwe (1) Gukoresha mu buryo bwo gutira ibango
articles.text:
cyangwa igice gito cy’igihangano
cyatangajwe rigashyirwa mu kindi
gihangano biremewe, bidatangiwe
uruhushya n’umuhanzi nta n’igihembo
cy’uruhushya gitanzwe, iyo gukoresha iryo
bango cyangwa igice gito cy’igihangano
byatiwe byubahiriza imikoreshereze myiza
kandi ntibirenge intego zigamijwe.
(2) Gutira ibango cyangwa igice gito
cy’igihangano biherekezwa no kugaragaza
inkomoko n’izina ry’umuhanzi, iyo iryo
zina rigaragara ku gihangano iryo bango
ryakuwemo.

articles.heading: Gukoresha igihangano mu kwigisha (1) Mu gihe cyo kwigisha ibikorwa bikurikira biremewe bidatangiwe uruhushya
articles.text:
n’umuhanzi nta n’igihembo cy’uruhushya
gitanzwe iyo:
(a) ikoreshwa ry’igihangano binyuze mu
isobanura, ibiganiro by’isakaza,
ibyafatiweho amajwi cyangwa
amashusho byagenewe inyigisho;
(b) gutubura hakoreshejwe uburyo
bw’ikoporora, mu rwego rw’inyigisho
cyangwa urw’ibizamini mu bigo
by’amashuri bidafite ibikorwa
bigamije inyungu kandi ibyo
bigakorwa mu buryo buhuje n’intego
zigamijwe;
(c) inyandiko zitandukanye zatangajwe
mu buryo bwemewe n’amategeko mu
igazeti cyangwa ibinyamakuru,
amabango magufi yavuye mu
gihangano cyatangajwe mu buryo
bwemewe n’amategeko cyangwa
igihangano kigufi cyatangajwe mu
buryo bwemewe n’amategeko.
(2) Icyakora, ibikorwa bivugwa mu gika cya
(1) cy’iyi ngingo bigomba kugaragaza
inkomoko n’izina ry’umuhanzi iyo iryo
zina rigaragara ku gihangano.

articles.heading: Gutubura igihangano bikozwe na serivisi z’amasomero cyangwa iz’ishyinguranyandiko Serivisi z’amasomero cyangwa
articles.text:
iz’ishyinguranyandiko zikora ibikorwa
bitagamije inyungu z’ubucuruzi ku buryo
buziguye cyangwa butaziguye zishobora,
gutubura umubare ukenewe wa kopi
z’igihangano bidasabiwe uruhushya
rw’umuhanzi cyangwa ufite uburenganzira ku
gihangano, iyo:
(a) igihangano cyatubuwe ari inyandiko
yatangajwe, ikindi gihangano kigufi
cyangwa incamake y’igihangano;
(b) gutubura bigamije kubahiriza ubusabe
bw’umuntu ku giti cye;
(c) serivisi z’isomero cyangwa
iz’ishyinguranyandiko zibona ko kopi
izakoreshwa gusa hagamijwe inyigisho,
ubufasha buhabwa abanyeshuri mu
myigire cyangwa ubushakashatsi
bwigenga;
(d) igikorwa cyo gutubura cyihariye cyangwa
gisubiwemo mu buryo butandukanye
cyangwa budahuye kandi nta ruhushya
ruhuriweho ruhari;
(e) kopi yakozwe hagamijwe kubungabunga
cyangwa gusimbuza kopi yabuze,
yangijwe cyangwa itagishobora
gukoreshwa cyangwa iri mu bubiko
buhoraho bw’irindi somero cyangwa mu
yindi serivisi y’ishyinguranyandiko.

articles.heading: Ubwisanzure bwo gukoresha igihangano ku mpamvu zerekeye ubucamanza cyangwa ubuyobozi Gukoresha igihangano ku mpamvu zerekeye
articles.text:
ubucamanza cyangwa ubuyobozi biremewe
bidatangiwe uruhushya rw’umuhanzi kandi
ntibitangirwa igihembo cy’uruhushya, iyo
bitarenze intego zigamijwe.

articles.heading: Ubwisanzure bwo gukoresha igihangano hagamijwe amakuru (1) Ibikorwa bikurikira hagamijwe amakuru
articles.text:
ku gihangano biremewe bidatangiwe
uruhushya n’umuhanzi nta n’igihembo
cy’uruhushya gitanzwe:
(a) gutubura mu kinyamakuru cyandikwa,
gusakaza cyangwa kugeza kuri rubanda,
inyandiko ngufi yerekeye ubukungu,
politiki, imibereho myiza cyangwa
iyobokamana yatangajwe mu magazeti
cyangwa mu rwunge rw’ibinyamakuru,
cyangwa igihangano giteye nk’ibyo
cyasakajwe, mu gihe uburenganzira bwo
gutubura, bwo gusakaza cyangwa bwo
kugeza kuri rubanda butabujijwe ku buryo
bweruye;
(b) gutubura cyangwa kugeza kuri rubanda,
mu rwego rwo gutangaza mu buryo bugufi
amakuru mashya hifashishijwe amafoto,
sinema cyangwa isakaza cyangwa irindi
tumanaho rikoresha insinga ku gihangano
cyabonywe cyangwa cyumviswe mu gihe
ayo makuru yabaga, hagamijwe kugera ku
ntego yo gutangaza amakuru;
(c) gutubura mu kinyamakuru, gusakaza
cyangwa kugeza kuri rubanda, disikuru za
politiki, ibiganiro mbwirwaruhame,
disikuru ngufi, inyigisho z’amadini
cyangwa ibindi bihangano biteye nk’ibyo
byatangarijwe mu ruhame, na disikuru
zavuzwe mu iburanisha, hagamijwe kugera
ku ntego yo gutangaza amakuru agezweho,
abahanzi bakagumana uburenganzira bwo
gutangaza urusange rw’ibyo bihangano.
(2) Icyakora, ibikorwa bivugwa mu gika cya
(1) cy’iyi ngingo bigaragaza inkomoko
n’izina ry’umuhanzi iyo bishoboka.

articles.heading: Ubwisanzure bwo gukoresha amashusho cyangwa amafoto y’ibihangano biri ahantu rusange (1) Ibikorwa bikurikira byerekeye amashusho,
articles.text:
amafoto, ibihangano by’ubugeni
mberabyombi, ishusho y’igihangano cyo
mu budaraza bihora ahantu rusange
biremewe bidatangiwe uruhushya
n’umuhanzi nta n’igihembo cy’uruhushya
gitanzwe:
(a) gutubura;
(b) gusakaza;
(c) kugeza kuri rubanda hakoreshejwe
insinga.
(2) Icyakora, iyo ishusho ry’igihangano ari ryo
ry’ibanze ry’icyatubuwe, icyasakajwe
cyangwa icyagejejwe kuri rubanda, kandi
iyo shusho ikoreshejwe mu rwego
rw’ubucuruzi bisabirwa uruhushya kandi
bigatangirwa igihembo cy’uruhushya.

articles.heading: Ubwisanzure mu gutubura no guhindura imiterere ya porogaramu za mudasobwa (1) Utunze mu buryo bwemewe n’amategeko
articles.text:
kopi ya porogaramu ya mudasobwa
ashobora, bidatangiwe uruhushya
rw’umuhanzi nta n’igihembo
cy’uruhushya gitanzwe, gukora kopi imwe
y’iyo porogaramu cyangwa kuyihindurira
imiterere, mu gihe iyo kopi cyangwa iyo
porogaramu yahinduriwe imiterere
ikenewe hagamijwe:
(a) gukoresha porogaramu ya mudasobwa
ibyo yagenewe kandi bitarenze intego
zigamijwe;
(b) gushyingura no gusimbuza kopi ya
porogaramu ya mudasobwa itunzwe
mu buryo bwemewe n’amategeko, mu
gihe iyo kopi yatakaye cyangwa
yangiritse ku buryo itakoreshwa.
(2) Kopi cyangwa porogaramu yahinduriwe
imiterere ikozwe hakurikijwe igika cya (1)
cy’iyi ngingo irasibwa iyo amasezerano yo
gukomeza gutunga kopi ya porogaramu ya
mudasobwa yarangiye. Gusiba iyo
porogaramu bikorwa mu gihe kitarenze
amezi atandatu abarwa uhereye ku itariki
amasezerano yarangiriyeho.

articles.heading: Ubwisanzure bwo gufata amajwi by’igihe gito ku kigo cy’isakaza (1) Ikigo cy’isakaza gishobora hatagombye
articles.text:
uruhushya rw’umuhanzi nta n’igihembo
cy’uruhushya gitanzwe, gufata by’igihe
gito, kibyikoreye kandi hagamijwe
ibiganiro byacyo, amajwi y’igihangano
icyo kigo gifitiye uburenganzira bwo
gusakaza.
(2) Ikigo cy’isakaza kigomba gusiba amajwi
yafashwe mu gihe cy’amezi atandatu
abarwa uhereye itariki amajwi yafatiweho
iyo nta masezerano atandukanye
yabayeho.

articles.heading: Ubwisanzure mu ikinwa ry’igihangano mu ruhame Ikinwa ry’igihangano mu ruhame riremewe bidatangiwe uruhushya rw’umuhanzi kandi
articles.text:
hadatanzwe igihembo cy’uruhushya iyo
bikozwe:
(a) mu gihe cy’imihango ya Leta cyangwa
y’amadini iyo gukina igihangano mu
ruhame bitagamije inyungu;
(b) mu rwego rw’ibikorwa by’uburezi
cyangwa ubukangurambaga bukozwe
na Leta cyangwa n’ikigo kitagamije
inyungu, iyo ikinwa ry’igihangano mu
ruhame bitagamije inyungu;
(c) cyangwa mu rwego rw’ibikorwa byo
kwigisha bikozwe n’ikigo cy’uburezi,
iyo igihangano gikiniwe abakozi,
abanyeshuri cyangwa umuryango
ugizwe n’abanyeshuri cyangwa abandi
bantu bafite uruhare rutaziguye mu
bikorwa by’icyo kigo.

articles.heading: Ubwisanzure mu kwinjiza mu gihugu kopi y’igihangano ku mpamvu bwite Kwinjiza mu gihugu kopi y’igihangano
articles.text:
umuntu yabonye ku mpamvu ze bwite mu
buryo bwemewe n’amategeko biremewe
bidasabiwe uruhushya kandi nta n’igihembo
cy’uruhushya gitanzwe.

articles.heading: Ubwisanzure mu gutubura igihangano ku bafite ubumuga bwo kutabona, abatabona neza cyangwa abatabasha gusoma igitabo
articles.text:
(1) Urwego rubifite mu nshingano
rutabiherewe uruhushya n’umuhanzi
cyangwa n’ufite uburenganzira
bw’umuhanzi nta n’igihembo
cy’uruhushya gitanzwe rushobora gukora
kopi y’igihangano iri mu buryo bushobora
kugerwaho, kuvana kopi y’igihangano mu
buryo bushobora kugerwaho mu kindi kigo
kibifitiye uruhushya, no guha izo kopi
abantu bafite ubumuga bwo kutabona,
abatabona neza cyangwa abatabasha
gusoma igitabo hakoreshejwe uburyo
ubwo ari bwo bwose, harimo gutiza
bitagamije ubucuruzi cyangwa isakaza mu
buryo bwa elegitoroniki hakoreshejwe
cyangwa hadakoreshejwe insinga no
gukora ibikenewe kugira ngo ikigamijwe
kigerweho, iyo hujujwe ibisabwa
bikurikira :
(a) urwego rubifite mu nshingano rwifuza
gukora icyo gikorwa rwemerewe
n’amategeko kugera kuri icyo
gihangano cyangwa kuri kopi yacyo;
(b) igihangano gihinduwemo kopi iri mu
buryo bushobora kugerwaho,
bukubiyemo uburyo ubwo aribwo
bwose bukenewe bwo kugera kuri ayo
makuru ari mu buryo bushobora
kugerwaho, ariko hadakozwe izindi
mpinduka zitari ngombwa, kugira ngo
icyo gihangano kibashe kugerwaho
n’umuntu ufite ubumuga bwo
kutabona, ubwo kutabona neza
cyangwa ubwo kutabasha gusoma
igitabo;
(c) kopi ziri mu buryo bushobora
kugerwaho zikorerwa gusa
gukoreshwa n’abantu bafite ubumuga
bwo kutabona, ubwo kutabona neza
cyangwa ubwo kutabasha gusoma
igitabo;
(d) icyo gikorwa gikozwe hatagamijwe
inyungu.
(2) Umuntu ufite ubumuga bwo kutabona,
ubwo kutabona neza cyangwa ubwo
kutabasha gusoma igitabo cyangwa
umwunganira, atabiherewe uruhushya nta
n’igihembo cy’uruhushya gitanzwe,
ashobora gukora kopi y’igihangano iri mu
buryo bushobora kugerwaho agamije
kuyikoresha ku giti cye cyangwa imufasha
gukora cyangwa gukoresha izo kopi
z’ibihangano ziri mu buryo bushobora
kugerwaho iyo yabonye icyo gihangano
cyangwa kopi yacyo mu buryo bwemewe
n’amategeko.
(3) Ibiteganywa muri iyi ngingo bireba
ibihangano biri mu buryo bw’inyandiko,
iyandikishamanota cyangwa ibishushanyo
bijyana na byo, byaba ibyatangajwe
cyangwa ibyagejejwe kuri rubanda mu
ruhame mu buryo ubwo ari bwo bwose
bw’itangazamakuru, harimo ibihangano
byo mu buryo bw’amajwi nk’ibitabo
biherekejwe n’amajwi yafashwe. Bireba
kandi ibikoresho by’uburenganzira
bushamikiyeho bya ngombwa kugira ngo
izo kopi ziri mu miterere ituma zigerwaho
ziboneke.

articles.heading: Ubwisanzure mu gusakaza no kwinjiza mu gihugu igihangano kiri mu buryo bushobora kugerwaho ku bafite
articles.text:
ubumuga bwo kutabona, abatabona neza
cyangwa abatabasha gusoma igitabo
(1) Urwego rubifite mu nshingano rushobora
rutabiherewe uruhushya n’umuhanzi
cyangwa ufite uburenganzira ku gihangano
nta n’igihembo cy’uruhushya gitanzwe,
gukwirakwiza cyangwa gutuma kopi ziri
mu buryo bushobora kugerwaho ziboneka
iyo:
(a) izo kopi zikoreshwa mu buryo
bwihariwe n’abantu bafite ubumuga
bwo kutabona, abatabona neza
cyangwa abatabasha gusoma igitabo;
(b) hagamijwe guha mu buryo butaziguye
izo kopi umuntu ufite ubumuga bwo
kutabona, utabona neza cyangwa
utabasha gusoma igitabo wo mu kindi
gihugu cyemeje Amasezerano ya
Marrakeshi;
(c) Uruhushya rwatanzwe rurakurikizwa
bipfa kuba mbere yo gusakaza
cyangwa gutuma ikigo gifite
uburenganzira gikomokaho icyo
gihangano kitari kizi cyangwa nta
mpamvu zumvikana ko cyagombaga
kumenya ko iyo kopi iri mu buryo
bushobora kugerwaho, ishobora
kubonwa yagombaga gukoreshwa
n’abandi bantu batari abafite ubumuga
bwo kutabona, utabona neza cyangwa
utabasha gusoma igitabo.
(2) Iryo kwirakwiza cyangwa ishyirwa
ahagaragara rya kopi iri mu buryo
bushobora kugerwaho rigarukira:
(a) ku bintu bimwe na bimwe bifite
umwihariko;
(b) ku bintu bitanyuranyije no kubyaza
umusaruro mu buryo busanzwe
igihangano cyangwa igikoresho gifite
uburenganzira bushamikiye kuri icyo
gihangano;
(c) ku bintu bitabangamira inyungu
zemewe n’amategeko z’ufite
uburenganzira kuri icyo gihangano.
(3) Umuntu ufite ubumuga bwo kutabona,
utabona neza cyangwa utabasha gusoma
igitabo cyangwa umuntu ukora mu izina
rye cyangwa ikigo kibifitiye uburenganzira
yemerewe kwinjiza mu gihugu kopi iri mu
buryo bushobora kugerwaho bidatangiwe
uruhushya rw’umuhanzi cyangwa
urw’ufite uburenganzira bw’umuhanzi nta
n’igihembo cy’uruhushya.
(4) Ibiteganywa muri iyi ngingo bireba
ibihangano biri mu buryo bw’inyandiko,
iyandikishamanota cyangwa ibishushanyo
bijyana na byo, byaba ibyatangajwe cyangwa
ibyagejejwe kuri rubanda mu ruhame mu
buryo ubwo ari bwo bwose
bw’itangazamakuru, harimo ibihangano byo
mu buryo bw’amajwi nk’ibitabo
biherekejwe n’amajwi yafashwe. Bireba
kandi ibikoresho by’uburenganzira
bushamikiyeho bya ngombwa kugira ngo izo
kopi ziri mu miterere ituma zigerwaho
ziboneke.

articles.heading: Ibyubahirizwa mu gihe cyo gukoresha igihangano nta ruhushya Ubwisanzure mu gukoresha igihangano nta
articles.text:
ruhushya rw’ufite uburenganzira ku gihangano
buvugwa mu ngingo ya 291, iya 292, iya 293,
iya 294, iya 295, iya 296, iya 297, iya 298, iya
299, iya 300, iya 301, iya 302, iya 303 n’iya
304 z’iri Tegeko ntibubangamira
imikoreshereze isanzwe y’igihangano,
uburenganzira bushamikiyeho cyangwa
inyungu ufite uburenganzira ku gihangano
yemerewe kuri icyo gihangano.
Akiciro ka 4: Igihe kurengera
uburenganzira bw’umuhanzi bimara

articles.heading: Igihe kurengera uburenganzira nyamuntu ku gihangano bimara Uburenganzira nyamuntu ku gihangano
articles.text:
ntibugira igihe burangirira ntibusaza,
ntibuhererekanywa mu gihe umuhanzi akiriho
cyangwa yarapfuye.

articles.heading: Igihe kurengera uburenganzira mu bukungu ku gihangano bimara Uburenganzira mu bukungu ku gihangano
articles.text:
burarengerwa mu gihe cyose umuhanzi akiriho
ndetse no mu gihe kingana n’imyaka 50 nyuma
y’urupfu rwe. Igihe cyo kurengera
uburenganzira mu bukungu ku gihangano
kirangirana n’umwaka uburenganzira
bw’umuhanzi burangiriramo.

articles.heading: Igihe kurengera uburenganzira mu bukungu ku gihangano gisangiwe bimara Uburenganzira mu bukungu ku gihangano
articles.text:
gisangiwe burarengerwa mu gihe cyose uwa
nyuma mu bafatanyije guhanga akiriho no mu
gihe kingana n’imyaka 50 nyuma y’urupfu
rwe.

articles.heading: Igihe kurengera uburenganzira mu bukungu ku gihangano kitagaragaza nyiracyo cyangwa ku cyanditse ku mazina y’amahimbano bimara
articles.text:
(1) Igihangano cyatangajwe kitagaragaza
nyiracyo cyangwa cyanditse ku mazina
y’amahimbano, uburenganzira mu
bukungu burarengerwa muri kimwe mu
bihe bikurikira:
(a) mu gihe cy’imyaka 50 ibarwa uhereye ku
itariki igihangano cyahangiweho;
(b) mu gihe cy’imyaka 50 ibarwa uhereye ku
itariki icyo gihangano cyatangarijweho
bwa mbere;
(c) mu gihe cy’imyaka 50 ibarwa uhereye ku
itariki icyo gihangano cyagejejwe bwa
mbere kuri rubanda.
(2) Icyakora, iyo umwirondoro w’umuhanzi
umenyekanye cyangwa
utagishidikanywaho mbere y’irangira
ry’ibihe bivugwa mu gika cya (1) cy’iyi
ngingo, ingingo ya 307 n’iya 308
zirakurikizwa.

articles.heading: Igihe kurengera uburenganzira mu bukungu ku gihangano gihuriweho cyangwa ku gihangano cyatangajwe nyiracyo atakiriho bimara
articles.text:
Uburenganzira mu bukungu ku gihangano
gihuriweho cyangwa cyatangajwe nyiracyo
atakiriho, burengerwa mu gihe kimwe mu bihe
bikurikira:
(a) imyaka 50 ibarwa uhereye ku itariki
igihangano cyahangiweho;
(b) imyaka 50 ibarwa uhereye ku itariki
icyo gihangano cyatangarijweho bwa
mbere;
(c) imyaka 50 ibarwa uhereye ku itariki
icyo gihangano cyagejejwe kuri
rubanda.

articles.heading: Igihe kurengera uburenganzira mu bukungu ku gihangano cy’ubugeni mberabyombi bimara Uburenganzira mu bukungu ku gihangano
articles.text:
cy’ubugeni mberabyombi burengerwa mu gihe
cy’imyaka 25 ibarwa uhereye ku itariki icyo
gihangano cyahangiweho.

articles.heading: Igihe igihangano kijya mu mutungo rusange (1) Igihangano kijya mu mutungo rusange iyo
articles.text:
(a) igihe cyo kukirengera kirangiye;
(b) ufite uburenganzira ku gihangano
yaretse uburenganzira yari afite kuri
icyo gihangano.
(2) Kureka uburenganzira ku gihangano
bivugwa mu gaka ka (b) k’igika cya (1)
cy’iyi ngingo, bikorwa mu nyandiko
imenyeshwa rubanda hakoreshejwe
uburyo ubwo aribwo bwose kandi hamaze
gusuzumwa ko uko kureka uburenganzira
bitabangamira amasezerano yakozwe
mbere mu birebana n’icyo gihangano.
(3) Umuntu wese ashobora gukoresha
igihangano kiri mu mutungo rusange
hatubahirije ibiteganyijwe mu ngingo ya
289 y’iri tegeko.
Akiciro ka 5: Ufite uburenganzira mu
bukungu ku gihangano

articles.heading: Uburenganzira ku gihangano gisangiwe (1) Abafatanyije guhanga igihangano nibo ba nyiracyo kandi bafite uburenganzira
articles.text:
nyamuntu n’uburenganzira mu bukungu
kuri icyo gihangano.
(2) Iyo igihangano gisangiwe kidashobora
gukoreshwa na ba nyiracyo buri wese
ukwe, uburenganzira bw’umuhanzi buba
ari ubw’abafatanyije kugihanga, ariko buri
wese muri bo, ashobora gutanga
umugabane we no gutanga ikirego igihe
uburenganzira bw’umuhanzi
bubangamiwe.
(3) Iyo igihangano gisangiwe n’abagihanze
kigizwe n’ibice bishobora gukoreshwa
n’abagihanze buri wese ukwe, kandi
bishobora gutuburwa, gukinwa cyangwa
gukoreshwa mu bundi buryo, buri muhanzi
afite uburenganzira bujyanye n’uruhare
rwe kuri icyo gihangano, ariko
abafatanyije kugihanga bakomeza ku
gitunga bagihuriyeho cyose uko
cyakabaye.

articles.heading: Uburenganzira ku gihangano gihuriweho Ufite uburenganzira nyamuntu n’uburenganzira mu bukungu ku gihangano
articles.text:
gihuriweho ni umuntu watangije kandi
wishingiye ihangwa ry’igihangano.

articles.heading: Ufite uburenganzira ku gihangano cyahanzwe hashingiwe ku masezerano y’umurimo (1) Iyo igihangano gihanzwe n’umuhanzi
articles.text:
abikoreye umuntu yubahiriza amasezerano
y’umurimo, umuhanzi afite uburenganzira
nyamuntu ku gihangano keretse iyo
amasezerano y’umurimo abiteganya
ukundi.
(2) Uburenganzira mu bukungu bufatwa
nk’aho bweguriwe umukoresha cyangwa
umuhagarariye, iyo igihangano cyahanzwe
hashyirwa mu bikorwa amasezerano
y’umurimo agamije igikorwa cy’ubuhanzi.
(3) Icyakora, umukozi afite uburenganzira mu
bukungu ku gihangano yahanze
bidateganyijwe mu masezerano
y’umurimo.
(4) Igihangano cyahanzwe n’umukozi wa Leta
y’u Rwanda hashingiwe ku masezerano
y’umurimo, kiba ari icya Repubulika y’u
Rwanda, keretse iyo ayo masezerano
abiteganya ukundi.

articles.heading: Uburenganzira ku gihangano cyahanzwe byasabwe Iyo ihangwa ry’igihangano risabwe n’umuntu hatanzwe ingurane y’igihembo, uburenganzira
articles.text:
mu bukungu kuri icyo gihangano buba ari
ubw’uwo muntu wasabye ko hakorwa
igikorwa cyo guhanga icyo gihangano, keretse
iyo biteganyijwe ukundi mu masezerano
yanditse agenga isabwa ryo guhanga icyo
gihangano.

articles.heading: Ufite uburenganzira mu bukungu ku gihangano cy’iyumvabona (1) Uwishingiye imirimo yo gukora
articles.text:
igihangano cy’iyumvabona niwe ufite
uburenganzira mu bukungu kuri icyo
gihangano keretse iyo biteganyijwe ukundi
mu masezerano.
(2) Icyakora, abafatanyije guhanga igihangano
cy’iyumvabona n’abandi bahanzi
b’ibihangano byahanzwe mbere
byifashishijwe cyangwa byahinduwe mu
ihangwa ry’icyo gihangano
cy’iyumvabona, bagira uburenganzira mu
bukungu ku bijyanye n’uruhare rwabo
muri icyo gihangano cyangwa ku
bihangano byari bisanzweho, ku buryo
urwo ruhare rwabo cyangwa ibihangano
bisanzweho bishobora kuba mu bigize
ibikorwa bijyanye n’uburenganzira bwabo
mu rwego rw’ubukungu butandukanye
n’ubwo bafite ku gihangano
cy’iyumvabona.

articles.heading: Ufite uburenganzira mu bukungu ku gihangano cy’ifoto (1) Uwahanze igihangano cy’ifoto ni we ufite
articles.text:
uburengazira mu bukungu kuri icyo
gihangano.
(2) Icyakora, undi muntu ashobora kugira
uburenganzira mu bukungu kuri icyo
gihangano iyo yishyuye ingurane
y’igihembo yacyo binyuze mu masezerano
yanditse kandi yashyizweho umukono
n’impande zombi, keretse iyo amasezerano
abiteganya ukundi.
Akiciro ka 6: Kwegurira undi muntu
uburenganzira mu bukungu ku gihangano

articles.heading: Kwegurira undi muntu uburenganzira mu bukungu ku gihangano (1) Uburenganzira mu bukungu ku gihangano
articles.text:
ni umutungo wihariwe ushobora
kwegurirwa undi muntu uko wakabaye
cyangwa igice cyawo.
(2) Ufite uburenganzira mu bukungu ku
gihangano ashobora kubwegurira undi
muntu binyuze mu masezerano
y’ihererekanya ry’igihangano cyangwa
binyuze mu izungura.

articles.heading: Amasezerano yo kwegurira undi muntu uburenganzira mu bukungu ku gihangano (1) Amasezerano yo kwegurira undi muntu
articles.text:
uburenganzira mu bukungu ku gihangano
akubiyemo nibura ibi bikurikira:
(a) uburenganzira bwihariye
bwegurirwa undi muntu;
(b) igihe iyegurira rizamara;
(c) ifasi buzakoreshwamo, iyo
itagaragajwe bifatwa ko
ukwegurira kugomba kugarukira
mu gihugu amasezerano yo
kwegurira undi muntu
uburenganzira yakorewemo;
(d) ingano y’igihembo n’uburyo bwo
kwishyura.
(2) Amasezerano yo kwegurira undi muntu
uburenganzira mu bukungu ku gihangano
agira agaciro iyo yanditse kandi
yarashyizweho umukono n’impande
zombi.
(3) Uburenganzira mu bukungu butavuzwe mu
buryo bweruye mu masezerano bufatwa ko
buhariwe umuhanzi.

articles.heading: Ihererekanya ry’igihangano cy’umwimerere cyangwa kopi zacyo (1) Iyo umuhanzi ahaye undi muntu
articles.text:
igihangano cye cy’umwimerere cyangwa
kopi yacyo nk’impano, ntafatwa
nk’umweguriye uburenganzira bwe mu
bukungu cyangwa nk’umwemereye
gukora igikorwa icyo ari cyo cyose
cyerekeye uburenganzira bwe mu
bukungu, keretse iyo amasezerano
y’ihererekanya abiteganya ukundi.
(2) Haseguriwe ibiteganywa mu gika cya (1)
cy’iyi ngingo, ufite igihangano
cy’umwimerere cyangwa kopi yacyo mu
buryo bwemewe n’amategeko aba afite
uburenganzira bwo kucyerekanira mu
ruhame keretse iyo amasezerano
y’ihererekanya abiteganya ukundi.
(3) Uburenganzira buteganywa mu gika cya
(2) cy’iyi ngingo ntibureba umuntu ufite
igihangano cy’umwimerere cyangwa kopi
yacyo, binyuze mu bukode cyangwa mu
bundi buryo bwose, iyo atigeze
agihabwaho uburenganzira mu bukungu
n’ufite uburenganzira ku gihangano.
Akiciro ka 7: Uruhushya rw’uburenganzira
mu bukungu ku gihangano

articles.heading: Uruhushya rushingiye ku masezerano y’uburenganzira mu bukungu Umuhanzi ashobora byumvikanyweho mu
articles.text:
masezerano y’uruhushya yanditse ashyirwaho
umukono n’impande zombi, guha undi muntu
uruhushya rwihariwe, urwihariwe igice
cyangwa urutihariwe rumwemerera kugira
uruhare mu gikorwa cyose kigize
uburenganzira mu bukungu bushingiye kuri
icyo gihangano.

articles.heading: Ibikubiye mu masezerano y’uruhushya rw’uburenganzira mu bukungu ku gihangano (1) Amasezerano y’uruhushya
articles.text:
rw’uburenganzira mu bukungu ku
gihangano akubiyemo nibura ibi
bikurikira:
(a) uburenganzira bwihariye ku ruhushya
rwahawe undi muntu;
(b) igihe uruhushya ruzamara;
(c) ifasi ruzakoreshwamo. Iyo
itagaragajwe bigafatwa ko uruhushya
rugomba kugarukira mu gihugu
amasezerano yo gutanga urwo
ruhushya yakorewemo;
(d) ingano y’igihembo n’uburyo bwo
kwishyura.
(2) Uburenganzira mu bukungu butavuzwe mu
buryo bweruye mu masezerano yo gutanga
uruhushya bufatwa ko buhariwe umuhanzi.

articles.heading: Uruhushya rwo kubyaza umusaruro igihangano nyiracyo ataboneka (1) Umuntu ushaka kubyaza umusaruro
articles.text:
igihangano nyiracyo ataboneka abisabira
uruhushya ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha
iyo yakoze ibishoboka byose kugira ngo
abonane n’ufite uburenganzira ku
gihangano ariko ntabashe kumubona.
(2) Iyo ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha
busanze usaba yaragize umuhate wo
kumenya aho ufite uburenganzira ku
gihangano cyangwa umuhagarariye
aherereye ariko ntaboneke, bushobora
guha uwasabye uruhushya.
(3) Uruhushya rwo kubyaza umusaruro
igihangano nyiracyo ataboneka
ntirwihariwe kandi rukurikiza ibisabwa
bigenwa n’ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha.

articles.heading: Igihe cyo kwakira igihembo cy’uruhushya ku burenganzira ku gihangano nyiracyo atabonetse Ufite uburenganzira ku gihangano mu gihe
articles.text:
kitarenze imyaka itanu nyuma y’irangira
ry’uruhushya rwatanzwe ku bireba
uburenganzira ku gihangano nyiracyo
atabonetse, ahabwa igihembo cy’uruhushya
cyangwa iyo atagihawe ashobora kuregera
urukiko rubifitiye ububasha hagamijwe
kugihabwa.
Akiciro ka 8: Amasezerano yo gutangaza
hakoreshejwe icapisha

articles.heading: Ibikurikizwa mu masezerano y’icapisha (1) Ufite uburenganzira ku gihangano, binyuze mu masezerano y’icapisha
articles.text:
ashobora kwegurira ucapa uburenganzira
bwo gukora cyangwa kwemerera gukora
umubare wa kopi z’igihangano zanditse,
zakozwe mu buryo bw’imashini,
ubw’ikoranabuhanga cyangwa kopi
z’igihangano no kuzitangaza cyangwa
kuzikwirakwiza. Mu gushyira mu bikorwa
ayo masezerano, ucapa:
(a) ntashobora kugira icyo ahindura ku
gihangano atabyumvikanyeho
n’umuhanzi;
(b) ashyira kuri buri kopi y’igihangano
izina ry’umuhanzi cyangwa irihimbano
rye;
(c) agena:
(i) imiterere n’uburyo igihangano
kizacapwamo;
(ii) igihe amasezerano y’icapisha azamara;
(iii) umubare wa kopi zizasohoka n’uburyo
kopi zitagurishijwe zizitabwaho nyuma
y’irangira ry’igihe cy’amasezerano
y’icapisha;
(iv) ingano y’igihembo n’uburyo
kizahabwa umuhanzi hakurikijwe
ikoreshwa n’umusaruro wava mu
icuruza ry’icyo gihangano;
(v) uburyo bwo gusesa amasezerano
y’icapisha.
(2) Uretse igihe byateganyijwe ukundi mu
masezerano, icapisha rishya ry’igihangano
ntirigomba gukorwa umuhanzi atongeye
kubimuhera urundi ruhushya.

articles.heading: Aho uburenganzira mu bukungu bw’ucapa bugarukira (1) Ucapa ntiyemerewe kwegurira undi muntu uburenganzira yeguriwe n’ufite
articles.text:
uburenganzira ku gihangano byaba ku
buntu, kugurisha cyangwa kugira
imigabane mu isosiyete y’ubucuruzi,
inyungu yakuye mu masezerano
y’icapisha atabiherewe uburenganzira na
nyiri igihangano wa mbere.
(2) Igihe yeguriye undi imari ikoreshwa mu
icapisha n’igihe uko kwegurira undi
bishobora kubangamira inyungu
zishingiye ku bintu cyangwa ku gaciro
nyamuntu k’umuhanzi, nyiri igihangano
afite uburenganzira bwo guhabwa
indishyi ikwiye cyangwa amasezerano
agaseswa hashingiwe ku buremere
bw’ikosa.
(3) Igihe imari ikoreshwa mu icapisha
ibyazwa umusaruro n’ishyirahamwe,
guha imari ikoreshwa mu icapisha umuntu
ku giti cye, yishyize hamwe n’abandi
cyangwa ari wenyine kandi bikomoka ku
iseswa cyangwa igabana ry’umutungo,
ntibishobora gufatwa nko kwegurira
umutungo undi muntu, kandi bisaba ko
umuhanzi abyemera.

articles.heading: Igihe amasezerano y’icapisha amara (1) Mu gihe amasezerano y’icapisha ari amasezerano y’igihe kizwi, uburenganzira
articles.text:
bw’ucapa burangirana n’igihe
cyateganyijwe.
(2) Icyakora, mu gihe cy’imyaka itatu nyuma
y’irangira ry’igihe cyateganyijwe, ucapa
ashobora kugurisha kopi z’igihangano
zisigaye mu bubiko ku zari ziteganyijwe
mu masezerano, keretse iyo icyo gihe,
umuhanzi ahisemo kujyana kopi zisigaye
A
ariko agaha ucapa igihembo gihwanye
n’agaciro kazo.

articles.heading: Iseswa ry’amasezerano y’icapisha (1) Amasezerano y’icapisha ashobora guseswa iyo ucapa atubahirije ibikubiye
articles.text:
mu masezerano cyangwa iyo umuhanzi
atujuje inshingano ze.
(2) Icapisha rishobora gufatwa nk’iryarangiye
iyo habonetse inyandiko nibura ebyiri
zikurikiranya zisaba kugemura kopi ariko
kopi ntizitangwe uko bikwiye kandi nta
mpamvu ifatika mu gihe cy’amezi
atandatu.
(3) Iyo igikorwa cy’icapisha kirangiye,
umuhanzi afite uburenganzira bwo gusesa
amasezerano. Iyo umuhanzi apfuye mu
gihe igihangano cye kiri mu icapiro, igice
cy’amasezerano atarashyirwa mu bikorwa
araseswa, keretse hagize ibindi biteganywa
n’amasezerano mashya yakorwa hagati
y’ucapa n’abazungura b’umuhanzi.
Akiciro ka 9: Uruhushya rutegetswe

articles.heading: Uruhushya rutegetswe rwo guhindura igihangano mu zindi ndimi (1) Umuntu ubifitemo inyungu ashobora
articles.text:
gusaba Minisitiri uruhushya rutegetswe
rwo guhindura mu zindi ndimi igihangano
cyatangajwe ku buryo bw’icapwa cyangwa
ubundi buryo buteye nka bwo, hagamijwe
kwigisha cyangwa gukora ubushakashatsi :
(a) iyo mu myaka itatu nyuma y’itariki
w’itangazwa rya mbere ry’igihangano
mu rurimi rumwe mu zemewe mu
butegetsi, igihangano kitatangajwe mu
rundi rurirmi mu zemewe mu
butegetsi;
(b) cyangwa iyo igihangano cyahinduwe
mu ndimi zose zemewe mu butegetsi
ariko kopi imwe cyangwa nyinshi mu
zahinduwe mu zindi ndimi
zitakiboneka zicapye.
(2) Uruhushya rutegetswe rwo guhindura mu
zindi ndimi ntirwihariwe kandi
ntirwegurirwa undi muntu ku isoko
ry’imbere mu gihugu, kandi rwemerera
urutunze, atabiherewe uruhushya n’ufite
uburenganzira bw’umuhanzi, guhindura
igihangano mu zindi ndimi zikenewe no
gutangaza ibyahinduwe mu buryo bucapye
cyangwa ubundi buryo busa na bwo
bw’itubura.

articles.heading: Ibisabwa mu gutanga uruhushya rutegetswe rwo guhindura igihangano mu zindi ndimi (1) Uruhushya rutegetswe rwo guhindura
articles.text:
igihangano mu zindi ndimi rushobora
gutangwa iyo uwarusabye agaragaje ko:
(a) yasabye ufite uburenganzira ku
gihangano uruhushya rutegetswe rwo
guhindura mu zindi ndimi
akarumwima ku mpamvu z’ubucuruzi;
(b) cyangwa yakoze ibishoboka byose
kugira ngo abonane n’ufite
uburenganzira ku gihangano ariko
ntabashe kumugeraho.
(2) Mu gihe hatanzwe uruhushya rutegetswe
uruhawe agomba kugaragaza izina
ry’umuhanzi n’inyito y’umwimerere
y’igihangano rigaragara kuri kopi zose
z’igihangano cyahinduwe mu zindi ndimi
hakurikijwe uruhushya rutegetswe rwo
guhindura igihangano mu zindi ndimi.
(3) Mu gutanga uruhushya rutegetswe,
Minisitiri afata ibyemezo bikwiye kugira
ngo igihangano cyahinduwe mu rundi
rurimi kitagira amakosa kandi ufite
uburenganzira ku gihangano akagenerwa
igihembo cy’uruhushya gikwiye
cyumvikanyweho mu bwisanzure
hashingiwe ku bwoko bw’igihangano
cyatangiwe uruhushya rutegetswe rwo
guhindura mu zindi ndimi.
(4) Icyakora, uruhushya rutegetswe rwo
guhindura igihangano mu zindi ndimi
ntirutangwa iyo umuhanzi yisubije kopi
zose z’igihangano cye atakizikwirakwiza.

articles.heading: Irangira ry’uruhushya rutegetswe rwo guhindura igihangano mu zindi ndimi (1) Uruhushya rutegetswe rwo guhindura
articles.text:
igihangano mu zindi ndimi rurangira:
(a) iyo igihangano gitangajwe n’ufite
uburenganzira ku gihangano
cyahinduwe mu ndimi zemewe mu
butegetsi;
(b) cyangwa iyo guhindura igihangano mu
zindi ndimi bitangiwe uruhushya
n’ufite uburenganzira ku gihangano ku
giciro gikwiye hashingiwe ku
bikurikizwa ku igena ry’igihembo
cy’uruhushya.
(2) Icyakora, kopi zose zakozwe mbere y’uko
uruhushya rutegetswe rwo guhindura
igihangano mu zindi ndimi rurangira
zikomeza gukwirakwizwa kugeza zishize
mu bubiko.

articles.heading: Impamvu zishingirwaho mu gutanga uruhushya rutegetswe rwo gutubura igihangano (1) Umuntu ubifitemo inyungu ashobora
articles.text:
gusaba Minisitiri uruhushya rutegetswe
rwo gutubura igihangano ku mpamvu
z’inyungu rusange, kwigisha cyangwa
gukora ubushakashatsi ku bireba
igihangano cyatangajwe mu buryo
bw’inyandiko icapye cyangwa ubundi
buryo buteye nka bwo mu gutubura
igihangano muri Repubulika y’u Rwanda.
(2) Uruhushya rutegetswe rwo gutubura
igihangano ntirwihariwe kandi uwaruhawe
ntashobora kurwegurira undi muntu ku
isoko ry’imbere mu gihugu.

articles.heading: Igihe uruhushya rutegetswe rwo gutubura igihangano rushobora gutangwa (1) Uruhushya rutegetswe rwo gutubura
articles.text:
igihangano rushobora gutangwa mu bihe
bikurikira:
(a) nyuma y’imyaka itatu ibarwa uhereye
ku itariki y’itangazwa rya mbere
ry’icapisha ku bihangano
by’ubumenyimpamo,
iby’ubumenyabintu
n’iby’ikoranabuhanga;
(b) nyuma y’imyaka irindwi ibarwa
uhereye ku itariki y’itangazwa rya
mbere ry’icapisha ku bihangano
by’inkuru z’ubuvanganzo, iby’ubusizi,
iby’ikinamico, ibya muzika n’ibitabo
by’ubugeni;
(c) nyuma y’imyaka itanu ibarwa uhereye
ku itariki y’itangazwa rya mbere
ry’icapisha ku bindi bihangano.
(2) Iyo igihe giteganyijwe mu gika cya (1)
cy’iyi ngingo kirangiye, hakiri kopi z’icyo
gihangano zitakwirakwizwa n’ufite
uburenganzira bwo gutubura igihangano
cyangwa uwo yabihereye uruhushya ku
giciro gikwiye igihangano ugereranyije
n’ibihangano bisa n’icyo, cyangwa nta
kopi z’icyo gihangano zemerewe
gucuruzwa mu gihe cy’amezi atandatu ku
giciro gikwiye ugereranyije n’ibihangano
bisa n’icyo, umuntu ubifitemo inyungu
ashobora guhabwa uburenganzira bwo
gutubura no gutangaza iryo capisha ku
giciro gikwiye.

articles.heading: Ibisabwa mu gutanga uruhushya rutegetswe rwo gutubura igihangano (1) Uruhushya rutegetswe rwo gutubura
articles.text:
igihangano rushobora gutangwa iyo usaba
agaragaje ko:
(a) yasabye ufite uburenganzira ku
gihangano uruhushya rwo gutubura
igihangano akarumwima ku mpamvu
z’ubucuruzi;
(b) yakoze ibishoboka byose kugira ngo
abone ufite uburenganzira ku
gihangano amusabe uruhushya ariko
ntabashe kumugeraho.
(2) Mu gihe hatanzwe uruhushya rutegetswe
uruhawe agomba kugaragaza izina
ry’umuhanzi n’inyito y’umwimerere
y’igihangano kuri kopi zose z’igihangano
cyatubuwe hakurikijwe uruhushya
rutegetswe rwo gutubura igihangano.
(3) Mu gutanga uruhushya rutegetswe,
Minisitiri afata ibyemezo bikwiye kugira
ngo igihangano gituburwe mu buryo
bwizewe kandi ufite uburenganzira
bw’umuhanzi agenerwa igihembo
cy’uruhushya gikwiye cyumvikanyweho
mu bwisanzure hashingiwe ku bwoko
bw’igihangano cyatangiwe uruhushya
rutegetswe rwo gutuburwa.
(4) Icyakora, uruhushya rutegetswe rwo
gutubura igihangano ntirutangwa iyo ufite
uburenganzira ku gihangano yakuye icyo
gihangano gisabirwa gutuburwa ku isoko.

articles.heading: Irangira ry’uruhushya rutegetswe rwo gutubura igihangano (1) Uruhushya rutegetswe rwo gutubura
articles.text:
igihangano rurangira iyo :
(a) igihangano cyatubuwe kandi
gikwirakwizwa n’ufite uburenganzira
ku gihangano;
(b) gutubura igihangano bitangiwe
uruhushya n’ufite uburenganzira ku
gihangano ku giciro gikwiye.
(2) Icyakora, kopi zose zakozwe mbere y’uko
uruhushya rutegetswe rwo gutubura
igihangano rurangira zikomeza
gukwirakwizwa kugeza zishize mu bubiko.
UMUTWE WA II: IBIKUBIYE MU
BURENGANZIRA BUSHAMIKIYE KU
GIHANGANO, AHO BUGARUKIRA
N’IGIHE BUMARA
Icyiciro cya mbere: Kurengera ikinwa
ry’igihangano, fonogaramu cyangwa
ibiganiro bisakazwa
Ingingo 337: Kurengera ikinwa
ry’igihangano
Ikinwa ry’igihangano rirengerwa iyo:
(a) uwagikinnye ari umwenegihugu wa
Repubulika y’u Rwanda;
(b) rikorewe ku butaka bwa Repubulika
y’u Rwanda;
(c) ryinjijwe muri fonogaramu irengewe;
(d) ritashyizwe muri fonogaramu ariko
bikinjizwa mu kiganiro cyemerewe
kurengerwa;
(e) uwakinnye igihangano ari umukinnyi
w’iyumvabona utari umwenegihugu
wa Repubulika y’u Rwanda ariko
asanzwe atuye muri Repubulika y’u
Rwanda.

articles.heading: Fonogaramu irengerwa Fonogaramu irengerwa iyo yujuje nibura kimwe muri ibi bikurikira
articles.text:
(a) uwayikoze ari umwenegihugu wa
Repubulika y’u Rwanda;
(b) gushyira amajwi bwa mbere kuri
fonogaramu byabereye muri
Repubulika y’u Rwanda;
(c) gutangaza fonogaramu bwa mbere
byabereye muri Repubulika y’u
Rwanda.

articles.heading: Ikiganiro gisakazwa kirengerwa Ikiganiro gisakazwa kirengerwa iyo
articles.text:
(a) icyicaro cy’ikigo gisakaza kiri muri
Repubulika y’u Rwanda;
(b) cyangwa ikiganiro gisakazwa gituruka
mu nsakaza ziherereye muri
Repubulika y’u Rwanda.

articles.heading: Igihe cyo kurengera ikinwa ry’igihangano (1) Igihe cyo kurengera ikinwa ry’igihangano ni imyaka 50 ibarwa uhereye
articles.text:
(a) mu kwezi kwa mbere k’umwaka
ukurikira uw’ifatwa ry’amajwi
n’amashusho ku byerekeye ikinwa
ry’igihangano cyafashwe kuri
fonogaramu;
(b) mu kwezi kwa mbere k’umwaka
ukurikira uwo indirimbo
yaririmbiweho cyangwa ikinwa
ry’igihangano, ku ndirimbo cyangwa
ikinwa ry’igihangano bitafashwe kuri
fonogaramu.
(2) Kurengera ikinwa ry’igihangano
ntibihagarika cyangwa ngo bibangamire
kurengera uburenganzira bw’umuhanzi
wahanze igihangano cyakinwe.

articles.heading: Igihe kurengera fonogaramu bimara (1) Fonogaramu irengerwa mu gihe cy’imyaka 50 ibarwa uhereye
articles.text:
(a) mu kwezi kwa mbere k’umwaka
ukurikira uw’itangaza rya
fonogaramu;
(b) mu kwezi kwa mbere k’umwaka
ukurikira uwo igihangano
cyashyiriwe kuri fonogaramu;
(c) mu kwezi kwa mbere k’umwaka
ukurikira uwo amajwi yafatiweho iyo
fonogaramu itatangajwe.
(2) Kurengera fonogaramu ntibihagarika
cyangwa ngo bibangamire kurengera
uburenganzira bw’umuhanzi
w’igihangano.

articles.heading: Igihe kurengera ikiganiro gisakazwa bimara (1) Ikiganiro gisakazwa kirengerwa mu gihe cy’imyaka 25 ibarwa uhereye
articles.text:
ukwezi kwa mbere k’umwaka
ukurikira umwaka isakazwa
ry’ikiganiro ryabereyemo.
(2) Kurengera ikiganiro gisakazwa
ntibihagarika cyangwa ngo
bibangamire kurengera uburenganzira
bw’umuhanzi.

articles.heading: Ubwisanzure bwo gukoresha by’igihe gito amajwi n’amashusho by’ikinwa ry’igihangano n’ibiganiro by’isakaza ku kigo cy’isakaza
articles.text:
(1) Uruhushya mu gufata amajwi
n’amashusho indirimbo cyangwa imikino
n’ibiganiro by’isakaza, gutubura
ibyafashwe amajwi n’amashusho no
gutubura za fonogaramu hagamijwe
ubucuruzi ntiruba rukenewe, iyo gufata
amajwi n’amashusho by’igihe gito
cyangwa gutubura bikozwe n’ikigo
cy’isakaza ubwacyo kandi gikurikiza ibyo
gikeneye mu mirimo yacyo.
(2) Icyakora, ibikorwa bikurikira bisabirwa
uruhushya:
(a) buri sakaza ry’ikinwa ry’igihangano
ryafashwe amajwi n’amashusho
cyangwa ryatubuwe;
(b) buri sakaza ry’ikiganiro cyafashwe
amajwi n’amashusho cyangwa itubura
ryacyo.
(3) Amajwi n’amashusho byafashwe cyangwa
amakopi yabyo bigomba guhanagurwa mu
gihe kingana n’amezi atandatu akurikira
igihe amajwi n’amashusho byafatiwe no
mu gutubura ibihangano birengerwa
n’uburenganzira bw’umuhanzi, uretse kopi
imwe rukumbi ishobora kubikwa
hagamijwe gusa gushyingura inyandiko
ndetse no kwegeranya inyandiko.

articles.heading: Uburenganzira bw’umuhanzi ukina igihangano (1) Umuhanzi ukina igihangano afite uburenganzira bwihariwe bwo gukora
articles.text:
cyangwa gutanga uruhushya ku bikorwa
bikurikira:
(a) gusakaza indirimbo cyangwa
umukino bye, uretse igihe isakazwa
rikozwe:
(i) rifatiye ku majwi n’amashusho
y’indirimbo cyangwa umukino
byafashwe umuhanzi yatangiye
uruhushya;
(ii) risubiramo ikiganiro ku buryo
bwemewe n’ikigo cy’isakaza gisakaza
bwa mbere igihangano;
(b) gukwirakwiza muri rubanda indirimbo
cyangwa umukino, uretse igihe iryo
kwirakwiza:
(i) rikozwe rifatiye ku majwi
n’amashusho y’indirimbo cyangwa
umukino byafashwe;
(ii) rikozwe rifatiye ku isakaza
ry’indirimbo cyangwa umukino;
(c) gufata amajwi n’amashusho
by’indirimbo cyangwa umukino
bitarafatirwa amajwi n’amashusho;
(d) gutubura ku buryo butaziguye cyangwa
buziguye indirimbo cyangwa umukino
byafatiwe amajwi n’amashusho;
(e) gukwirakwiza muri rubanda, binyuze
mu igurisha cyangwa ubundi buryo
bwo guhererekanya umutungo, kopi
z’indirimbo cyangwa umukino
byafatiwe amajwi n’amashusho;
(f) gukodesha rubanda indirimbo cyangwa
umukino bye byafatiwe amajwi
n’amashusho cyangwa kopi zabyo;
(g) kugeza kuri rubanda indirimbo
cyangwa umukino byafashwe kuri
fonogaramu ku buryo buri wese aho ari
ho hose n’igihe icyo ari cyo cyose
abishakiye ashobora kubigeraho.
(2) Iyo ukina yatanze uburenganzira bwo
gufata umukino we mu mashusho no mu
majwi, utunganya ayo mashusho n’amajwi
afite uburenganzira bwihariwe bwo
gutanga uruhushya rwo gukoresha
umukino washyizwe mu gihangano
cy’iyumvabona, keretse iyo
byemeranyijweho ukundi.
(3) Haseguriwe uburenganzira
bw’uwatunganyije igihangano, ukina afite
uburenganzira bwo guhabwa igihembo
cyangwa igihembo cy’uruhushya bikwiye
kuri buri sakaza, buri gikorwa kigamije
kugeza ubutumwa kuri rubanda, buri
kodesha cyangwa buri gikorwa cyo
gushyira ahagaragara indirimbo cyangwa
umukino bye byafatiwe ku gihangano
cy’iyumvabona.

articles.heading: Uburenganzira bw’ukora fonogaramu (1) Ukora fonogaramu afite uburenganzira bwihariwe bwo gukora cyangwa gutanga
articles.text:
uruhushya rwo gukora ibikorwa bikurikira:
(a) gutubura fonogaramu ku buryo
butaziguye cyangwa buziguye;
(b) gukwirakwiza muri rubanda kopi za
fonogaramu binyuze mu igurisha
cyangwa ubundi buryo bwo
guhererekanya uburenganzira ku
gihangano;
(c) gukodesha rubanda kopi za
fonogaramu;
(d) kugeza kuri rubanda fonogaramu,
hifashishijwe uburyo bukoresha
cyangwa budakoresha insinga, ku
buryo umuntu aho ari hose n’igihe
cyose abishakiye ashobora kuyigeraho.
(2) Uburenganzira bwo gukwirakwiza
buteganywa mu gaka ka (b) k’igika cya (1)
cy’iyi ngingo ntibukurikizwa igihe
igihangano cy’umwimerere cyangwa kopi
yacyo byashyizwe ku isoko, byagurishijwe
cyangwa habayeho ihererekanya
ry’uburenganzira ryatangiwe uruhushya
n’ufite uburenganzira ku gihangano aho
ariho hose ku isi.

articles.heading: Uburenganzira bw’ikigo cy’isakaza Ikigo cy’isakaza gifite uburenganzira bwihariwe bwo gukora cyangwa gutanga
Aho uruhushya rwo gusakaza rugarukira Uruhushya rwo gusakaza ruhawe ikigo cy’isakaza, uretse igihe amasezerano
articles.text:
abiteganya ukundi, ntibivuze gutanga ibi
bikurikira:
(a) uruhushya ku bindi bigo by’isakaza
k’ugusakaza ikinwa ry’igihangano;
(b) uruhushya rwo gufata amajwi
n’amashusho cyangwa ikinwa
ry’igihangano ;
(c) uruhushya rwo gutubura amajwi
n’amashusho cyangwa ikinwa
ry’igihangano byafashwe;
(d) uruhushya rwo gufata amajwi
n’amashusho cyangwa ikinwa
ry’igihangano no gutubura icyo
gihangano cyangwa uruhushya rwo
gusakaza cyangwa ikinwa
ry’igihangano gifatiye ku gihangano
cyafashwe amajwi n’amashusho
cyangwa ibyatubuwemo.

articles.heading: Igihembo gikwiye ku isakaza n’imenyekanisha rya fonogaramu (1) Umuhanzi wa fonogaramu yatangajwe mu
articles.text:
rwego rw’ubucuruzi kandi yakoreshejwe
mu isakazwa cyangwa mu bundi buryo
bw’imenyekanisha kuri rubanda ahabwa
igihembo gikwiye gitangwa rimwe kandi
icyo gihembo akakigabana n’umuhanzi
wakinnye igihangano.
(2) Igihembo gikwiye kivugwa mu gika cya
(1) cy’iyi ngingo, kigabanywa mu buryo
bungana keretse iyo amasezerano
umuhanzi wa fonogaramu yagiranye
n’umuhanzi wakinnye igihangano
abiteganya ukundi.

articles.heading: Ubwisanzure mu gukoresha uburenganzira bushamikiyeho (1) Ibikorwa bikurikira bikorwa bidatangiwe
articles.text:
uruhushya n’ufite uburenganzira bw’ukina
igihangano, umuhanzi wa fonogaramu
cyangwa ikigo cy’isakaza kandi nta
igihembo gitanzwe:
(a) gukoresha uduce duto twa fonogaramu,
utw’ikinwa ry’igihangano cyangwa
utw’isakaza mu kuvuga amakuru y’ibiri
kuba;
(b) gutubura fonogaramu, ikinwa
ry’igihangano cyangwa isakaza
hagamijwe ubushakashatsi mu
by’ubuhanga;
(c) gutubura fonogaramu, ikinwa
ry’igihangano cyangwa isakaza
hagamijwe kugikoresha mu bikorwa
byo kwigisha mu buryo
bw’imbonankubone, uretse ibihangano
bikinwa n’amajwi yafashwe
byashyizwe ahagaragara
nk’imfashanyigisho;
(d) gukoresha fonogaramu, ikinwa
ry’igihangano cyangwa isakaza
n’umuntu ku giti cye;
(e) gutubura fonogaramu, ikinwa
ry’igihangano cyangwa isakaza
bikozwe na serivisi z’amasomero
cyangwa iz’ishyinguranyandiko
hatagamijwe inyungu;
(f) gukoresha fonogaramu, ikinwa
ry’igihangano cyangwa isakaza ku
mpamvu zerekeye ubucamanza
cyangwa ubuyobozi;
(g) gutubura no gusakaza fonogaramu,
ikinwa ry’igihangano cyangwa isakaza
k’ufite ubumuga bwo kutabona, utabona
neza cyangwa utabasha gusoma igitabo.
(2) Ubwisanzure buvugwa mu gika cya (1)
cy’iyi ngingo ntibubangamira
imikoreshereze isanzwe y’igihangano
cyangwa inyungu ufite uburenganzira ku
gihangano yemerewe kuri icyo gihangano.
UMUTWE WA III: INGINGO
ZIHURIWEHO KU BURENGAZIRA KU
GIHANGANO N’UBURENGANZIRA
BUBUSHAMIKIYEHO

articles.heading: Ikusanywa n’isaranganya ry’ibihembo by’uruhushya (1) Ubuyobozi bubifitiye ububasha bukusanya
articles.text:
ibihembo by’uruhushya byavuye mu
gukoresha ibikomoka ku bihangano,
uburenganzira bw’abahanzi
n’uburenganzira bushamikiyeho kandi
bukabisaranganya ku bafite uburenganzira.
(2) Iteka rya Minisitiri ufite umuco mu
nshingano rigena uburyo bw’ikusanywa
n’isaranganya ry’ibihembo by’uruhushya
byavuye mu gukoresha ibikomoka ku
bihangano, uburenganzira bw’abahanzi,
uburenganzira bushamikiyeho rikorwa.

articles.heading: Ibibujijwe mu kurengera uburyo koranabuhanga bwo kurinda igihangano (1) Mu rwego rwo kurengera uburyo
articles.text:
koranabuhanga bwo kurinda igihangano,
ibikorwa bikurikira ntibyemewe :
(a) kurengera uburyo koranabuhanga
bwakoreshejwe mu kurinda
igihangano;
(b) gukora, kwinjiza mu gihugu,
gukwirakwiza, kugurisha, gukodesha,
imenyekanisha rigamije igurishwa
cyangwa ikodeshwa, gutunga mu
rwego rw’ubucuruzi ibikoresho
cyangwa ibice bibigize byamamazwa
nk’ibyifashishwa mu kwirengagiza
nkana tekiniki zirengera igihangano
mu buryo buhamye.
(2) Icyakora, bisabwe n’umuntu ufite
uburenganzira bwo gukoresha igihangano
bidatangiwe uruhushya buteganywa mu
ngingo ya 288, iya 290, iya 291, iya 292,
iya 294, iya 295, iya 296, iya 297, iya 298,
iya 300 n’iya 346 z’iri tegeko ufite
uburenganzira ku gihangano akuraho
uburyo koranabuhanga bwo kurinda
igihangano kugira ngo uwemerewe
gukoresha igihangano nta ruhushya
ashobore kugikoresha nk’uko
abyemererwa n’amategeko.

articles.heading: Kurinda igihangano hakoreshejwe uburyo koranabuhanga Kurinda igihangano hakoreshejwe uburyo
articles.text:
koranabuhanga bikorwa iyo gukoresha
igihangano, bigenzurwa n’ufite uburenganzira
ku gihangano cyangwa ufite uburenganzira
bushamikiyeho yifashishije kugenzura
cyangwa kurinda uburyo bwo kugera ku
gihangano nk’ijambo ry’ibanga, uburyo bwo
guhisha, kuyoberanya cyangwa ubundi buryo
bwo guhindura igihangano cyangwa ikindi
gikoresho cyangwa uburyo bwo kugenzura
kopi mu buryo busanzwe bukoreshwa,
bikagera ku ntego yo kukirengera.

articles.heading: Ibibujijwe ku byerekeye amakuru ku micungire y’uburenganzira ku gihangano (1) Ibikorwa bikurikira byerekeye icungwa
articles.text:
ry’amakuru ku burenganzira birabujijwe:
(a) gukuraho cyangwa guhindura
imicungire y’amakuru k’uburenganzira
utabyemerewe n’ufite uburenganzira
ku gihangano;
(b) gukwirakwiza, kwinjiza mu gihugu
hagamijwe ikwirakwiza, isakaza
cyangwa kumenyekanisha kuri
rubanda igihangano cyangwa ibindi
bikoresho birengerwa byakuweho
cyangwa byahinduriwe uburenganzira
ku micungire y’amakuru bidatangiwe
uruhushya n’ufite uburenganzira ku
gihangano.
(2) Icyakora, ibiteganyijwe mu gika cya (1)
cy’iyi ngingo ntibireba ibikorwa bya Leta
bigamije kubahiriza ituze rusange cyangwa
umutekano bya rubanda.
INTERURO YA IV: IBYEMEZO
BIGAMIJE IYUBAHIRIZWA
RY’UBURENGANZIRA KU MUTUNGO
BWITE MU BY’UBWENGE, IBYAHA
N’IBIHANO
UMUTWE WA MBERE: IBYEMEZO
BIGAMIJE IYUBAHIRIZWA
RY’UBURENGANZIRA KU MUTUNGO
BWITE MU BY’UBWENGE
Icyiciro cya mbere: Icyemezo
cy’agateganyo ku birebana n’umutungo
bwite mu by’ubwenge

articles.heading: Gusaba no gufata icyemezo cy’agateganyo ku birebana n’umutungo bwite mu by’ubwenge Bisabwe n’ufite urupapurompamo rwo
articles.text:
kurengera umutungo bwite mu by’inganda,
ufite uburenganzira ku gihangano, ufite
burenganzira bushamikiyeho cyangwa
uwahawe uruhushya, urukiko rubifitiye
ububasha rushobora gufata icyemezo
cy’agateganyo kigamije gukumira igikorwa
kinyuranyije n’amategeko cyangwa kurinda
ibimenyetso bifite ireme bigaragaza
ibangamirwa ry’uburenganzira rikekwa.

articles.heading: Ibishingirwaho mu ifatwa ry’icyemezo cy’agateganyo (1) Urukiko rubifitiye ububasha rushobora
articles.text:
gufata icyemezo cy’agateganyo rutabanje
kumva uregwa iyo:
(a) gutinda gufata icyemezo ku
ibangamirwa ry’uburenganzira ku
mutungo bwite mu by’ubwenge
cyangwa kurinda ibimenyetso bifite
ireme bijyana n’iyigana ryagaragaye
bishobora guteza igihombo ku buryo
budasubirwaho k’ufite uburenganzira;
(b) ibimenyetso bifatika bigaragaza ko
urega ariwe ufite uburenganzira ku
mutungo bwite mu by’ubwenge kandi
ko uburenganzira bwe burimo
guhungabanywa cyangwa ko
ihungabanya ririmo gutegurwa;
(c) urega atanze ingwate cyangwa ubundi
bwishingire hagamijwe kurinda
uregwa no gukumira ubuhemu ubwo
ari bwo bwose.
(2) Urukiko rufata icyemezo mu gihe
kitarenze iminsi itatu y’akazi ibarwa
uhereye ku itariki rwashyikirijwe ikirego.
Iyo icyemezo cy’agateganyo gifashwe,
Urukiko rumenyesha uwatanze ikirego
nawe akamenyesha abandi barebwa
n’ikibazo.
(3) Iteka rya Minisitiri rigena ingano
y’ingwate cyangwa y’ubwishingire
iteganyijwe mu gika cya (1), agaka ka (c)
by’iyi ngingo.

articles.heading: Gusubirishamo icyemezo cy’agateganyo (1) Iyo icyemezo cy’agateganyo cyafashwe hashingiwe ku bikubiye mu ngingo ya 355
articles.text:
y’iri tegeko, uregwa ashobora gutanga, mu
rukiko rwari rwafashe icyemezo, ikirego
cyo gusubirishamo icyo cyemezo mu minsi
15 ibarwa uhereye ku itariki icyemezo
cyamenyekanishirijweho.
(2) Mu gihe cyo gusubirishamo icyemezo,
urukiko rubifitiye ububasha ruha impande
zombi umwanya wo kwisobanura kandi
rushobora kugumishaho, guhindura,
cyangwa gusesa icyemezo mu gihe
kitarenze iminsi ibiri y’umurimo ikurikira
itariki ikirego cyo gusubirishamo
icyemezo cy’agateganyo cyakiriweho.

articles.heading: Gukuraho icyemezo cy’agateganyo Bisabwe n’uwabangamiwe n’icyemezo cy’agateganyo, urukiko rubifitiye ububasha
articles.text:
rushobora gusesa icyemezo cy’agateganyo iyo
urega adashyikirije urukiko ikirego kigamije
kuburanisha urubanza mu mizi mu gihe
cy’iminsi 31 ibarwa uhereye ku itariki
imenyekanisha ry’icyemezo cy’agateganyo
ryakorewe.
Icyiciro cya 2: Ibyemezo bikosora ku
birebana n’umutungo bwite mu
by’ubwenge

articles.heading: Gusaba no gufata ibyemezo bikosora mu birebana n’umutungo bwite mu by’inganda Bisabwe n’ufite umutungo bwite mu
articles.text:
by’inganda cyangwa uwabiherewe uruhushya,
urukiko rubifitiye ububasha rushobora
gutegeka:
(a) guhagarika kwinjiza mu bucuruzi
ibicuruzwa bifite ibirango
by’ibyiganano cyangwa bihungabanya
uburenganzira bw’ufite uburenganzira
ku mutungo bwite mu by’inganda no
guhagarika kubyamamaza;
(b) kuvana mu bucuruzi, nta ndishyi
ibicuruzwa bifite ibirango
by’ibyiganano cyangwa bibangamiye
uburenganzira bw’ufite uburenganzira
ku umutungo bwite mu by’inganda ku
buryo arindwa icyahungabanya
uburenganzira bwe. Gukuraho ikirango
cyashyizweho ku buryo budakurikije
amategeko byonyine ntibihagije uretse
ku mpamvu zidasanzwe zo gutuma
ibicuruzwa byinjizwa mu bucuruzi ;
(c) kuvana mu bucuruzi, nta ndishyi
zitanzwe, ibikoresho byifashishijwe
cyangwa bishobora kwifashishwa mu
guhanga cyangwa gukora ibicuruzwa
bifite ibirango by’ibyiganano cyangwa
bibangamiye uburenganzira bw’ufite
uburenganzira ku mutungo bwite mu
by’inganda hagamijwe kwirinda
inkurikizi zabangamira uburenganzira
bwe;
(d) gufatira, kwamburwa cyangwa
gusenya ibicuruzwa by’ibyiganano
n’ibikoresho byose byakoreshejwe mu
gukora ibicuruzwa by’ibyiganano.

articles.heading: Gusaba no gufata icyemezo gikosora ku birebana n’uburenganzira bw’umuhanzi n’uburenganzira bushamikiyeho
articles.text:
(1) Bisabwe n’ufite uburenganzira ku
gihangano, ufite uburenganzira
bushamikiyeho cyangwa uwahawe
uruhushya, urukiko rubifitiye ububasha
rushobora gutegeka :
(a) guhagarika igikorwa kinyuranyije
n’amategeko cyangwa gihungabanya
uburenganzira ku gihangano;
(b) ifatira, iyamburwa cyangwa iyangizwa
ry’amakopi y’ibihangano cyangwa ya
fonogaramu yakozwe cyangwa yinjijwe
mu gihugu cyangwa se akekwa kuba
yarakozwe cyangwa yarinjijwe mu gihugu
bidatangiwe uruhushya n’ufite
uburenganzira ku mutungo bwite mu
by’ubwenge;
(c) ifatira, iyamburwa cyangwa iyangizwa
ry’ibifuniko by’amakopi y’ibihangano
cyangwa ya za fonogaramu, ibikoresho
byakoreshejwe mu gukora izo kopi
z’ibihangano n’inyandiko, impapuro
z’ubucuruzi zijyanye n’izo kopi;
(d) gukura ku isoko kopi z’igihangano
cyangwa fonogaramu n’ibifuniko byabyo
byifashishijwe mu gukora cyangwa
gukomeza gukora ibikorwa bibangamira
ufite uburenganzira ku mutungo bwite mu
by’ubwenge;
(e) gukura ku isoko ibikoresho bishobora
gukoreshwa mu gukora cyangwa
gukomeza gukora ibikorwa bibangamira
ufite uburenganzira ku mutungo bwite mu
by’ubwenge.
(2) Gufatira, kwambura cyangwa kwangiza
hakurikijwe ibiteganywa n’igika cya (1)
cy’iyi ngingo ntibikurikizwa kuri za kopi
n’ibifuniko byazo umuntu yabonye nta
buriganya.

articles.heading: Itangwa ry’indishyi (1) Urukiko rubifitiye ububasha rushobora gutegeka uwabangamiye ufite uburenganzira ku mutungo bwite mu
articles.text:
by’ubwenge kumwishyura indishyi ikwiye
iyo uwabangamiye ufite uburenganzira ku
mutungo bwite mu by’ubwenge yari azi
cyangwa hari impamvu zigaragaza ko
yamenye ko yakoraga igikorwa cyo
kubangamira ufite uburenganzira ku
mutungo bwite mu by’ubwenge.
(2) Urukiko rubifitiye ububasha rushobora
gutegeka uwabangamiye ufite
uburenganzira ku mutungo bwite mu
by’ubwenge kumwishyura inyungu
yabonye kubera gukora igikorwa
kibangamira uburenganzira bwe yaba
yaragikoze abizi cyangwa atabizi.
(3) Iyo urukiko rubifitiye ububasha rusanze
uwatanze ikirego cy’iyubahirizwa
ry’uburenganzira ku mutungo bwite mu
by’ubwenge yarabikoze mu buriganya,
rumutegeka kwishyura uwarezwe
indishyi ikwiye ku gihombo yagize.

articles.heading: Uburenganzira ku makuru Urukiko rubifiye ububasha rubisabwe n’ufite uburenganzira ku mutungo bwite mu
articles.text:
by’ubwenge, ufite uburenganzira burengewe
cyangwa undi muntu ubifitemo inyungu,
rushobora gutegeka uwabangamiye
uburenganzira burengewe kumenyesha ufite
uburenganzira ku mutungo bwite mu
by’ubwenge amazina y’abandi bantu bagize
uruhare mu gukora no gukwirakwiza
ibicuruzwa by’ibyiganano cyangwa gutanga
servisi zitatangiwe uruhushya n’inzira
byakozwemo.

articles.heading: Itangwa ry’ibimenyetso ku byerekeye uburyo bwakoreshejwe mu buvumbuzi (1) Iyo ikirego cyatanzwe n’ufite
articles.text:
uburenganzira ku mpamyabuvumbuzi ari
icyerekeranye n’uburyo bwakoreshejwe
mu buvumbuzi kugira ngo
icyatunganyijwe kigerweho, urukiko
rubifitiye ububasha rushobora gutegeka
uregwa gutanga ibimenyetso bigaragaza ko
uburyo bwakoreshejwe kugira ngo agere
ku cyatunganyijwe gisa n’icy’urega
butandukanye n’ubwatangiwe
impamyabuvumbuzi.
(2) Iyo icyatunganyijwe gisa
n’icyatunganyijwe kirengewe nta ruhushya
rw’ufite uburenganzira ku
mpamyabuvumbuzi kandi iyo nta
kimenyetso kibivuguruza, gifatwa nk’aho
cyagezweho hifashishijwe uburyo
burengewe kuri imwe mu mpamvu
zikukurikira:
(a) iyo icyatunganijwe ari gishya;
(b) iyo icyatunganijwe cyakozwe
hifashishijwe ubwo buryo busa, kandi
ufite uburenganzira ku
mpamyabuvumbuzi akaba
atarashoboye gusobanura uburyo
nyakuri bwakoreshejwe ubwo ari bwo.
(3) Mu gusaba ko hatangwa ibimenyetso,
urukiko rubifitiye ububasha
rwashyikirijwe ikirego, ntirushyira
ahagaragara amabanga y’uburyo ikintu
cyakozwe n’amabanga y’ubucuruzi
by’uwabangamiye uburenganzira bw’ufite
uburenganzira ku mpamyabuvumbuzi.
Icyiciro cya 3: Ibyemezo byihariye
bikurikizwa ku mupaka
Akiciro ka mbere: Ibyemezo bishobora
gufatwa n’ubuyobozi bwa gasutamo

articles.heading: Gusaba guhagarika ikwirakwizwa ry’ibicuruzwa by’ibyiganano (1) Ubuyobozi bwa gasutamo bubisabwe mu
articles.text:
nyandiko n’ufite uburenganzira, ufite
impamvu zifatika zo gukeka ko hari
umugambi wo kwinjiza mu gihugu
ibicuruzwa by’ibyiganano cyangwa
bubyibwirije, bushobora guhagarika
imirimo yose ijyanye no gukura ibyo
bicuruzwa muri gasutamo n’ikwirakwiza
ryabyo.
(2) Ubuyobozi bwa gasutamo bushobora
gutegeka uwasabye guhagarika imirimo
ijyanye no gukura ibicuruzwa muri
gasutamo no kubikwirakwiza gutanga
ibimenyetso bihagije bigaragaza ko
habayeho iyigana ry’ibicuruzwa no
gutanga ibisobanuro bihagije
by’ibicuruzwa kugira ngo ubuyobozi bwa
gasutamo bushobore kubitahura
bitabugoye.

articles.heading: Ibicuruzwa bifatwa nk’ibyiganano Ibicuruzwa bifatwa nk’ibyiganano iyo
articles.text:
(a) byigana ikirango cyandikishijwe cyangwa
ikimenyetso ndangahantu cyakoreshejwe
ku bireba ibyo bicuruzwa iyo gukoresha
ibyo bicuruzwa ku mpamvu z’ubucuruzi
muri Repubulika y’u Rwanda bibangamira
uburenganzira bihabwa n’ikirango
cyangwa ikimenyetso ndangahantu;
(b) bibangamira uburenganzira bw’umuhanzi
cyangwa uburenganzira bushamikiyeho
cyangwa undi muntu wabiherewe
uruhushya na nyir’ubwo burenganzira mu
gihugu byakorewemo kandi byakozwe ku
buryo buziguye cyangwa butaziguye
bivanwe ku gicuruzwa iyo gukorera iyo
kopi muri Repubulika y’u Rwanda
byashoboraga kubangamira uburenganzira
bw’umuhanzi cyangwa uburenganzira
bushamikiyeho;
(c) bifitanye isano n’ubundi burenganzira
burengerwa, kubyinjiza mu gihugu
cyangwa kubisakaza mu nzira z’ubucuruzi
byavamo ibikorwa bigize icyaha cyo
kwigana umutungo bwite mu by’ubwenge.

articles.heading: Kumenyesha ihagarikwa ry’ikwirakwizwa ry’ibicuruzwa by’ibyiganano (1) Ihagarikwa ry’ikwirakwiza ry’ibicuruzwa
articles.text:
by’ibyiganano ryakozwe n’ubuyobozi bwa
gasutamo bubyibwirije cyangwa
bubisabwe n’ufite uburenganzira
rimenyeshwa ufite uburenganzira
n’uwinjije ibicuruzwa.
(2) Imenyesha rivugwa mu gika cya (1) cy’iyi
ngingo rikorwa mu gihe kitarenze iminsi
itanu y’akazi ibarwa uhereye ku itariki
icyemezo cy’ihagarika cyafatiwe.

articles.heading: Gusuzuma no gutanga amakuru ku bicuruzwa by’ibyiganano (1) Haseguriwe ihame ryo kudahishura
articles.text:
amakuru y’ibanga, ubuyobozi bwa
gasutamo bushobora kwemerera ufite
uburenganzira burengewe, ufite
uburenganzira ku bicuruzwa, uwabyinjije
cyangwa uwo bigenewe gusuzuma
ibicuruzwa byahagarikiwe ikwirakwizwa
no gufata indobanwa kugira ngo
zisuzumwe, zipimwe kandi
zinasesengurwe hagamijwe gusobanura
ibyo buri ruhande rusaba cyangwa
rwireguraho.
(2) Iyo gukwirakwiza ibicuruzwa
bihagaritswe, ubuyobozi bwa gasutamo
bumenyesha ufite uburenganzira
burengewe umwirondoro wa
nyir’ibicuruzwa, uwabyinjije cyangwa
uwo bigenewe, ibicuruzwa n’ingano
yabyo.

articles.heading: Itangwa ry’ingwate ku guhagarika ikwirakwizwa ry’ibicuruzwa by’ibyiganano (1) Ubuyobozi bwa gasutamo buhagarika
articles.text:
ikwirakwizwa ry’ibicuruzwa uwabisabye
agaragaje ko yatanze ingwate cyangwa
ubundi bwishingire.
(2) Ingwate ivugwa mu gika cya (1) cy’iyi
ngingo igenewe ibi bikurikira:
(a) kwishyura imirimo ijyanye no
guhagarika ikwirakwizwa ryakozwe
n’ubuyobozi bwa gasutamo;
(b) guha indishyi ikwiye uwinjije
ibicuruzwa igihe bigaragaye ko nta
kwigana kwakozwe.
(3) Iyo gukwirakwiza ibicuruzwa
by’ibyiganano bihagaritswe n’ubuyobozi
bwa gasutamo bubyibwirije, ingwate
itangwa n’ufite uburenganzira ku
bicuruzwa mu gihe cy’iminsi 10 y’akazi
ibarwa uhereye itariki yabimenyesherejwe.
Mu gihe ingwate idatanzwe, ibicuruzwa
birarekurwa.
(4) Iteka rya Minisitiri rigena ingano
y’ingwate cyangwa y’ubwishingire
itangwa ku bicuruzwa bisabirwa
guhagarika ikwirakwizwa.

articles.heading: Igihe guhagarika ikwirakwizwa ry’ibicuruzwa bimara (1) Uwasabye guhagarika ikwirakwizwa ry’ibicuruzwa agaragariza ubuyobozi bwa
articles.text:
gasutamo ko yashyikirije urukiko
rubifitiye ububasha ikirego cyangwa
akabugaragariza icyemezo cy’agateganyo
cyongera igihe cy’ihagarikwa
ry’ikwirakwiza cyafashwe n’urukiko
rubifitiye ububasha mu gihe kitarenze
iminsi 10 y’akazi ibarwa uhereye ku itariki
yamenyesherejweho icyemezo cyo
guhagarika ikwirakwiza ry’ibicuruzwa.
(2) Iyo ibisabwa biteganyijwe mu gika cya (1)
cy’iyi ngingo bitubahirijwe, ibicuruzwa
birarekurwa nyuma yo kubahiriza
imihango yo gukura ibicuruzwa muri
gasutamo.
(3) Iyo ubusabe bwo guhagarika ikwirakwiza
ry’ibicuruzwa bwerekeye igishushanyo
n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa mu nganda,
ubuvumbuzi, ubuvumbuzi buciriritse,
igishushanyo ndangamiterere cyangwa
amakuru y’ibanga mu bucuruzi
byahagaritswe n’ubuyobozi bwa gasutamo
kandi n’igihe cy’ihagarikwa ry’ibicuruzwa
kivugwa mu gika cya (1) cy’iyi ngingo
kikarangira urukiko rutarategeka ko
ibicuruzwa birekurwa kandi n’ibindi byose
bisabwa mu kwinjiza ibicuruzwa bikaba
byubahirijwe, ufite uburenganzira kuri
ibyo ibicuruzwa, uwabyinjije cyangwa
uwo ibyo bicuruzwa bigenewe agira
uburenganzira bw’uko birekurwa amaze
gutanga ingwate ihagije kugira ngo ufite
uburenganzira wasabye ihagarikwa
ry’ibicuruzwa arindwe igihombo
cyakomoka ku ibangamirwa iryo ari ryo
ryose.
(4) Iyo uwasabye ihagarikwa ry’ikwirakwiza
ry’ibicuruzwa adatanze ikirego cy’indishyi
mu rukiko rubifitiye ububasha mu gihe
kitarenze iminsi 14 ibarwa uhereye ku
itariki yo guhagarika ikwirakwizwa
ry’ibicuruzwa ingwate irasubizwa.

articles.heading: Ukutaryozwa k’ubuyobozi bwa gasutamo Ubuyobozi bwa gasutamo n’abakozi babwo ntibaryozwa igikorwa gikozwe mu gihe
articles.text:
hubahirijwe amategeko n’imihango yo gukura
ibicuruzwa muri gasutamo no guhagarika
ikwirakwizwa ryabyo niyo nyuma bigaragaye
ko habayeho ikwirakwizwa ry’ibicuruzwa
bibangamira ufite uburenganzira burengewe.

articles.heading: Ibicuruzwa bitarebwa n’ibyemezo byihariye bikurikizwa ku mupaka Ibyemezo byihariye bikurikizwa ku mupaka
articles.text:
ntibireba ibi bikurikira:
(a) ibicuruzwa bike byinjijwe mu gihugu
hatagamije ubucuruzi;
(b) ibicuruzwa binyujijwe ku butaka bwa
Repubulika y’u Rwanda.
Akiciro ka 2: Ibyemezo bifatwa n’inkiko

articles.heading: Impamvu urukiko rushingiraho rufata icyemezo Urukiko rubifitiye ububasha rushobora gufata icyemezo hagamijwe gukumira ibangamira
articles.text:
ry’uburenganzira ku bicuruzwa rushingiye
nibura ku mpamvu zikurikira:
(a) iyo ibyo bicuruzwa bibangamiye
uburenganzira ku mutungo bwite mu
by’ubwenge burengerwa muri
Repubulika y’u Rwanda;
(b) iyo gutunganya ibyo bicuruzwa
cyangwa kubishyira ku isoko muri
Repubulika y’u Rwanda ari igikorwa
cy’ihiganwa ritemewe.

articles.heading: Icyemezo gifatwa n’urukiko (1) Urukiko rubifitiye ububasha iyo rusanze harabaye ibangamira ry’uburenganzira ku
articles.text:
bicuruzwa rushobora gufata icyemezo cyo:
(a) kuvana ibyo bicuruzwa ku isoko ry’u
Rwanda;
(b) guhagarika ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi
bw’ibicuruzwa bibangamira
uburenganzira ku mutungo bwite mu
by’ubwenge;
(c) kwangiza ibyo bicuruzwa.
(2) Mbere yo gufata icyemezo cyo kwangiza
ibicuruzwa bibangamira uburenganzira no
kubivana ku isoko, urukiko rugereranya
uburemere bw’ibangamira byateza ku
isoko, n’icyemezo cyafashwe n’inyungu
z’abandi bantu.
UMUTWE WA II: IBYAHA N’IBIHANO

articles.heading: Kubangamira uburenganzira ku mutungo bwite mu by’ubwenge Umuntu ukoresha umutungo bwite mu
articles.text:
by’ubwenge atabyemerewe n’ufite
uburenganzira kuri uwo mutungo, agakora
kimwe mu bikorwa bikurikira abigambiriye
kandi agamije ubucuruzi:
(a) kwigana uburenganzira bw’umuhanzi
cyangwa uburenganzira bushamikiyeho
burengerwa;
(b) gukora, kugurisha, gutanga kugira ngo
bagure, gutanga kugira ngo bakodeshe,
gutunga cyangwa kwinjiza ku butaka
bw’u Rwanda ibicuruzwa by’ibyiganano;
(c) gukoresha ikirango cy’undi muntu; aba
akoze icyaha. Iyo abihamijwe n’urukiko,
ahanishwa igifungo kitari munsi y’imyaka
3 ariko kitarenze imyaka 5 n’ihazabu
y’amafaranga atari munsi ya FRW
3.000.000 ariko atarenze FRW 5.000.000.

articles.heading: Gukina cyangwa gutangaza igihangano mu buryo bwo kwigana Umuntu wese, ukina cyangwa utangaza
articles.text:
igihangano mu buryo bwiganwe, aba akoze
icyaha. Iyo abihamijwe n’urukiko, ahanishwa
igifungo kitari munsi y’imyaka 3 ariko
kitarenze imyaka 5 n’ihazabu y’amafaranga
atari munsi ya FRW 7.000.000 ariko atarenze
FRW 10.000.000.

articles.heading: Gukoresha izina ry’umuhanzi mu buriganya cyangwa ikimenyetso gitandukanya ku gihangano cy’ubuvanganzo, icy’ubugeni cyangwa
articles.text:
icy’ubumenyi
Umuntu wese, ukoresha mu buryo
bw’uburiganya izina ry’umuhanzi cyangwa
ikimenyetso gitandukanya ku gihangano
cy’ubuvanganzo, icy’ubugeni cyangwa
icy’ubumenyi, aba akoze icyaha. Iyo
abihamijwe n’urukiko, ahanishwa igifungo
kitari munsi y’imyaka 3 ariko kitarenze
imyaka 5 n’ihazabu y’amafaranga atari munsi
ya FRW 7.000.000 ariko atarenze FRW
10.000.000.

articles.heading: Kugurisha ibyatunganyijwe byiganwe Umuntu wese ugurisha ibyatunganyijwe mu buryo byiganwe abizi, aba akoze icyaha. Iyo
articles.text:
abihamijwe n’urukiko, ahanishwa ihazabu
y’amafaranga itari munsi ya FRW 300.000
ariko atarenze FRW 500.000.

articles.heading: Gutangariza rubanda igihangano kirengewe nta ruhushya Umuntu wese usakaza cyangwa utangariza
articles.text:
rubanda igihangano kirengewe akoresheje
uburyo ubwo ari bwo bwose bw’itumanaho,
atabiherewe uruhushya n’ufite uburenganzira
ku gihangano cyangwa umuhagarariye, aba
akoze icyaha. Iyo abihamijwe n’urukiko,
ahanishwa ihazabu y’amafaranga atari munsi
ya FRW 1.000.000 ariko atarenze FRW
2.000.000.

articles.heading: Gutanga cyangwa guha undi muntu uburenganzira bwo gukina igihangano nta ruhushya rwa nyiracyo
articles.text:
Umuntu wese utanga cyangwa uha undi muntu
uburenganzira bwo gukina igihangano nta
ruhushya rw’ufite uburenganzira ku gihangano
cyangwa umuhagarariye cyangwa undi muntu
wese ukoresha uruhushya rutari ukuri, aba
akoze icyaha. Iyo abihamijwe n’urukiko,
ahanishwa igifungo kitari munsi y’umwaka 1
ariko kitarenze imyaka 2 n’ihazabu
y’amafaranga atari munsi ya FRW 500.000
ariko atarenze FRW 1.000.000.

articles.heading: Kwiba cyangwa gukoresha mu buryo bw’uburiganya forumire ikoreshwa mu buvumbuzi Umuntu wiba cyangwa ukoresha mu buryo
articles.text:
bw’uburiganya forumire ikoreshwa mu
buvumbuzi, aba akoze icyaha. Iyo abihamijwe
n’urukiko, ahanishwa igifungo kitari munsi
y’imyaka 3 ariko kitarenze imyaka 5,
n’ihazabu y’amafaranga atari munsi ya FRW
7.000.000 ariko atarenze FRW 10.000.000.

articles.heading: Igikorwa cy’ihiganwa kirimo uburiganya ku byerekeye umutungo bwite mu by’ubwenge Umuntu ukoze igikorwa cy’ihiganwa kirimo
articles.text:
uburiganya ku byerekeye umutungo bwite mu
by’ubwenge, aba akoze icyaha. Iyo
abihamijwe n’urukiko, ahanishwa ihazabu
y’amafaranga atari munsi ya FRW 7.000.000
ariko atarenze FRW 10.000.000.

articles.heading: Ihanwa ry’ikigo cyangwa urwego bifite ubuzima gatozi Ikigo cyangwa urwego bifite ubuzima gatozi
articles.text:
bikoze kimwe mu byaha bivugwa mu ngingo
ya 373, iya 374, iya 375, iya 376, iya 377, iya
378, iya 379 n’iya 380 z’iri tegeko biba bikoze
icyaha. Iyo bigihamijwe n’urukiko,
bihanishwa ihazabu y’amafaranga yikubye
inshuro icumi ku gihano cy`ihazabu
giteganyijwe kuri buri ngingo.

articles.heading: Ibihano by’inyongera Ku bihano biteganywa n’iri tegeko, urukiko rushobora kongeraho ifatira, isenywa cyangwa
articles.text:
inyagwa ry’ibikoresho byakoreshejwe mu
gukora kimwe mu byaha biteganywa n’iri
tegeko.
INTERURO YA V: INGINGO
ZINYURANYE, IZ’INZIBACYUHO
N’IZISOZA

articles.heading: Amafaranga yagenwe Iteka rya Minisitiri rigena ingano y’amafaranga yagenwe yishyurwa kuri serivisi
articles.text: ateganyijwe muri iri tegeko n’aho ashyirwa.

articles.heading: Amateka asanzwe akurikizwa Amateka ateganywa n’Itegeko nº 31/2009 ryo ku wa 26/10/2009 rigamije kurengera
articles.text:
umutungo bwite mu by’ubwenge nk’uko
ryahinduwe kugeza ubu akomeza kubahirizwa
mu ngingo zayo zitanyuranyije n’iri tegeko mu
gihe kitarenze amezi atandatu, abarwa uhereye
ku itariki iri tegeko ritangarijweho mu Igazeti
ya Leta ya Repubulika y’u Rwanda.

articles.heading: Ingingo y’ururimi Iri tegeko ryateguwe mu rurimi rw’Icyongereza, risuzumwa kandi ritorwa mu
articles.text: rurimi rw’Ikinyarwanda.

articles.heading: Ingingo ivanaho Itegeko n° 31/2009 ryo ku wa 26/10/2009 ryerekeye kurengera umutungo bwite mu
articles.text:
by’ubwenge nk’uko ryahinduwe kugeza ubu
rivanyweho.

articles.heading: Gutangira gukurikizwa ITEGEKO N° 055/2024 RYO KU WA 20/06/2024 RYEREKEYE KURENGERA UMUTUNGO BWITE MU
articles.text:
BY’UBWENGE
Twebwe, KAGAME Paul,
Perezida wa Repubulika;
INTEKO ISHINGA AMATEGEKO
YEMEJE, NONE NATWE DUHAMIJE,
DUTANGAJE ITEGEKO RITEYE
RITYA, KANDI DUTEGETSE KO
RITANGAZWA MU IGAZETI YA LETA
YA REPUBULIKA Y’U RWANDA
INTEKO ISHINGA AMATEGEKO:
Umutwe w’Abadepite, mu nama yawo yo ku
wa 04 Ukuboza 2023;
Ishingiye ku Itegeko Nshinga rya Repubulika
y’u Rwanda cyane cyane mu ngingo yaryo ya
64;
Ishingiye ku Itegeko ryo ku wa 26 Gicurasi
1996 ryemera ko u Rwanda ruba kimwe mu
bihugu bigize umunyamuryango
w’Umuryango Mpuzamahanga w’Ubucuruzi;
Ishingiye ku Masezerano ya Berne yerekeye
kurengera ibihangano byo mu rwego
rw’ubuvanganzo n’urw’ubugeni yashyiriweho
umukono i Berne mu Busuwisi ku wa 09 Nzeri
1886 nk’uko yavuguruwe kugeza ubu, nk’uko
yemejwe n’Itegeko n°18/1983 ryo ku wa
18/08/1983;
Ishingiye ku Masezerano ya Budapest
yerekeye iyemerwa mpuzamahanga
ry’ububiko bw’ingirabuzima ntoya hagamijwe
iyubahirizwa ry’ibikurikizwa mu gusaba
impamyabuvumbuzi yashyiriweho umukono i
Budapest muri Hongiriya ku wa 28 Mata 1977
nk’uko yavuguruwe kugeza ubu, nk’uko
yemejwe n’Iteka rya Perezida nº 047/01 ryo ku
wa 11/07/2023;
Ishingiye ku Masezerano ya Harare yerekeye
impamyabuvumbuzi n’igishushanyo
n’icyitegererezo bikoreshwa mu nganda mu
rwego rw’Umuryango wo mu Karere ka
Afurika ugamije kurengera Umutungo bwite
mu by’Ubwenge (ARIPO) yashyiriweho
umukono i Harare muri Zimbabwe ku wa 10
Ukuboza 1982 nk’uko yahinduwe kugeza ubu,
nk’uko yemejwe n’Iteka rya Perezida nº 17/01
ryo ku wa 16/02/2011;
Ishingiye ku Masezerano ya Marrakesh
agamije korohereza abantu bafite ubumuga
bwo kutabona, kutabona neza, cyangwa
kutabasha gusoma igitabo yashyiriweho
umukono i Marrakesh muri Maroc ku wa 27
Kamena 2013, nk’uko yemejwe n’Iteka rya
Perezida N° 087/01 ryo ku wa 07/09/2020;
Ishingiye ku Masezerano y’i Madrid yerekeye
iyandikwa ry’ibirango ku rwego
mpuzamahanga yashyiriweho umukono i
Madrid muri Esipanye kuwa 27 Kamena 1989
nk’uko yahinduwe kugeza ubu, nk’uko
yemejwe n’Iteka rya Perezida N° 09/01 ryo ku
wa 16/02/2011;
Ishingiye ku Masezerano y’i Paris ajyanye no
kurengera umutungo bwite mu by’inganda
yashyiriweho umukono i Paris mu Bufaransa
kuwa 20 Werurwe 1883, nk’uko yavuguruwe
kugeza ubu yemejwe n’Itegeko n°17/1983 ryo
ku wa 18 Kanama 1983;
Ishingiye ku Masezerano y’Ubufatanye mu
byerekeye impamyabuvumbuzi yashyiriweho
umukono i Washington muri Leta Zunze
Ubumwe z’Amerika ku wa 19 Kamena 1970,
nk’uko yemejwe n’Iteka rya Perezida no16/01
ryo ku wa 16/02/2011.
Isubiye ku Itegeko nº 31/2009 ryo ku wa
26/10/2009 rigamije kurengera umutungo
bwite mu by’ubwenge nk’uko ryahinduwe
kugeza ubu;
